The surgeon’s register took the body’s inventory and entered it nowhere: one stiff leathery brown-edged barley crust two inches from the ear, its empty place unnamed and no third; the thread frozen in the dry heat and unwiped, because nobody under any roof has been given an instruction about the thread and a basket set down is a pot set down and left; cold stopped at cheek, temple and the bare joint of the wrist where the wool rides back, the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody in this house will perform. He knew the shape of a man going cold and wanted the crust; both were true and the second was louder. Instruction went to the wool, fire, pot, broom, running water and river wind and never to the basket; \emph{the house}, \emph{The house will keep it}, half-pace from every open slate, jar-glance without a touch, hand shut half over nothing, finger on top of the shelf’s front edge so the charcoal stayed unread, pot handle two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, lips along the two-gapped row with no figure, cost-questions sent to the pot and the weather with nothing priced, refused or entered (T058/T079, T100, T077). The dressed grain was turned under wool for damp on all three mornings, spread thin and gathered back by the handful, changing state and gaining no figure, counted in glances, handfuls and the carrying arm’s weight that knows weight and not cost, entered on no slate and laid across none of the absences. Garl stayed in objects — salt-stiff coat with the left-shoulder crease, hollow wheel-seat with its twenty-year lean, clean dark line and finer grey called the thaw, proverb gone to a pot with no crack, tile debt circling without a name — his name unspoken two hundred and forty-five days, no collector up or down the clay road (T009/T013/T092). The widow’s mark hung where it hung, touched once before the kiln on Smoke 1 and at no shelf, well, rack, road, basket, afternoon or dusk on Smoke 4, 5 or 6, because the hand goes to the mark before the kiln and at no other hour; the opening stayed behind the household, no lesson made and no payer named (T058/T079). \textbf{The chapter’s one meaningful change, T080 advanced and not paid:} at the yard well on Smoke 5 a woman of the firing work, \textbf{Ilva}, drew a short strip of notched birch bark from her sleeve and passed the nail of a thumb across the notches before her eyes went to the woman who had asked and before her mouth answered \emph{Five to this morning}; the hand went to the record before it went to the person and to the pot not at all. What the notches held was a count of firings, plain as a firing is plain, kept in wood because a slate would want a figure put on it; nothing on the stick waited to be read and no figure came off it that a clerk could enter. He took the order of reaching and filed it as a \textbf{ninth record-first hand-shape} on a place of its own beside the eighth, a finger between every pair and fingers between it and the charcoal, the cords, the knots, the pages, the tins, the missing hand and the pale line. He did not read the stick, ask her about it or let nine likenesses stand up and call themselves a rule, for a rule is an account that has found a payer and none stood to any (T080). At the kindling Tarn’s ear-sentence reached the word that would call the loan and stopped, nine stoppings standing with no tenth and the Seed 16 breath unspent; at the wheel-shed Jorra parted dust from slip, withheld the note he knew three turns ahead, kept the burned slate at four and the shut-room tellings at two, held his bent finger in the damper as a remembered repetition, and kept \emph{he’s not Vail} sealed and the promise ungiven (T036/T076, T035/T031/T062/T065/T095). On Smoke 6 a wrong wind off High Kiln brought the sweet edge of lead glaze over the boards, touched the fold and went out on the wind that brought it — a direction arrived nowhere and not a second edge paid — and one of the three shapings of the pot saying stood again as a saying, no fourth likeness made a cause, no pot lost and no name given to what ailed the man carried out on Day 188 (T064 held). The file turned out as instruments on a towel was exact, complete and worth nothing: six hearings beside and never among with no seventh, three near-full answers, three pot sayings, the fourth burned-slate telling, two shut-room tellings, told bell beside heard, told figure beside paid with Grain’s third subtraction locked in Berr’s box, the returning-line place gone around with a look and no number, the question on its seventh place with four askings and no witness standing, and the ninth hand on its own tray (T101 carried, T098 carried). Six answers of the hand across the three days, the sixty-first through the sixty-sixth, each filed on the sixth place with no payer named: down at once; down before the letting-go; held to the river’s own low interval with no count in the house to borrow; one borrowed rhythm crossed with one kept; one rhythm held through the little silence after Sella’s count; and in the small hours of Day 245 two rhythms crossing in the inch across a wall that does not touch, remembered and not a change made again. \textbf{Sixty-six} answers now stand on the sixth place, objects and not powers, not a longer reach, a miss entered, a hearing, a seventh, a tenth stopping, a payment, a held change, a key, a power or a rule. He still cannot close two inches to the pot handle, lift the leathery crust or speak a number. Nothing was joined, named, opened, called, spent or ended, no thread was paid and no new thread opened; the hand lay down against the fold like a tool put away and the count went forward into Smoke 7, unspent and told by nobody.
