The house has said it, going away level with nothing priced, refused or entered (T077), while the printed figure stood at one in twelve unchallenged, the true subtraction sat locked in Berr’s box up the road, Hessa’s slate had gone to Greybank unread and the soft-cuffed clerk remained set at the out-of-line landing for an uncalled measure (T015/T041/T047, T080, T090 held); the yard went around the clean dark line and the finer grey called the thaw, the broken birth-slates beneath the lowest rack, the pan’s gone round ring, the bare dark trough whose water was called weather, the field’s empty place where a hand went in on Seed 15 and the place the carriers crossed, each with a look and a wide step and no number, while Tarn took the broom only after it was instructed and went over the flagstones without the half-check, Jorra’s wheel turned beyond the shed and the back room kept its finger’s width of open with no name given to the men who had gone in before first grey (T009/T013/T092/T098, T036/T076, T035/T031/T065/T095); at the shelf Sella moved her lips along the loaf row with two unnamed gaps and gave nobody a figure, kept her finger from beneath the front edge so the charcoal stayed unread, and at the going of the light carried him home up the clay road with woodsmoke before and river wind behind, set him on his bed and not in the Debt Loft, left the thread frozen and did not touch the mark, and in the small hours he turned out the file as instruments on a towel --- six hearings beside and never among with the sixth from a person and no seventh in a hundred and ninety-two days, three near-full answers advanced and unpaid, nine stoppings as objects with no tenth, three held changes on three places with the loft scrape on a fourth and the carried man’s pale line on a fifth, the told bell beside the heard and the told figure beside the paid --- exact, complete and worth nothing, with one hundred and ninety-two standing unspent in the dark of the wool.}
\CRday{Day 193}{Ember 14, Y.H. 813 (Fourthday)  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, hearth, loaf shelf’s low angle and kiln mouth, the drying racks, the yard well and the bare trough, the wheel-shed edge, the back room (not entered), the kindling, the flagstones, the Debt Loft (heard only), the clay road at the going of the light, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  The kiln month’s second working week ran on without a boundary drawn and neither the district’s name of firing month for Tallow nor its name of kiln month for Ember was corrected, while the boy came into his hundred and ninety-third day, six months and thirteen days, told by nobody, the carried fire’s payer without a name for a hundred and ninety-three days and the river, fire and boards keeping three counts in three places that did not become one (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082); hot clay came under tallow and wet wool under that with the sour breath of the unswept corner, the crust leathery two inches from his ear, the thread frozen and unwiped, the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody would perform, while Sella Vail fed him barley gruel from the house’s own dish with two fingers behind his ear, wiped the spoon on her sleeve and not his mouth, gave the instruction to the wool, fire, pot, broom and running water and never the basket, said the house, kept her half-pace, glanced once at the clay jar without touching it, set the pot handle two inches beyond the reaching hand and left the widow’s mark where it hung because a morning and a shelf are not openings (T058/T079); a rack woman with slip dried pale in her wrists asked what the pots would want before the kiln month was out and was sent to the pot and the weather with nothing priced or entered, and the sweet edge of lead glaze came up off High Kiln on a wrong wind again, was taken as a direction and not a name or a cause and went out on the same wind, nobody naming what ailed the man carried out on Day 188, calling a collector, giving a figure, opening a slate or making a lesson of the glaze, so that his pale line lay on a place of its own and his cost stood entered nowhere (T077, T064); three or four men unnamed went low into the finger’s-width-open back room before first grey and got no name, the two shut-room tellings staying two, and the yard went around the broken birth-slates, the dark line, the thaw, the pan’s gone ring, the bare trough and the field’s empty place with a look and a wide step (T035/T031/T065/T095, T009/T013/T092/T098); Jorra came through with grey slate dust ground small as meal past the bent finger and white in the creases where a fist had opened, not bone-coloured slip, kept dusty and clean forearms on one tray, told the wheel it did not care whose hands and a pot it would do, withheld the full note he knew three turns ahead from a man on a wrong wind who said a pot singing early generally sings itself out early, and held his bent finger in the cold damper until Sella’s unfinished sentence reached the pot --- a remembered holding and not a change made again (T035/T031, T061/T082, T062); Tarn took the broom only after it was instructed, told the wood Six counted. The next I don’t count with six in the worn thumb-mark and the seventh at the lip beside Garl’s unforged collector sentence, Ash worked into his knuckles and the pale clip-ring at his wrist, said Yes, house to an early thaw and a late while wanting the late, brought the ear-sentence all the way to the word that would call the loan and stopped there, drew the Seed 16 breath and did not spend it, kept the nine stoppings with no tenth and went over the bright patch without the half-check, and no collector came up or down the clay road (T036/T076), while the stone lay cold and unreconciled in its loft pot and the charcoal waited unread (T006, T100); then came the chapter’s first small movement, for at the low angle under the shelf where the underside made a roof that stopped at his reach his hand outside the wool went up an inch toward the note of water over water and did not come down at once but held for the length of the small pause in the kiln’s breath before the next pull, a fraction filed on a place of its own --- not a hearing, not a seventh, not a stopping, not one of the three held changes, not a payment, with no payer named and no cause allowed to stand up out of it (T071/T072, T061/T082); the told bell stood beside the heard and the told figure beside the paid, no third gap came and no finger of his drew the line, and one hundred and ninety-three stood exact, complete and unspent in the dark of the wool, the hand lying outside the wool with the inch still in it.}
\CRday{Day 194}{Ember 15, Y.H. 813 (Fifthday)  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, hearth, loaf shelf’s low angle and kiln mouth, the yard well and the bare trough, the drying racks and the space beneath the lowest rack, the wall where the shallow pan stood, the field’s empty place, the place the carriers crossed, the wheel-shed and its finger’s-width-open back room (not entered), the clay road at the going of the light, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  The third quiet morning was the fullest yet and the kiln month’s second working week drew toward its end with no boundary drawn, the boy one hundred and ninety-four days old and six months and fourteen days and nobody saying so, the carried fire’s payer unnamed for a hundred and ninety-four days and the river’s fifth note, the boards’ four nails, four and a thumb-width knot and the fire’s four pulls keeping three counts in three places that did not become one (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082); hot clay came under tallow and wet wool with the sour corner breath, the crust leathery two inches from his ear, the thread frozen and unwiped, cold stopped at cheek, temple and the bare wrist joint, and in the morning his hand went up an inch toward the note of water over water and came down at once with no holding in it yet, while Sella Vail gave the instruction to the wool, the fire, the pot, the broom, the running water, the river wind and never the basket, said the house, kept her half-pace, glanced once at the clay jar without touching it, fed him barley gruel from the house’s own dish, wiped the spoon on her sleeve and not his mouth, set the pot handle two inches beyond the reaching hand with her hand resting a half-beat longer, counted under her breath toward no opening and left the widow’s mark untouched because there had been no opening since before the kiln on Ember 1 (T058/T079); a woman with a wet pot asked what a wet thing cost set down in the dry heat and a man come off the clay road asked what the kiln would want now the figure had gone up, and both were sent to the pot and the weather, going away level with nothing priced, refused or entered while the printed one in twelve stood unchallenged and the true subtraction sat in a locked box up the road (T077, T015/T041/T047); the yard went around the clean dark line and the thaw, the broken birth-slates, the pan’s gone round ring, the bare trough called weather, the field’s empty place and the place the carriers crossed, on trays that did not touch, the sweet edge riding up off High Kiln on a wrong wind as a direction and going out on it with no man revived as a cause, no collector called and no Grathic sickness named (T009/T013/T092/T098, T064); three or four men unnamed went low into the back room before first grey and got no name, Jorra kept dusty and clean forearms on one tray, withheld his note from the wrong wind and held his bent finger in the cold damper as a remembered repetition, and Tarn kept six where the house could check and the seventh at the lip, brought the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan, held the Seed 16 breath, kept nine stoppings with no tenth and swept past the bright patch without the half-check so that no collector came (T035/T031/T062/T065/T095, T036/T076), while the charcoal waited unread, the stone lay cold in its loft pot and the file went with him and came back exact and worth nothing (T100, T006, T060/T086/T097); at the going of the light she carried him home up the clay road with woodsmoke before and river wind behind, went wide around the absences, set him on his bed and not in the Debt Loft, put the fold right without looking at his face, left the thread frozen, told the fire it was the thaw, banked the coals and did not touch the mark; then in the small hours, after the file came back exact, complete and worthless with six hearings beside and never among, no seventh, three near-full answers unpaid, nine stoppings with no tenth, three held changes on three places with the loft scrape on a fourth and the carried man’s pale line on a fifth, his hand outside the wool went up an inch toward the note of water over water through the finger’s-width door and \textbf{stayed up for the length of one of the breaths Sella counted at her fire in the room that did not touch this one} --- the small intake at the top, the hold, the letting go --- before coming down against the fold, an inch held and let go, filed on a place of its own beside the others, not a hearing, not a seventh, not a stopping, not a payment, not one of the three held changes, with no payer named and no doctrine allowed to stand up out of it, while he still could not close two inches on the pot handle, lift his chin to the crust or speak a number, the body humiliating him and moving by an inch at the same time, and one hundred and ninety-four standing exact, complete and unspent in the dark of the wool with nothing joined, named, opened, called, spent or ended, the count going forward into Day 195, Ember 16 (T071/T072, T061/T082, T088).}
\CRday{Day 195}{Ember 16, Y.H. 813 (Sixthday)  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, hearth and loaf shelf’s low angle, the Clay Yard, the kiln mouth, the drying racks, the yard well and the trough, the wall where the shallow pan stood, the field’s empty place, the place the carriers crossed, the wheel-shed edge, the kindling, the flagstones and the clay road at the going of the light, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  The hand outside the wool went up an inch toward the river’s note of water over water and came down as it had every morning of his life while the boy came into his hundred and ninety-fifth day, six months and fifteen days, told by nobody, the carried fire answering four low pulls with its fifth missing and its payer unnamed for a hundred and ninety-five days and the river’s fifth note, the kiln’s four-and-a-gap and the boards’ four nails, four and a thumb-width knot keeping three counts in three places that did not become one (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082); hot clay came under tallow and wet wool under that with the sour corner breath, the crust leathery two inches from his ear, the thread frozen and unwiped, cold stopped at cheek, temple and the bare wrist joint, the afterdrop waiting on a warming nobody would perform, while Sella Vail gave the instruction to the wool, the fire, the pot, the broom and the running water and never the basket, said the house, kept her half-pace, glanced once at the clay jar cold under its glaze without touching it, pushed coal-black hair back with the burn-wrist so the grey streak showed pale, fed him barley gruel from the house’s own dish with two fingers behind his ear and the spoon wiped on her sleeve and not his mouth, set the pot handle two inches beyond the reaching hand with her hand resting a half-beat longer at the setting, told the fire it was the thaw, counted under her breath toward no opening and left the widow’s mark untouched because a morning and a shelf are not openings and there had been none since before the kiln on Ember 1 (T058/T079); a neighbour with dry mud-scurf on her hem asked what the firing would want now the account had gone up the road and was sent to the pot and the weather with Ask the pot what a firing costs set down there. The house has said it, going away level with nothing priced, refused or entered, the printed one in twelve standing unchallenged and the true subtraction locked in Berr’s box up the road (T077, T015/T041/T047 held), while the sweet edge of lead glaze came off High Kiln on a wrong wind and went out on the same wind as a direction answered with pot and weather and no second edge paid (T064 held); the yard went around the clean dark line and the finer grey called the thaw, the rack space with its broken birth-slates, the pan’s gone round ring, the bare dark trough called weather, the field’s empty place where a hand went in on Seed 15 and the place the carriers crossed, each with a look and a wide step and no number (T009/T013/T092/T098); at the shelf Sella moved her lips along the loaf row with two unnamed gaps and gave nobody a figure and kept her finger from beneath the front edge so the charcoal stayed unread (T100), while Tarn took the broom only after instruction, told the wood Six counted. The next I don’t count, brought the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stopped, drew the Seed 16 breath and did not spend it, kept the nine stoppings with no tenth before the seventh year was earned and went over the bright patch without the half-check so that no collector came (T036/T076), and Jorra kept dusty and clean forearms on one tray, told a pot You’ll do, withheld his note from a man on the wrong wind and held his bent finger in the cold damper until Sella’s unfinished sentence reached the pot as a remembered repetition (T035/T031/T062); at the going of the light she carried him home up the clay road with woodsmoke before and river wind behind, set him on his bed and not in the Debt Loft, put the fold right without looking at his face, left the thread frozen and did not touch the mark, and in the small hours the file came back exact, complete and worth nothing with six hearings beside and never among and no seventh, three near-full answers unpaid, the older intervals and nine stoppings as objects with no tenth, three held changes on three places with the loft scrape on a fourth and the carried man’s pale line on a fifth, then his hand outside the wool went up an inch toward the note of water over water and, when he asked it to stay, \textbf{held for the length of one of the breaths Sella counted at her fire in the room that does not touch this one} --- the small intake, the hold, the letting go --- before coming down against the fold, an inch held and let go, filed on a place of its own, not a hearing, not a seventh, not a stopping, not a payment, not one of the three held changes, with no payer named and no doctrine stood up out of it, while he still could not close two inches on the pot handle, lift his chin to the crust or speak a number, the body humiliating him and moving by an inch at the same time, and one hundred and ninety-five standing exact, complete and unspent in the dark of the wool (T071/T072, T061/T082).}
\CRday{Day 196}{Ember 17, Y.H. 813 (Seventhday)  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, hearth and loaf shelf, the yard well and the bare trough, the drying racks and the space beneath the lowest rack, the wall where the shallow pan stood, the field’s empty place, the place the carriers crossed, the wheel-shed and its finger’s-width-open back room (not entered), the cold damper, the kindling, the flagstones, the Debt Loft (heard only), the clay road at the going of the light, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  The kiln month’s second working week ran on without a boundary drawn while the district kept calling Tallow the firing month and Ember the kiln month and neither was corrected, the boy one hundred and ninety-six days old and six months and sixteen days and nobody saying so, the carried fire’s payer unnamed for a hundred and ninety-six days and the river’s fifth note, the kiln’s four-and-a-gap and the boards’ four nails, four and a thumb-width knot keeping three counts in three places that did not become one (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082); Sella Vail gave the instruction to the wool, fire, pot, broom, running water and river wind and never the basket, said the house, kept her half-pace, glanced once at the clay jar without touching it, fed him barley gruel from the house’s own dish with the spoon wiped on her sleeve and not his mouth, set the pot handle two inches beyond the reaching hand with the half-beat at the setting and left the widow’s mark where it hung (T058/T079), while a rack woman with slip dried pale in her wrists asked what the pots would want before the kiln month was out and a man come off the clay road asked what the kiln would want now the figure had gone up, and both were sent to the pot and the weather with nothing priced, refused or entered, the figure standing up the road in a locked box with the true subtraction inside and the printed one in twelve unchallenged (T077, T015/T041/T047 held); the yard went around the clean dark line and the finer grey called the thaw, the broken birth-slates beneath the lowest rack, the pan’s gone round ring with no scrape or chip, the bare dark trough whose water was called weather, the field’s empty place and the place the carriers crossed, each with a look and a wide step and no number, no third gap coming and no fourth likeness made a cause (T009/T013/T092/T098, T060/T086/T097); three or four unnamed men went low into the finger’s-width-open back room before first grey and got no name, the two shut-room tellings staying two (T035/T031/T065/T095), and Jorra came through with fine grey slate dust ground small as meal into both forearms past the bent little finger and white in the creases where a fist had opened, not bone-coloured slip, parted dust from slip as a surgeon parts a clot from its vessel, kept dusty and clean forearms on one tray, told the wheel it did not care whose hands and a pot it would do, withheld the full note he knew three turns ahead from a High Kiln kiln-master on a wrong wind who said a pot singing early generally sings itself out early, and held his bent finger in the cold damper until Sella’s unfinished sentence reached the pot as a remembered repetition (T035/T031/T062, T065/T095); at the racks a woman set a pot down wrong so that it gave its high thin note before its time and sang itself out early, and she went on with her hands, set it square, swept around the fault and made no lesson of it, the boy filing the note where a danger goes and not among the hearings, not as a seventh and not as a cause, with no collector called, no figure given and no second edge paid (T077, T061/T082, T064 held); at the kindling Tarn took the broom only after instruction, told the wood Six counted. The next I don’t count with six in the worn thumb-mark and the seventh at the lip beside Garl’s unforged collector sentence, Ash worked into his knuckles and the pale clip-ring at his wrist, brought the ear-sentence all the way to the word that would call the loan and stopped there with no figure and no name, drew the Seed 16 breath and did not spend it, kept nine stoppings with no tenth before the seventh year was earned and went over the bright patch without the half-check, and no collector came (T036/T076); the stone lay back in its unmarked pot in the loft cold and unreconciled by not trying, which is not forgiving, and the small dry scrape of a pot’s foot on loft stone lay on its own fourth place (T006), while the charcoal waited unread beneath the shelf (T100); at the going of the light she carried him home up the clay road with woodsmoke before and river wind behind, went wide around the absences, set him on his bed and not in the Debt Loft, put the fold right without looking at his face, left the thread frozen and did not touch the mark, and in the small hours the file came back exact, complete and worth nothing with six hearings beside and never among and no seventh in a hundred and ninety-six days, three near-full answers unpaid, nine stoppings with no tenth, three held changes on three places, the loft scrape on a fourth and the pale line on a fifth, then the hand outside the wool went up an inch toward the note of water over water and came down \textbf{before the counted breath had finished} --- the body keeping its own time, an inch held briefly no more a reaching than an inch held long and an inch let go early no more a failure than an inch that stays --- the shorter holding filed on its own place and not joined to the breath that outlasted it, to the fire’s gap or to any other place, not a seventh, hearing, stopping, payment or cause, with no payer named, while he still could not close two inches, lift the crust or speak a number, and one hundred and ninety-six stood exact, complete and unspent in the dark of the wool with nothing joined, named, opened, called, spent or ended (T071/T072, T061/T082).}
\CRday{Day 197}{Ember 18, Y.H. 813 (Eighthday)  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, hearth, loaf shelf and kiln mouth, the drying racks, the yard well and the bare trough, the wall where the shallow pan stood, the field’s empty place, the place the carriers crossed, the wheel-shed and its finger’s-width-open back room (not entered), the cold damper, the kindling, the flagstones, the Debt Loft (heard only), the clay road at the going of the light, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  The kiln month’s second working week drew toward its end with no boundary drawn, the boy one hundred and ninety-seven days old and six months and seventeen days and nobody under any roof saying so, the carried fire’s payer unnamed for a hundred and ninety-seven days and the river’s fifth note, the kiln’s four-and-a-gap and the boards’ four nails, four and a thumb-width knot keeping three counts in three places that did not become one (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082); Sella Vail gave the instruction to the wool, the fire, the pot, the broom, the running water and the river wind and never the basket, said the house, kept her half-pace, glanced once at the clay jar cold under its glaze without touching it, kept her finger from beneath the shelf so the charcoal stayed unread, fed him barley gruel from the house’s own dish with the spoon wiped on her sleeve and not his mouth, pushed coal-black hair back with the burn-wrist so the grey streak showed pale, set the pot handle two inches beyond the reaching hand with the half-beat at the setting, counted under her breath toward no opening and left the widow’s mark untouched, for a morning was not an opening and there had been none since before the kiln on Ember 1 (T058/T079, T100); three or four unnamed men with collars high went low-voiced into the back room before first grey and got no name, the two shut-room tellings staying two (T035/T031/T065/T095), and Jorra came through with grey slate dust ground small as meal into both forearms past the bent finger and white in the creases where a fist had opened, kept dusty and clean forearms on one tray, told the wheel it did not care whose hands and a pot it would do, withheld the knowing from a man come up on a wrong wind who said a pot singing before its time generally sings itself out early --- the saying staying a saying about a pot and not made true as a lesson, no pot lost --- and held his bent finger in the cold damper until Sella’s unfinished sentence reached the pot as a remembered repetition (T035/T031/T062, T065/T095); at the kiln mouth the sweet edge of lead glaze rode up off High Kiln on a wrong wind and went out on the same wind as a direction and not a second edge paid, no collector called for the glaze-room hand carried out while the month was young and his pale line at his gum lying on a place of its own, exact, complete and worth nothing at two paces, with no offstage fate invented for him (T064 held); neighbours asking what the firing would want now the account had gone up the road were sent to the pot and the weather and went away level, the printed one in twelve standing unchallenged, Berr’s box gone up the road locked with the true subtraction inside, Hessa’s narrow slate unread at Greybank and the soft-cuffed clerk still set at the out-of-line landing for a measure nobody called (T077, T015/T041/T047/T080/T090 held); the yard went around the clean dark line and the thaw, the rack space with its broken birth-slates, the pan’s gone round ring, the bare dark trough, the field’s empty place and the place the carriers crossed with a look and a wide step and no number, no third gap coming and no fourth likeness made a cause (T009/T013/T092/T098); at the going of the light she carried him home up the clay road with woodsmoke before and river wind behind and went wide around the absences, set him on his bed and not in the Debt Loft, put the fold right without a look at his face, left the thread frozen, banked the coals with the back of a broken pot and did not touch the mark because a dusk is not an opening, and in the small hours he turned out the file as a man lays instruments on a towel --- six hearings beside and never among with the sixth from a person and no seventh in a hundred and ninety-seven days, three near-full answers advanced and unpaid, nine stoppings with no tenth, the told bell beside the heard and the told figure beside the paid, three held changes on three places with the loft scrape on a fourth and the pale line on a fifth, the crust’s gap, the shelf’s two gaps, the pan’s gone ring and the field’s empty place on trays that do not touch, the warm stone cold in its loft pot, the Seed 16 breath unspent and the loan uncalled --- and then the hand outside the wool went up an inch toward the note of water over water through the finger’s-width door and \textbf{did not come down at once but stayed up through the whole of one of the breaths Sella counted at her fire in the room that does not touch this one --- the small intake, the hold, and on into the letting go --- and came down with the breath rather than before it, against the fold}, the longest holding yet, a coordination and not a reach, not a greater reach and not a stronger hand, filed on a place of its own beside the others and never laid across them, not a reaching, not a hearing, not a seventh, not a stopping, not a payment, not one of the three held changes, not a key, not a power and not a rule, with no payer named and no doctrine stood up out of it, while he still could not close the two inches to the pot handle, lift his chin to the crust or speak a number, the body humiliating him and moving by an inch at the same time, and one hundred and ninety-seven standing exact, complete and unspent in the dark of the wool, nothing joined, named, opened, called, spent or ended, the count going forward into Day 198, Ember 19 (T071/T072, T061/T082, T088).}
\CRday{Day 198}{Ember 19, Y.H. 813 (Ninthday)  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, hearth, kiln mouth and loaf shelf’s low angle, the Clay Yard, the yard well and the trough, the drying racks and the space beneath the lowest rack, the wall where the shallow pan stood, the field’s empty place and the place the carriers crossed, the kindling, the flagstones, the wheel-shed edge, the clay road at the going of the light, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  The hand outside the wool went up an inch toward the note of water over water through the finger’s-width door and came down before the counted breath had finished --- a shorter holding, the body keeping its own time, an inch let go early and no failure in it --- while the boy came into his hundred and ninety-eighth day, six months and eighteen days, and nobody under any roof said either number, the carried fire answering four low pulls with its fifth missing and its payer unnamed for a hundred and ninety-eight days and the river’s fifth note and the boards’ four nails, four and a thumb-width knot keeping three counts in three places that did not become one (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082); hot clay came under tallow and wet wool under that with the sour corner breath, the crust gone leathery two inches from his ear with its empty place unnamed and no third, the drool thread frozen and unwiped, cold stopped at cheek, temple and the bare wrist joint, and the afterdrop waiting on a warming nobody would perform, while Sella Vail gave the instruction to the wool, the fire, the pot, the broom and the running water and never the basket, said the house, kept her half-pace, glanced once at the clay jar cold under its glaze without touching it, fed him gruel from the house’s own dish with the spoon on her sleeve, pushed coal-black hair back with the burn-wrist so the grey streak showed pale, set the pot handle two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat at the setting, counted under her breath toward no opening and left the widow’s mark untouched, for a morning and a shelf are not openings and there had been none since before the kiln on Ember 1 (T058/T079); a neighbour at the threshold with dry mud-scurf on her hem asked what the firing would want now the second reading stood a day off and was sent to the pot and the weather with nothing priced, refused or entered, and the sweet edge of lead glaze came up off High Kiln on a wrong wind and went out on the same wind as a direction answered with the pot and the weather, no sickness named in Grathic, no collector called and no lesson made (T077, T064 held); the yard went around the pan’s gone round ring, the bare dark trough, the rack space with its broken birth-slates, the field’s empty place and the place the carriers crossed with a look and a wide step and no number, the arm carrying him keeping the height of the handle, the give of the shoulder and the turn of the wrist at a step’s end, a record in muscle that remembered weight and not cost (T009/T013/T092, T098); at the kindling Tarn took the broom only after it had been instructed, six counted in the worn thumb-mark and the seventh at the lip beside Garl’s unforged collector sentence, brought the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stopped, kept the Seed 16 breath unspent and the nine stoppings nine with no tenth before the seventh year was earned, his stroke going over the flagstones past the bright patch without the half-check and over the collector road without turning, no collector coming (T036/T076); Jorra kept dusty and clean forearms on one tray, parted dust from slip, told wheel and pot their sayings, withheld the note he knew three turns ahead from a man on a wrong wind, and held his bent finger in the cold damper until Sella’s sentence reached the pot, a remembered repetition, with he’s not Vail sealed and the promise ungiven (T035/T031/T062, T065/T095); in the small hours the file came back exact, complete and worth nothing, six hearings beside and never among with no seventh, three near-full answers advanced, the told bell beside the heard and the told figure beside the paid, three held changes on three places, the loft scrape on a fourth, the pale line on a fifth and the held inch on a sixth, the stone cold in its loft pot, the charcoal unread, the cost of the carried man entered nowhere, and one hundred and ninety-eight standing exact in the wool while the market stood a day off and did not get to read the inch (T061/T082, T006, T064, T060/T086/T097, T100, T004).}
\CRday{Day 199}{Ember 20, Y.H. 813 (Tenthday, the second Account-day and market-day of Ember)  —  the Cross, the reading block, the moot-post’s finger’s width of shade, the pot board and stalls, the out-of-line landing below the north bridge, the clay road, the Vail kiln-house roof at the hearth, loaf shelf, kindling and bed, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  The kiln month’s second Account-day and market came up over the Cross with the boy one hundred and ninety-nine days old and six months and nineteen days and nobody saying so, Tallow still the firing month and Ember the kiln month and neither corrected, the carried fire’s payer unnamed for a hundred and ninety-nine days and river, fire and boards keeping three counts in three places that did not become one (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082); Sella Vail set the basket in the moot-post’s finger’s width of shade where no slate lay, stood half a pace off, gave the instruction to the wool and the river wind and never the basket, kept her hand from the mark because a reading was not an opening, and did not look into the basket (T058/T079); two hundred leaned to the reading block and eight pigs went over the wet boards while the bell went four, four and a gap with nobody crossing himself, the heard kept beside the told (T078); \textbf{the chapter’s one meaningful change:} Berr Clay came up short off the clay road with the red wool cord of his office folded square under his coat and the green of tasted lead glaze at one mouth-corner, wiped his thumb twice before touching nothing, held a narrow slate unopened to his forearm, passed a finger over the figure, read One in twelve, as the notice says low into the top of the crowd --- the figure going twice over the basket, once for the moot and once for the households that came late --- said The levy is called. It is not called by me and your house, never I, and went off toward High Kiln with the box locked and the true subtraction inside, believing he had done a kindness, so that the district’s arithmetic for the kiln month changed for the second time and could not be changed back, the printed figure standing unchallenged and a figure read aloud still not the figure paid (T015/T041/T047/T077); the reading did not answer the man carried out of High Kiln breathing while the month was young --- no figure, collector or slate knew what he cost, no cause was named in Grathic and his pale line stayed on its own place, a breath kept not an ending and no offstage fate invented (T064 held); Hessa Rale carried the slate up the road before noon edge-on to her forearm with the writing to her sleeve, telling the women who asked I don’t read it. I carry it. There’s a difference, and the road doesn’t care which and Cross to Greybank. Reading goes up before noon. I’ve got a road to walk, her hand to the slate before her eyes to the yard, the eighth record-first hand joined to none and no figure coming off the slate (T080); below the north bridge the soft-cuffed clerk stayed set at the out-of-line landing for a measure nobody called, cuff grey from washing and grey again by midday, hand to slate before eyes to stalls and a buyer’s number entered before he looked up to find the man who had said it, the market selling over him as water over a stone (T090); across the square a silent woman with clay under her nails, a pale line across the back of one hand and green in the crease beside her lip turned a cup a quarter and went off with the light, the sixth green a colour joined to no ear and never Fenna in narration (T050/T051 held), and at the market’s edge a small shape in cast-offs with silt dried pale in its wrist creases, a gap where a front tooth had been and a green sliver on a string at its throat stopped its half-beat toward a pot and rubbed the sliver, unnamed, silent, no loaf, slate or sale and not a seventh sighting (T033/T034 held); Berr’s twice-wiped thumb, Hessa’s hand to the slate and the clerk’s hand to his slate lay on places of their own, two inward records still two inward records, and a row of such hands would call itself an account (T080/T090); carried home at the going of the light with woodsmoke before and river wind behind, Sella went wide around the pan’s gone ring, the bare trough, the rack space, the field’s empty place and the place the carriers crossed, a neighbour’s cost-question going to the pot and the weather and away level (T009/T013/T092, T098, T077); under the roof the figure had not crossed the wall, and in the small hours the hand outside the wool went up an inch and came down at once with no holding in it, the asking not always answered, the miss filed on the sixth place beside the holdings, not a hearing, seventh, stopping, payment, key, power or rule, with one hundred and ninety-nine exact and unspent in the wool and the market’s figure not entered anywhere under the roof (T061/T082).}
\CRday{Day 200}{Ember 21, Y.H. 813 (Firstday)  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, hearth, kiln mouth, loaf shelf’s low angle and kindling, the Clay Yard, the yard well and the trough, the drying racks and the space beneath the lowest rack, the wall where the shallow pan stood, the field’s empty place, the place the carriers crossed, the wheel-shed edge and its finger’s-width-open back room (not entered), the cold damper, the flagstones, the Debt Loft (heard only), the clay road at the going of the light, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  The kiln month’s last working week opened as an ordinary morning with no boundary drawn, the boy two hundred days old and six months and twenty days and nobody saying so, the carried fire’s payer unnamed for two hundred days and the river’s fifth note, the kiln’s four-and-a-gap and the boards’ four nails, four and a thumb-width knot keeping three counts in three places that did not become one (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082); hot clay came under tallow and wet wool with the sour corner breath, the crust leathery two inches from his ear, the thread frozen and unwiped, cold stopped at cheek, temple and the bare wrist joint, and Sella Vail gave the instruction to the wool, fire, pot, broom, running water and river wind and never the basket, fed him from the house’s own dish with the spoon on her sleeve, pushed coal-black hair back with the burn-wrist so the grey streak showed pale, set the pot handle two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat at the setting, counted under her breath toward no opening, kept her finger from beneath the shelf so the charcoal stayed unread and left the widow’s mark untouched, for a morning and a shelf are not openings (T058/T079, T100); at the well a rack woman with slip dried pale in her wrists asked what the pots would want before the kiln month was out and a man come off the clay road asked what the kiln would want now the figure had gone up twice, and both were sent to the pot, the house and the weather with nothing priced, refused or entered, while the sweet edge of lead glaze came up off High Kiln on a wrong wind and went out on the same wind as a direction, no sickness named in Grathic, no collector called and no second edge paid so soon after the carrying-out (T077, T064 held); the yard went around the clean dark line and the finer grey called the thaw, the birth-slates beneath the lowest rack, the pan’s gone round ring, the bare dark trough, the field’s empty place and the place the carriers crossed with a look and a wide step and no number, no third gap and no fourth likeness made a cause and no finger of his drawing the line (T009/T013/T092, T098, T060/T086/T097); before first grey three or four unnamed men went low into the back room and got no name, the two shut-room tellings staying two (T035/T031, T065/T095); Jorra parted dust from slip as a surgeon parts clot from vessel, kept dusty and clean forearms on one tray, told wheel and pot their sayings, withheld the note known three turns ahead from a man on a wrong wind whose saying stayed a saying about a pot, and held his bent finger in the cold damper until Sella’s sentence reached the pot, a remembered repetition not a change made again, with he’s not Vail sealed and the promise ungiven (T035/T031/T062), while Tarn took the broom only after instruction, told the kindling Six counted. The next I don’t count, brought the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stopped, kept the nine stoppings nine with no tenth before the seventh year was earned, the Seed 16 breath unspent and the loan uncalled, his stroke over the flagstones past the bright patch without the half-check and over the collector road without turning, no collector coming (T036/T076); in the morning the hand outside the wool went up an inch and held for the length of the small intake only, coming down before the letting go, and in the small hours it went up again and stayed through the whole of one of the breaths Sella counted at her fire in the room that does not touch his, through the small intake and the hold and on into the letting go, coming down with the breath rather than before it --- a coordination with a rhythm he could not enter, not a greater reach, not a stronger hand and not a power, filed on its sixth place beside the others and never laid across them, with no payer named (T061/T082); the file came back exact, complete and worth nothing, six hearings with no seventh, three near-full answers, the told bell beside the heard and the told figure beside the paid, three held changes on three places, the loft scrape on a fourth, the pale line on a fifth and the held inch on a sixth, the stone cold in its loft pot, the charcoal unread, the cost of the carried man entered nowhere, and two hundred standing exact and unspent in the wool while the river, the fire and the boards kept three counts in three places that did not become one and the count went forward into Day 201 (T006, T064, T100, T004).}
\CRday{Day 201}{Ember 22, Y.H. 813 (Secondday)  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, hearth and loaf shelf’s low angle, the Clay Yard, the yard well, the drying racks, the kindling, the flagstones, the wheel-shed edge and its finger’s-width-open back room (not entered), the Debt Loft (heard only), the clay road at the going of the light, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  The kiln month’s last tend opened as an ordinary morning with no boundary drawn under anything, the boy two hundred and one days old and six months and twenty-one days and nobody under any roof saying so, the first smell hot clay under tallow and wet wool with the sour Ash breath of the unswept corner and the first sound the kiln drawing in fours with a gap rather than a bell, the carried fire missing its fifth with its payer unnamed for two hundred and one days while the river’s fifth low note and the boards’ four nails, four and a thumb-width knot kept three counts in three places that did not become one (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082); the one leathery crust lay two inches from his ear with its empty place unnamed and no third, the drool thread frozen and unwiped, cold stopped at cheek, temple and the bare wrist joint with the afterdrop waiting on a warming nobody would perform, while Sella Vail gave the instruction to the wool, fire, pot, broom, running water and river wind and never the basket, said the house, kept her half-pace, glanced once at the clay jar without touching it, fed him from the house’s own dish with the spoon on her sleeve, set the pot handle two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat at the setting, moved her lips along a two-gapped row without a figure, kept her finger from beneath the charcoal and left the widow’s mark untouched, for a morning and a shelf are not openings and there had been none since before the kiln on Ember 1 (T058/T079, T100); a neighbour at the threshold with dry mud-scurf on her hem asked what the firing would want now the last tend was in and was told to ask the pot and the weather, going away level with nothing priced, refused or entered (T077), while three or four men went low into the back room before first grey and got no name and the two tellings of the shut counting room stayed two with no third (T035/T031/T065/T095); then the hand outside the wool went up an inch toward the note of water over water and came down at once in the morning, and in the small hours went up and held for the length of the small intake only, coming down before the letting go, each answer filed on its sixth place beside the others as not a hearing, seventh, stopping, payment, change, key, power or rule with no payer named, and two hundred and one stood exact in the wool, complete and unspent, spoken by nobody, as the count went forward into Day 202 (T061/T082).}
\CRday{Day 202}{Ember 23, Y.H. 813 (Thirdday)  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, hearth and loaf shelf’s low angle, the Clay Yard, the yard well, the trough, the drying racks, the kindling, the flagstones, the wheel-shed edge, the back room (not entered) and the Debt Loft (heard only), the clay road at the going of the light, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  The last working week went on into its third day without a boundary drawn, the boy two hundred and two days old and six months and twenty-two days and nobody saying so, the carried fire’s payer unnamed for two hundred and two days and the fire, river and boards keeping three counts that did not become one (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082); the sweet edge of lead glaze came up off High Kiln on a wrong wind, touched the fold and went out on the same wind, read as a direction and entered nowhere, and the saying that a pot singing before its time generally sings itself out early stayed a saying about a pot and was not made true as a lesson (T064); Sella Vail gave the instruction to the wool, fire, pot, broom, running water and river wind and never the basket, said the house, kept her half-pace, glanced once at the clay jar without a touch, fed him from the house’s own dish with the spoon on her sleeve and his mouth unwiped, set the pot handle two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat at the setting, kept her finger from beneath the charcoal and left the widow’s mark untouched because a morning and a shelf are not openings (T058/T079, T100); at the yard well a rack woman with slip dried pale in the creases of her wrists asked what the pots would want before the kiln month was out and a man come off the clay road with a number shut in his fist asked what the kiln would want now the figure had gone up twice, and both were sent to the pot, the house and the weather, going away level with nothing priced, refused or entered while the number in the fist arrived nowhere (T077); the second reading of Ember stood offstage and unchallenged, the box gone up the locked road toward High Kiln with the true subtraction inside, the printed one in twelve still printed, a figure gone twice over the basket still not the figure paid, Hessa’s slate unread at Greybank with the writing to her sleeve and the soft-cuffed clerk still set at the out-of-line landing for a measure nobody called (T015/T041/T047, T080, T090 held); Tarn told the kindling six counted and the next he did not count with the knife at the sill’s edge and Garl’s unforged sentence beside it, brought the ear-sentence all the way to the word that would call the loan and stopped with no figure and no name, kept the Seed 16 breath unspent and nine stoppings with no tenth before the seventh year was earned, nearer its end than ever and not given, and swept the collector’s road without turning while no collector came (T036/T076), and Jorra parted dust from slip, withheld a note known three turns ahead from a man on a wrong wind whose saying cost no pot, and held his bent finger in the cold damper until the sentence reached the pot, remembered and not made again (T035/T031, T061/T082, T062); then the hand went up an inch and came down before the counted breath had finished in the morning, an inch let go early and no failure in it, and in the small hours went up, stayed through the small intake, the hold and the letting go of one of the breaths Sella counted at her fire in the room that did not touch his, and came down with the breath --- the old coordination remembered, not a change made again --- each answer filed on its sixth place and laid across nothing, and two hundred and two stood exact in the wool, complete and unspent, spoken by nobody (T061/T082).}
\CRday{Day 203}{Ember 24, Y.H. 813 (Fourthday)  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, hearth, loaf shelf’s low angle and kindling, the Clay Yard, the yard well and the trough, the drying racks, the flagstones, the wheel-shed edge, the finger’s-width-open back room (not entered), the cold damper, the Debt Loft (heard only), the clay road at the going of the light, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  The last tend ran on into its third working day with no boundary drawn and the seventh year standing nearer its end than ever at the lip of the knife’s sill with six counted where the house could check and the seventh where it could not, the boy two hundred and three days old and six months and twenty-three days and nobody saying so, the carried fire’s payer unnamed for two hundred and three days and the fire, river and boards keeping three counts that did not become one (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082, T036/T076); Sella Vail gave the instruction where it always went, to the wool, fire, pot, broom, running water and river wind and never the basket, said the house, kept her half-pace, glanced once at the clay jar without touching it, fed him from the house’s own dish with the spoon on her sleeve and his mouth unwiped, set the pot handle two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat at the setting, kept her finger from beneath the charcoal and left the widow’s mark untouched, for a morning and an afternoon are not openings and there had been none since before the kiln on Ember 1 (T058/T079, T100); a cost-question at the door went to the pot and the weather and away level with nothing entered (T077), neighbours wanting the thaw early and the late one were each answered Yes, house by Tarn, who went on wanting the late because it puts off the paying though the paying had stood in the ruts since the water went, brought the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stopped with no figure and no name, kept the Seed 16 breath unspent and nine stoppings with no tenth, and swept the collector’s road without turning while no collector came (T036/T076); three or four men went low into the back room before first grey and got no name, the two shut-room tellings staying two (T035/T031/T065/T095), and Jorra came through with fine grey slate dust ground small as meal past the bent finger, kept dusty and clean forearms on one tray, told a pot You’ll do, withheld its full note from a man on a wrong wind whose saying stayed a saying and whose pot was not lost, and held his bent finger in the cold damper until the sentence reached the pot, remembered and not made again (T061/T082, T062); in the morning the hand went up an inch and held for the length of the small intake only, coming down before the letting go, but in the small hours it went up and stayed through the small intake, the hold and the letting go of one of the breaths Sella counted at her fire in the room that did not touch his and \textbf{did not come down with her breath}, keeping the small height through the little silence after her count had ended and coming down on the river’s next low note --- a coordination with a second rhythm nobody counted and that was never given to him, not a longer reach, not a stronger hand, not a hearing since water over water remained a fifth low thing never counted among the hearings, not a seventh, stopping, payment, one of the three held changes, key, power or rule, with no payer named and nothing stood up out of it to call itself a sign (T061/T082, advanced and not paid); he still could not close the two inches to the pot handle, lift the crust two inches to his mouth or speak a number, the file stayed exact, complete and worth nothing, and two hundred and three stood exact in the dark, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody while the river went on without noticing that an inch had ridden one of its low notes and the count went forward into Day 204 (T006, T064, T100, T004).}
\CRday{Day 204}{Ember 25, Y.H. 813 (Fifthday)  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, hearth and loaf shelf’s low angle, the kindling, the Clay Yard, the yard well, the drying racks, the wheel-shed edge, the finger’s-width-open back room (not entered), the cold damper, the Debt Loft (heard only), the clay road at the going of the light, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  The kiln month’s last working week opened as an ordinary morning with no boundary drawn under the tend that had turned four days back, the boy two hundred and four days old and six months and twenty-four days and nobody under any roof saying so, the first smell hot clay under tallow and wet wool under that with the sour Ash breath of the unswept corner called the thaw and the first sound the kiln drawing in fours with a gap rather than a bell, the carried fire’s payer unnamed for two hundred and four days while the river’s fifth note of water over water and the boards’ four nails, four and a thumb-width knot kept three counts in three places that did not become one, for agreeing them would have wanted a payer and none stood to any (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082); one leathery brown-edged crust lay two inches from his ear with its empty place still unnamed and no third, the drool thread frozen and unwiped, cold stopped at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint with the afterdrop waiting on a warming nobody would perform, and the file turned out before the grey as instruments on a towel was exact, complete and worth nothing --- six hearings beside and never among with the sixth from a person and no seventh, three near-full answers advanced and unpaid, the told bell beside the heard and the told figure beside the paid, nine stoppings with no tenth before the seventh year was earned, three held changes on three places with the loft scrape on a fourth, the pale line on a fifth and the held inch on a sixth, the crust’s gap, the shelf’s two gaps, the pan’s gone ring and the field’s empty place on trays that did not touch (T060/T086/T097, T100, T006); the household kept Garl in objects and not in a story --- the salt coat holding a broader man’s shape on its peg, the seat keeping its twenty-year leftward hollow, the clean dark line and the finer grey called the thaw unswept, the proverb gone to the pot and the debt against a firing of tiles circled without a name, neither paid nor settled nor stopped nor called, no collector coming up the clay road (T009/T013/T092); Sella Vail gave the instruction to the wool, fire, pot, broom, running water and river wind and never the basket, said the house, kept her half-pace, glanced once at the clay jar and shut her hand half over nothing without a touch, pushed coal-black hair back with the burn-wrist so the grey streak showed pale, fed him from the house’s own dish with the spoon on her sleeve and his mouth unwiped, moved her lips along a two-gapped row without a figure, kept her finger from beneath the charcoal, told the fire it was the thaw, counted under her breath toward no opening and left the widow’s mark where it had hung since the first firing, touched once before the kiln on Ember 1 and at no hour since (T058/T079, T100); a neighbour’s cost-question about the firing went to the pot and the weather and away level with nothing priced, refused or entered (T077); at the kindling Tarn took the broom only after instruction, told the wood Six counted. The next I don’t count with six in the worn thumb-mark and the seventh at the lip beside Garl’s unforged collector sentence, brought the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stopped with no figure and no name, drew the Seed 16 breath and did not spend it, kept nine stoppings with no tenth, his stroke over the flagstones without the half-check and over the collector road without turning while no collector came (T036/T076); three or four unnamed men went low into the back room before first grey and got no name, the two shut-room tellings staying two, and Jorra came through with meal-fine grey slate dust past the bent finger, not bone-coloured slip, parted dust from slip as clot from vessel, told the wheel it cared only for steady hands and a pot it would do, withheld the note he knew three turns ahead from a man on a wrong wind whose saying about a pot singing early stayed a saying and cost no pot, held his bent finger in the cold damper until the sentence reached the pot as a remembered repetition, and kept he’s not Vail sealed with the promise of the boy’s name ungiven (T035/T031/T062, T064, T065/T095); asked in the morning the hand outside the wool went up an inch toward the river’s note and came down at once, the asking not always answered and the miss no failure, and in the small hours it went up and held for the small intake only, coming down before the letting go, each answer filed on the sixth place beside the others as not a hearing, seventh, stopping, payment, change, key, power or rule with no payer named, while he still could not close two inches, lift the crust or speak a number, and two hundred and four stood exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody as the count went forward into Day 205 (T061/T082).}
\CRday{Day 205}{Ember 26, Y.H. 813 (Sixthday)  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, hearth, loaf shelf’s low angle and kindling, the Clay Yard, the yard well and the bare trough, the drying racks, the wheel-shed edge, the finger’s-width-open back room (not entered), the cold damper, the Debt Loft (heard only), the clay road at the going of the light, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  The word of the burned slate was the day’s one change and it came up from Slate Row before the grey, spoken over the boards of the yard and not to the basket, a voice on the river wind saying that a slate had burned in the night and then going on to the price of barley and the weather, with no owner named, no room, no hand at the flame and no reason, and nobody in the yard turning it into a cause; the boy took it apart as a surgeon takes apart a wound and set it on a place of its own beside the dust off Jorra’s forearms and the two tellings of the shut counting room, with a hand between the three, a direction arriving from a place, passing over boards and arriving nowhere, not a hearing, seventh, stopping, payment, fourth likeness or third telling and not carried into any chart a clerk would keep, advanced and not paid (T035/T031, T065/T095); the boy came into his two hundred and fifth day and six months and twenty-five days with nobody saying so, the fire’s fifth without a payer for two hundred and five days and the river’s fifth note, the kiln’s four-and-a-gap and the boards’ four, four and a thumb-width knot keeping three counts in three places that did not become one (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082); hot clay came under tallow and wet wool with the sour corner breath, the crust leathery two inches from his ear with its empty place unnamed and no third, the thread frozen and unwiped, cold stopped at cheek, temple and the bare wrist joint, and the afterdrop waiting, while Sella Vail came to the fire before the basket, gave the instruction to the wool, fire, pot, broom, running water and river wind and never to the child, said the house, kept her half-pace, glanced once at the clay jar without a touch, pushed the coal-black hair back with the burn-wrist so the grey streak showed pale, fed him from her own dish with the spoon on her sleeve and his mouth unwiped, set the pot handle two inches beyond the hand with a half-beat at the setting and no look toward the bed, moved her lips along a two-gapped row without a figure, kept her finger from beneath the charcoal, counted under her breath toward no opening and left the widow’s mark untouched, for a word over the boards and a slate burning in another quarter were not openings and there had been none in twenty-five days (T058/T079, T100); Jorra came through with meal-fine grey dust under the bent finger, grew quieter by a degree when the word went around the boards so that the household straightened around the quiet without an order, gave the house no name for anything, parted dust from slip as clot from vessel, spoke to the wheel and a pot, withheld the full note known three turns ahead from a wrong wind whose saying stayed a saying and cost no pot, and held his bent finger in the cold damper until the sentence reached the pot, a remembered repetition, with the damper read as one iron with two bites and he’s not Vail sealed and the promise ungiven (T035/T031/T062); the sweet edge of lead glaze came up off High Kiln on that wrong wind, touched the fold and went out on the same wind, a second direction on the same day answered as a direction and entered nowhere, no second edge paid, no pot lost and no lesson stood up out of a breath of air (T064); at the yard well a rack woman with slip dried pale in her wrists and a man off the clay road with a number shut in his fist asked what the pots and the kiln would want with the last tend running, and both were sent to the pot, the house and the weather, going away level with nothing priced, refused or entered, the man’s number arriving nowhere, while the figure of the second reading stood offstage in Berr’s locked box with the true subtraction inside, Hessa’s slate unread at Greybank and the soft-cuffed clerk still set for his uncalled measure (T077, T015/T041/T047/T080/T090 held); three or four unnamed men went low into the back room before first grey and got no name, and Tarn kept six where the house could check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl’s unforged sentence, brought the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stopped, kept the Seed 16 breath unspent and nine stoppings with no tenth, and swept past the bright patch and the collector road without turning while no collector came (T036/T076); in the morning the hand went up an inch and held for the small intake only, coming down before the letting go, and in the small hours it stayed through the small intake, the hold and the letting go of a breath counted at Sella’s fire in the room that does not touch his and came down with the breath --- the old coordination remembered, not a change made again --- each answer filed on its sixth place and laid across nothing, while he still could not close two inches, lift the crust or speak a number and two hundred and five stood exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody as the count went forward into Day 206 (T061/T082).}
\CRday{Day 206}{Ember 27, Y.H. 813 (Seventhday)  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, hearth, loaf shelf’s low angle and kindling, the Clay Yard, the yard well, the drying racks, the flagstones, the wheel-shed edge, the finger’s-width-open back room (not entered), the cold damper, the Debt Loft (heard only), the clay road at the going of the light, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  The kiln month’s last working week ran into its third day with no boundary drawn and neither of the district’s two names for the months corrected, the boy two hundred and six days old and six months and twenty-six days and nobody saying so, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid for two hundred and six days and the river’s fifth note, the kiln’s four-and-a-gap and the boards’ four, four and a thumb-width knot keeping three counts in three places that did not become one (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082); the household kept Garl at its closest yet to the end of the tend and kept him in objects --- the salt-stiff coat with its left-shoulder crease, the seat with its twenty-year hollow, the clean dark line and the finer grey called the thaw gone around with a look and a wide step and neither swept, the proverb gone to the pot and the tile debt circled without a name, worse for being uncalled because it could be neither paid nor settled nor stopped, no collector called and no lesson made of any of it (T009/T013/T092); hot clay came under tallow and wet wool with the sour corner breath, the leathery crust stiff two inches from his ear with its empty place unnamed and no third, the thread frozen and unwiped, cold stopped at cheek, temple and the bare wrist joint, the afterdrop waiting, and his wanting to be told had gone so quiet he could no longer hear it asking though it was there all the same; Sella Vail came to the fire before the basket, told it the grey was the thaw, turned the coals with a broken pot, stood with the back of the pot counting under her breath toward no opening, said The house will keep it where another woman would say I, pushed coal-black hair back with the burn-wrist so the grey streak showed pale, glanced once at the clay jar and shut her hand half over nothing, moved her lips along a two-gapped row without a figure, kept her finger from beneath the charcoal, fed him from the house’s own dish with the spoon on her sleeve and his mouth unwiped, set the pot handle two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat at the setting and no look toward the bed, and left the widow’s mark where it had hung since the first firing, touched once before the kiln on Ember 1 and at no hour since --- no opening in twenty-six days (T058/T079, T100); a neighbour with dry scurf on her hem and a pot against her hip asked what the last of the kiln month would want before the account was read and was sent to the pot and the weather, going away level with nothing priced, refused or entered (T077); the sweet edge of lead glaze came up off High Kiln on a wrong wind, touched the fold and went out on the same wind, answered as a direction and entered nowhere, and the saying about a pot singing early stayed a saying and cost no pot (T064); Jorra came through with meal-fine grey dust past the bent finger, parted dust from slip as clot from vessel, quieter since the burned-slate word, told the wheel and a pot their sayings, withheld the note from the wrong wind, held his bent finger in the cold damper until the sentence reached the pot as a remembered repetition, read the iron as one piece with two bites with no Grathic word for both, and kept he’s not Vail sealed with the promise of the boy’s name ungiven, while the burned-slate word still went around the boards touching everything and belonging to nothing, nobody saying whose slate or which room or why, and the boy keeping it on its own place beside the dust and the two tellings with a hand between the three (T035/T031/T062, T065/T095); three or four unnamed men went low into the back room before first grey and got no name, and Tarn kept six counted where the house could check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl’s unforged sentence, brought the ear-sentence all the way to the word that would call the loan and stopped with no figure and no name, drew the Seed 16 breath and did not spend it, kept nine stoppings with no tenth, the seventh nearer its end than ever and not given, his stroke over the bright patch and the collector road without the half-check or a turn while no collector came (T036/T076); in the morning the hand went up an inch and came down before the counted breath had finished, an inch let go early and no failure in it, but in the small hours, with Sella gone to her own bed and no count at her fire in the room that does not touch his to hold against, it went up an inch toward the note of water over water through the finger’s-width door and stayed up for the length of the river’s own low interval, the note drawing out and slackening, and came down on the next low note when the river gave it --- a coordination with the one rhythm through the door, not willed against another count and not a gain in strength, filed on the sixth place beside the others as not a longer reach, not a stronger hand, not a hearing since water over water remained a fifth low thing never counted among the hearings, not a seventh, stopping, payment, one of the three held changes, key, power or rule, with no payer named and no sign stood up (T061/T082 advanced and not paid); the file turned out at the close was exact, complete and worth nothing, six hearings with the sixth from a person and no seventh, three near-full answers unpaid, the told bell beside the heard and the told figure beside the paid, the three held changes and the loft scrape and pale line, nine stoppings with no tenth, the absences on trays that did not touch, the carried man’s cost entered nowhere and the sixth green a colour and the foundling a shape, and he still could not close two inches, lift the crust or speak a number while two hundred and six stood exact in the dark, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody and the river went on over water without noticing that an inch had ridden one of its low notes, the count going forward into Day 207 (T006, T064, T100, T004).}
\CRday{Day 207}{Ember 28, Y.H. 813 (Eighthday)  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, hearth, loaf shelf’s low angle and kindling, the Clay Yard, the yard well, the drying racks, the wheel-shed edge, the finger’s-width-open back room (not entered), the cold damper, the Debt Loft (heard only), the clay road at the going of the light, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  The kiln month’s last working week ran on into its eighth morning with no boundary drawn at the turning of the tend and neither month-name corrected, the boy two hundred and seven days old and six months and twenty-seven days and nobody under any roof saying so, the carried fire’s fifth without a payer for two hundred and seven days while the river’s note of water over water, the kiln’s four-and-a-gap and the boards’ four nails, four and a thumb-width knot kept three counts in three places that did not become one, for agreeing them would have wanted a payer and none stood to any (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082); the leathery brown-edged crust lay two inches from his ear with its empty place unnamed and no third, the drool thread frozen and unwiped, cold stopped at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint with the afterdrop waiting on a warming nobody would perform, and the file turned out before the grey as instruments on a towel was exact, complete and worth nothing --- six hearings beside and never among with the sixth from a person and no seventh, three near-full answers advanced and unpaid, the told bell beside the heard and the told figure beside the paid, nine stoppings with no tenth before the seventh year was earned, three held changes on three places with the loft scrape on a fourth, the pale line on a fifth and the held inch on a sixth, and the burned-slate word on its own place beside Jorra’s dust and the two shut-room tellings with a hand between the three (T061/T082, T100); Sella Vail came to the fire before the basket and gave the instruction to the wool, the fire, the pot, the broom, the running water and the river wind and never to the basket, said the house, kept the half-pace, moved her lips along a two-gapped row without a figure, glanced once at the clay jar and shut her hand half over nothing without a touch, kept her finger on top of the shelf’s front edge so the charcoal stayed unread, told the fire it was the thaw, turned the coals with the back of a broken pot, said The house will keep it, counted under her breath toward no opening, pushed coal-black hair back with the burn-wrist so the grey streak showed pale, set the pot rim out two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat at the setting and did not look toward the bed, leaving the widow’s mark untouched with no opening in twenty-seven days (T058/T079); a neighbour’s cost-question about the firing was sent to the pot and the weather and went away level with nothing priced, refused or entered (T077); at the kindling Tarn told the wood Six counted. The next I don’t count, said Yes, house to an early thaw and a late while wanting the late because it puts off the paying, brought the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stopped with no figure and no name, kept the Seed 16 breath unspent, nine stoppings standing with no tenth and the collector road unswept, no collector coming (T036/T076); Jorra Vail came through with meal-fine grey dust parted from slip, spoke to the wheel before anyone (It doesn’t care whose hands. It cares if they’re steady), told a pot You’ll do, withheld its full note from a man on a wrong wind whose saying stayed a saying and cost no pot, and held his bent finger in the cold damper until Sella’s sentence reached the pot, a remembered holding and not a change made again (T035/T031/T062); the burned-slate word went over the boards and arrived nowhere, and the hand outside the wool went up an inch toward the river’s note and came down before the counted breath had finished, a miss filed on its sixth place with no payer named (T061/T082); Garl was kept in objects to the last working week’s end --- the salt coat’s broader shape, the seat’s hollow, the unswept line and finer grey, the proverb gone to the pot and the tile debt circled without a name, no lesson made, no collector called and his name unspoken for two hundred and seven days (T009/T013/T092).}
\CRday{Day 208}{Ember 29, Y.H. 813 (Ninthday)  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, hearth, loaf shelf’s low angle and kindling, the Clay Yard, the yard well and the bare trough, the drying racks, the flagstones, the wheel-shed edge, the finger’s-width-open back room (not entered), the cold damper, the Debt Loft (heard only), the clay road’s edge, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  A second day of directions came over the boards with no boundary drawn, the boy two hundred and eight days old and six months and twenty-eight days and nobody saying so, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid for two hundred and eight days and the river’s fifth note, the kiln’s four-and-a-gap and the boards’ four, four and a thumb-width knot keeping three counts in three places that did not become one (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082); the burned-slate word went around the boards a second time, spoken over them and not to the basket, with no owner, room, hand at the flame or reason and the voice going on to the price of barley and the weather, and the boy took it apart as a surgeon takes apart a wound and filed it again on its own place beside Jorra’s dust and the two shut-room tellings with a hand between the three --- a second telling of a direction, still not a third telling of the shut counting room, not a cause and nothing a clerk could chart (T035/T031/T065/T095); Jorra Vail came through with meal-fine grey dust ground small as meal past the bent finger and white in the creases of a fist, parted dust from slip, spoke to the wheel (It doesn’t care whose hands. It cares if they’re steady), told a pot You’ll do, knew its full note three turns before it left the wheel and withheld it from a man come up on a wrong wind whose saying that a pot singing before its time generally sings itself out early stayed a saying about a pot with no pot lost and no lesson made (T061/T082); the sweet edge of lead glaze came up off High Kiln on that wrong wind, touched the fold and went out on the wind that brought it, answered as a direction and entered nowhere with no second edge paid, no cause named in Grathic and no collector called (T064 held); at the yard well a rack woman with slip dried pale in her wrists asked what the pots would want before the last market and a man off the clay road kept his number shut in his fist and paid nothing, both sent to the pot and the weather so nothing was slopped, priced, refused or entered, while the printed one in twelve stood unchallenged and the true subtraction stayed out of reach in Berr Clay’s locked box up the road, and the boy sorted the yard in ninety seconds with a competence intact and useless because there was no hand in the basket to carry any of it to a slate (T077, T015/T041/T047 held); Sella Vail gave the instruction to the wool, fire, pot, broom, running water and river wind and never to the basket, said the house, kept the half-pace from open slates, moved her lips along a two-gapped row without a figure, kept her finger from beneath the charcoal, glanced once at the clay jar and shut her hand half over nothing, told the fire it was the thaw, turned the coals with a broken pot, said The house will keep it, counted under her breath toward no opening, pushed coal-black hair back with the burn-wrist so the grey streak showed pale, set the pot rim out two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat at the setting and did not look toward the bed, the widow’s mark untouched with no opening in twenty-eight days (T058/T079, T100); at the kindling Tarn told the wood Six counted. The next I don’t count, said Yes, house to an early thaw and a late while going on wanting the late because it puts off the paying, brought the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stopped, kept nine stoppings with no tenth before the seventh year was earned, the Seed 16 breath unspent and the loan uncalled, and swept past the bright patch and the collector road without turning, no collector coming (T036/T076); three or four unnamed men went low into the back room before first grey and Jorra gave them no name; in the morning the hand went up an inch toward the river’s note and came down at once before the small intake had finished, an honest miss, and in the small hours it stayed through the small intake, the hold and the letting go of one of the breaths Sella counted at her fire in the room that does not touch his and came down with the breath --- the old coordination remembered, not a change made again --- each answer filed on its sixth place with no payer named and nothing standing up to call itself a hearing, seventh, stopping, payment, key, power or rule (T061/T082).}
