\CRday{Day 209}{Ember 30, Y.H. 813 (Tenthday, the third Account-day and last market of Ember)  —  the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, hearth, loaf shelf’s low angle and kindling, the Clay Yard, the drying racks, the yard well, the flagstones, the wheel-shed edge, the back room (not entered), the cold damper, the Debt Loft (heard only), the clay road, the Cross, the reading block and the moot-post’s finger’s width of shade, the pot board and stalls, the Fishstairs and out-of-line landing below the north bridge, High Kiln, Greybank, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  The kiln month’s third and last Account-day and last market came up over the Cross with the boy two hundred and nine days old and six months and twenty-nine days and nobody under any roof saying so, no slate in Sarn with a place to enter it, the carried fire’s fifth without a payer for two hundred and nine days and the river’s fifth low note, the kiln’s four-and-a-gap and the boards’ four, four and a thumb-width knot keeping three counts in three places that did not become one (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082); Sella Vail carried him down the clay road at the half-pace in the morning with woodsmoke before her and river wind behind, kept the half-pace from every open slate, gave the instruction to the wool and the river wind and never to the basket, and set him in the moot-post’s finger’s width of shade where no slate lay with the cold iron at his cheek, standing half a pace off and saying nothing of the square or the thane’s low voice (T058/T079); two hundred leaned to the reading block while eight pigs went over the wet boards with a man and a slate following every pig, and the bell went four, four and a gap with nobody crossing himself, the heard bell kept beside the told from the Long Night (T078); the chapter’s one true change: Berr Clay came up short off the clay road a little before the top of the morning with the red wool cord of his office folded square under his coat and the green of tasted lead glaze at one corner of his mouth, wiped his thumb twice before touching nothing, held a narrow slate unopened to his forearm, passed a finger over the figure and read One in twelve, as the notice says low into the top of the crowd --- the figure going twice over the basket, once for the moot and once for the households that come late --- said The levy is called. It is not called by me and your house, never I, taking himself out of his own sentence as a surgeon takes his hand out of a field before the dressing goes on, and went off toward High Kiln with the box locked and the true subtraction inside, believing he had done a kindness, so that the district’s arithmetic changed for the third time in the kiln month where two hundred people stood and could not be changed back, the printed figure standing unchallenged and a figure read aloud still not the figure paid (T015/T041/T047/T077); Berr’s twice-wiped thumb joined the record-first hands on the widened tray --- the midwife’s reach for a slate before the child, the thane’s finger over the figure, the clerk’s number before the eyes found the man, the wheel-keeper’s word to the wheel, Sella’s finger on the shelf’s front edge, Hessa’s hand to her slate and the soft-cuffed clerk’s inward reaching, eight hands going to the record before the person and held apart by hand because a row of eight standing long enough will call itself an account and an account wants a payer, and none stands; Hessa Rale took the slate up the road toward Greybank before noon edge-on to her forearm with the writing to her sleeve, her hand arriving before her eyes took the crowd, telling the women who asked what she carried I don’t read it. I carry it. There’s a difference, and the road doesn’t care which and Cross to Greybank. Reading goes up before noon. I’ve got a road to walk, answering the question put and not the one behind it, a runner and not a reader with no figure coming off the slate, her reaching filed as the eighth record-first hand, advanced and not paid (T080); below the north bridge at the Fishstairs on the out-of-line landing where a fifth step should have stood the soft-cuffed clerk stayed set for a measure nobody called, cuff grey from washing and grey again by midday, hand to slate before eyes to stalls, nobody stepping around him or taking him off, the market selling over him as water goes over a stone (T090); the reading answered nothing for the glaze-room hand carried out on Day 188 --- no figure, collector, slate, name, cause or offstage death --- and the pale line stayed on its own place; at the pot board the sixth green stayed a colour, turned a cup a quarter and set it back, and at the market’s edge the foundling stayed a shape with a green sliver going dull and a thumb rubbed to it, no seventh of either coming to Ember’s last market and neither named as Fenna or Ulda in the narration (T050/T051, T033/T034 held); the crowd leaned and straightened and went back to its pots and pigs, and the red wool cord went up the clay road folded square under Berr’s coat with the box locked and the true subtraction inside; at the going of the light Sella carried him home around the pan’s gone ring, the bare dark trough, the broken birth-slates, the field’s empty place and the place the carriers crossed, each with a look and a wide step and no number, and set him on his bed under the roof and not in the Debt Loft, fold right and thread frozen (T009/T013/T092/T098); in the small hours he turned out the file as instruments on a towel and found it exact, complete and worth nothing, six hearings beside and never among with the sixth from a person and no seventh, three near-full answers advanced and unpaid, the told bell beside the heard, the told figure beside the paid, nine stoppings with no tenth, three held changes on three places with the loft scrape on a fourth, the pale line on a fifth and the held inch on a sixth, the burned-slate word on its own place and no third gap, no fourth likeness made a cause and no finger drawn across them (T061/T082, T100, T060/T086/T097); then, with Sella gone to her bed and no breathing number anywhere in the house, under the very conditions that had given the one-rhythm holding on Day 206, the hand went up an inch toward the river’s note and came down at once against the fold --- a miss, the asking not always answered and no failure in the miss --- filed on its sixth place with no payer named and nothing standing up to call itself a reach, hearing, seventh, stopping, payment, held change, key, power or rule (T061/T082); he could not close two inches to the pot handle, lift his chin two inches to the crust or speak a number anybody would believe, and Ember went out without a boundary drawn, two hundred and nine standing exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody, the fire’s fifth unpaid for two hundred and nine days and the count standing ready to go forward into a day nobody under the roof had named.}
\CRday{Day 210}{Grain 1, Y.H. 813 (Firstday)  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, hearth, loaf shelf’s low angle and kindling, the Clay Yard, the drying racks, the yard well, the bare trough, the wheel-shed edge, the finger’s-width-open back room (not entered), the cold damper, the Debt Loft (heard only), the flagstones, the clay road at the going of the light, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  Ember gave way to Grain in the dark without a boundary drawn and neither of the district’s two month-names was corrected, the boy two hundred and ten days old and six months and thirty days with no slate in Sarn to enter it, the fire’s fifth unpaid for two hundred and ten days while the river’s fifth low note and the boards’ four nails, four and a thumb-width knot kept three counts in three places that did not become one, for agreeing them would have wanted a payer and none stood to any (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082); the file turned out before the grey as instruments on a towel was exact, complete and worth nothing --- six hearings beside and never among with the sixth from a person and no seventh, three near-full answers advanced and unpaid, the told bell beside the heard, the told figure beside the paid with Ember’s third true subtraction gone up the clay road in Berr’s locked box, nine stoppings with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end and still ungiven, three held changes on three places with the loft scrape on a fourth, the pale line on a fifth and the held inch on a sixth, the burned-slate word on its own place beside Jorra’s dust and the two shut-room tellings with a hand between the three, and the crust’s gap, the shelf’s two gaps, the pan’s gone ring and the field’s empty place on trays that did not touch (T061/T082, T100); Sella Vail came to the fire before the basket, gave the instruction to the wool, fire, pot, broom, running water and river wind and never the basket, said the house, moved her lips along a two-gapped loaf row with no figure, kept her finger on top of the shelf’s front edge so the charcoal stayed unread, glanced once at the clay jar cold under its glaze and shut her hand half over nothing without a touch, told the fire it was the thaw, turned the coals with a broken pot, said The house will keep it, counted under her breath toward no opening, pushed coal-black hair back with the burn-wrist so the grey streak showed pale, set the pot handle two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat at the setting and no look toward the bed, and left the widow’s mark untouched with no opening in thirty days (T058/T079, T100); a neighbour’s cost-question about the new month’s firing went to the pot and the weather and away level with nothing priced, refused or entered (T077); Tarn told the wood Six counted. The next I don’t count with the knife at the sill’s edge and Garl’s unforged collector sentence beside it, brought the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stopped with no figure and no name, kept the Seed 16 breath unspent and nine stoppings with no tenth, swept past the bright patch without the half-check and over the collector’s road without a turn, and no collector came up or went down the clay road (T036/T076); Jorra Vail came through with meal-fine grey slate dust ground small as meal, parted dust from slip as clot from vessel, kept dusty and clean forearms on one tray, spoke to the wheel and told a pot You’ll do, withheld its full note from a man come up on a wrong wind whose saying about a pot singing early stayed a saying and cost no pot, named no man who went low into the back room before first grey, joined nothing to the two shut-room tellings, and held his bent finger in the cold damper until Sella’s sentence reached the pot as a remembered repetition (T035/T031/T062/T065/T095); the household kept Garl in objects at the turning --- the salt coat, the hollow seat, the unswept line and finer grey called the thaw, the proverb gone to the pot and the tile debt circled without a name --- with no lesson, no collector and his name unspoken for two hundred and ten days (T009/T013/T092); asked in the morning the hand went up an inch toward the river’s note and came down before the counted breath had finished, filed on the sixth place with no payer named and nothing standing up as a power, and in the small hours it held for the small intake only and came down before the letting go (T061/T082).}
\CRday{Day 211}{Grain 2, Y.H. 813 (Secondday)  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, hearth, loaf shelf’s low angle and kindling, the Clay Yard, the kiln mouth, the drying racks, the lowest rack and its broken birth-slates, the pan’s gone round ring, the yard well, the bare trough, the flagstones, the wheel-shed edge, the finger’s-width-open back room (not entered), the cold damper, the Debt Loft (heard only), the clay road at the going of the light, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  The firing thinned into the ordinary tending of a year begun without a boundary drawn, so gradual that a man come into the yard at first grey would have said the kiln month had never been a month but one long morning’s work, the boy two hundred and eleven days old and six months and thirty-one days with no slate in Sarn, Sill or Grath to enter either number, the carried fire’s fifth without a payer for two hundred and eleven days and the river, the boards and the fire keeping three counts that did not become one (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082); the yard went around the clean dark line where Ash had turned the corner, the new finer hairline called the thaw, the space beneath the lowest rack with its broken birth-slates, the circle the shallow clay pan had left, the bare dark trough whose water was called weather, the field’s empty place and the place the carriers crossed, each with a look and a wide step and no number, the house keeping its arithmetic in loaves, glances and the space where a thing had stood (T009/T013/T092, T097/T098 carried); at the yard well a rack woman with slip dried pale in the creases of her wrists asked what the new month’s pots would want now the firing was done and was sent to the pot and the weather with nothing priced, refused or entered, while a man come off the clay road kept a number shut in his fist, went off up the road with his arithmetic still his own and paid nothing, two directions coming over the boards in one morning and neither landing (T077, T058/T079); Berr Clay’s box stayed locked going toward High Kiln with Ember’s third true subtraction inside, the printed one in twelve stood unchallenged, Hessa Rale’s slate lay unread at Greybank with the writing to her sleeve, and the soft-cuffed clerk stayed set at the out-of-line landing below the north bridge for a measure nobody called, all held offstage in the file, none opened and none reaching back (T015/T041/T047, T080, T090 held); Sella Vail came to the fire before the basket, gave the instruction to the wool, fire, pot, broom, running water and river wind and never the basket, said the house, kept her half-pace and went wide around the pan’s gone ring, moved her lips along a two-gapped row with no figure, kept her finger on top of the shelf’s front edge, glanced once at the clay jar and shut her hand half over nothing, told the fire it was the thaw, turned the coals with a broken pot, said The house will keep it, counted under her breath toward no opening, pushed coal-black hair back with the burn-wrist so the grey streak showed pale, set the pot handle two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, and left the widow’s mark untouched because a morning shelf and a well are not openings, no opening in thirty-one days (T058/T079, T100); Tarn at the kindling told the wood Six counted. The next I don’t count with the knife at the sill’s lip, said Yes, house to an early thaw and a late while wanting the late because it puts off the paying, brought the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stopped with no figure and no name, kept the Seed 16 breath unspent and nine stoppings with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, swept over the flagstones past the bright patch without the half-check and over the collector’s road without a turn, and no collector came (T036/T076); Jorra Vail came through with meal-fine grey slate dust, kept dusty and clean forearms on one tray, told a pot You’ll do, withheld its knowing from a wrong-wind man whose saying stayed a saying, gave no name to the men who went low into the back room before first grey, kept the burned-slate word on its own place beside the dust and the two tellings with a hand between, and held his bent finger in the cold damper until Sella’s sentence reached the pot (T035/T031/T062/T065/T095); Sella carried him home at the going of the light around the absences with a look and a wide step and no number, set him on his bed and not in the Debt Loft, put the fold right without a look at his face and left the thread frozen; asked in the morning the hand went up an inch toward the note and came down at once against the fold, an honest miss with no failure in it, and in the small hours it stayed for the river’s own low interval, the draw, the slack and the small pause, and came down on the river’s next low note, the one-rhythm coordination remembered and not a change made again, filed on the sixth place with no payer and nothing standing up as a power (T061/T082).}
\CRday{Day 212}{Grain 3, Y.H. 813 (Thirdday)  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, hearth, loaf shelf’s low angle and kindling, the Clay Yard, the kiln mouth, the drying racks, the lowest rack, the pan’s gone round ring, the yard well, the bare trough, the flagstones, the wheel-shed edge, the finger’s-width-open back room (not entered), the cold damper, the Debt Loft (heard only), the clay road at the going of the light, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  Grain’s third day came on in the small hours as a smell and then a gap in a sound, its first tend running on without a boundary drawn and neither of the district’s two month-names put right, with no market and no Account-day until Grain 10 nine mornings off, the boy two hundred and twelve days old and six months and thirty-two days with no slate in Sarn, Sill or Grath to enter either number, the carried fire’s fifth without a payer for two hundred and twelve days and the river, the boards and the fire keeping three counts that did not become one (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082); the yard went around the clean dark line, the thaw, the broken birth-slates beneath the lowest rack, the pan’s gone round ring, the bare trough with its water called weather, the field’s empty place and the place the carriers crossed, each with a look and a wide step and no number, and he took the empty places one at a time with no finger drawn across them, no third gap and no fourth likeness made a cause (T009/T013/T092, T097/T098); Sella Vail came to the fire before the basket, gave the instruction to the wool, fire, pot, broom, running water and river wind and never the basket, said the house, kept her half-pace and went wide around the pan’s gone ring, moved her lips along a two-gapped row with no figure, kept her finger on top of the shelf’s front edge so the charcoal stayed unread, glanced once at the clay jar and shut her hand half over nothing, told the fire it was the thaw, turned the coals with a broken pot, said The house will keep it, counted under her breath toward no opening, pushed coal-black hair back with the burn-wrist so the grey streak showed pale, set the pot handle two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, and left the widow’s mark untouched because a shelf and a morning are not openings, no opening in thirty-two days, her private roll unshown and Dessa’s cost unentered (T058/T079, T100); a neighbour with dry scurf on her hem and a pot hitched against her hip asked what Grain’s pots would want now the firing was done and was told Ask the pot, the house has said it, ask the weather too, going away level with nothing priced, refused or entered (T077); Tarn told the wood Six counted. The next I don’t count with the knife at the sill’s lip, brought the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stopped, kept the Seed 16 breath unspent and nine stoppings with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end and still ungiven, swept past the bright patch without the half-check and over the collector’s road without a turn, and no collector came in the third morning of Grain (T036/T076); Jorra Vail came through with meal-fine grey slate dust past the bent finger and under the nails, parted dust from slip as clot from vessel, kept dusty and clean forearms on one tray, told a pot You’ll do, withheld its full note from a High Kiln man on a wrong wind whose saying about a pot singing early stayed a saying and cost no pot, gave no name to the men who went low into the back room before first grey, kept the burned-slate word on its own place beside the dust and the two tellings with a hand between, grew quieter, and held his bent finger in the cold damper until Sella’s sentence reached the pot (T035/T031/T062/T065/T095); Garl was kept to the third day without a story, the salt coat holding a broader man’s shape, the seat its hollow and leftward lean, the clean dark line and the finer grey unswept, the proverb gone to the pot and the tile debt circled without a name, his name unspoken for two hundred and twelve days (T009/T013/T092); Sella carried him home at the going of the light around the absences and set him on his bed, put the fold right without a look at his face and left the thread frozen; in the small hours he turned out the file as a man lays instruments on a towel and found it exact, complete and worth nothing, then asked his hand and had it go up an inch toward the note and hold for the small intake only and come down before the letting go in the morning, and in the small hours hold through the small intake, the hold and the letting go of one of the breaths Sella counts at her fire in the room that does not touch his, coming down with the breath --- the old two-rhythm coordination remembered, not a change made again --- filed on the sixth place with no payer named and nothing standing up as a power; he still could not close the two inches to the pot handle, lift his chin two inches to the crust or speak a number, and the count went forward into Day 213, Grain 4, Fourthday, with Grain 10 held as the first Account-day and market of Grain, where the seventh green and the seventh sighting are owed and must not come early, the green still a colour and the foundling a shape (T061/T082, T050/T051, T033/T034).}
\CRday{Day 213}{Grain 4, Y.H. 813 (Fourthday)  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, hearth, loaf shelf’s low angle and kindling, the Clay Yard, the drying racks, the lowest rack with its broken birth-slates, the pan’s gone round ring, the yard well, the bare trough, the flagstones, the wheel-shed edge, the finger’s-width-open back room (not entered), the cold damper, the Debt Loft (heard only), the clay road at the going of the light, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  the day came to the boy as hot clay under tallow and the kiln’s four-and-a-gap with no bell while he lay two hundred and thirteen days old and six months and thirty-three days with no slate in Sarn to enter it, the file turned out as instruments on a towel exact, complete and worth nothing with six hearings beside and never among and no seventh, three near-full answers advanced and unpaid, the told bell beside the heard and the told figure beside the paid, nine stoppings and three held changes on three places with the loft scrape fourth, the pale line fifth and the held inch sixth, and the burned-slate word on its own place beside Jorra’s dust and the two shut-room tellings with a hand between the three (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082); the morning hand went up an inch toward the river’s note and came down at once against the fold, an honest miss with no failure hidden under it and no payer named, while Sella came to the fire before the basket, told it the thaw, moved her lips along a two-gapped loaf row with no figure, kept her finger on top of the shelf’s front edge, glanced once at the cold clay jar and shut her hand half over nothing, set the pot rim out with its handle two inches beyond the reaching hand and rested her hand a half-beat longer at the setting without looking toward the bed, and left the widow’s mark untouched with no opening in thirty-three days (T058/T079, T100); a neighbour’s cost-question at the threshold went to the pot and the weather and away level, the yard went around the clean dark line, the thaw, the broken birth-slates, the pan’s gone ring, the bare trough, the field’s empty place and the carriers’ place each with a look and a wide step and no number, Tarn took the broom only after it had been instructed and told the wood Six counted. The next I don’t count with the ear-sentence stopped at the word that would call the loan and no collector on Grain 4, and Jorra parted dust from slip at the wheel-shed, held his bent finger in the cold damper until Sella’s sentence reached the pot and kept he’s not Vail sealed (T036/T076, T035/T031/T065/T095); in the small hours the hand held for the small intake only and came down before the letting go, filed on the sixth place, and two hundred and thirteen stood exact, unspent and spoken by nobody into Grain 5.}
\CRday{Day 214}{Grain 5, Y.H. 813 (Fifthday)  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, hearth, loaf shelf’s low angle and kindling, the Clay Yard and its edge, the drying racks and the broken birth-slates beneath the lowest rack, the yard well, the bare trough, the flagstones, the wheel-shed edge, the finger’s-width-open back room (not entered), the cold damper, the Debt Loft (heard only), the clay road, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  the boy came into his two hundred and fourteenth day and six months and thirty-four days with nobody saying so, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid for two hundred and fourteen days and the fire, river and boards keeping three counts that did not become one (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082); the chapter’s one meaningful change: a kiln-hand come up from High Kiln on a wrong wind told the yard that the pot which sang before its time last month had not been heard from since, and the boy took the saying apart as a surgeon takes apart a wound --- a direction with no hand at the foot of it, no owner, no room, no cause and no figure --- and set it on the near-full tray beside the hearings and never among them, for a report of a silence is not a second hearing of the same pot, while Jorra, who knew the note that pot would give three turns before it left his hands, let the saying stand as a saying, gave no name to what ailed the man carried out on Day 188 and lost no pot (T064, T061/T082, T035/T031); the sweet edge of lead glaze came up off High Kiln on the wrong wind, touched the fold and went out on the wind that brought it as a direction and not a second edge paid, and at the yard well a rack woman with slip dried pale in her wrists and a man off the clay road with a number shut in his fist went to the pot and the weather with nothing priced, refused or entered while the printed one in twelve stood unchallenged and the true subtraction stayed locked in Berr’s box answering nothing for the carried man (T077, T015/T041/T047 held); Sella kept her back to the basket and her finger above the charcoal, set the pot handle two inches beyond the hand with the half-beat and no look toward the bed, and left the mark untouched with no opening in thirty-four days (T058/T079, T100), Tarn brought the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan as an interval and not a calling with nine stoppings and the Seed 16 breath unspent and no collector on Grain 5 (T036/T076), and in the small hours the hand kept the river’s own low interval, the draw, the slack and the small pause, and came down on the next low note, a one-rhythm coordination remembered with no count anywhere in the house to hold it against (T061/T082).}
\CRday{Day 215}{Grain 6, Y.H. 813 (Sixthday)  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, hearth, loaf shelf’s low angle and kindling, the Clay Yard, the drying racks and the broken birth-slates beneath the lowest rack, the pan’s gone round ring, the yard well, the bare trough, the flagstones, the wheel-shed edge, the finger’s-width-open back room (not entered), the cold damper, the Debt Loft (heard only), the clay road at the going of the light, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  the burned-slate word came over the boards a third time, from Slate Row as a direction and not a visit, spoken on the same breath as the price of barley and the weather with no owner, room, hand at the flame or reason, and the boy took it apart as a surgeon takes apart a wound and set it on its own place beside Jorra’s dust and the two shut-room tellings with a hand between the three --- a third telling of the burned slate and still not a third telling of the counting room shut in the war, advanced and not paid (T035/T031/T065/T095); Jorra grew quieter whenever it went around and the household straightened around the quiet without an order, the quiet going before him into the shed the way a cold air goes before a door, while he kept his dusty forearms apart from his clean ones, told a pot You’ll do, withheld its full note, gave no name to what ailed the man carried out on Day 188 and sealed he’s not Vail with the promise of the boy’s name neither given nor withdrawn; two cost-questions, a neighbour’s at the door about the mid-tend work and a rack woman’s at the well about the pots’ cost, went to the pot and the weather and away level with nothing priced, refused or entered (T077, T058/T079), and Sella kept her two-gapped loaf row, her finger above the charcoal and the clay jar untouched, set the pot handle two inches beyond the hand and left the widow’s mark with no opening in thirty-five days (T100); Tarn’s ear-sentence stopped at the word that would call the loan as a remembered stopping with nine stoppings, the Seed 16 breath unspent and no collector on Grain 6 (T036/T076), and in the morning the hand went up an inch under conditions that had sometimes answered and came down at once --- a miss --- while in the small hours it went up, stayed through the small intake and the hold of one of the breaths Sella counts at her fire and came down on the letting go, a coordination shorter than the whole breath of the night before, filed on the sixth place with nothing laid across it and no payer named (T061/T082); two hundred and fifteen stood exact, unspent and spoken by nobody into Day 216, Grain 7, with Grain 10 four mornings off and the seventh green still a colour and the foundling a shape (T050/T051, T033/T034).}
\CRday{Day 216}{Grain 7, Y.H. 813 (Seventhday)  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, hearth, loaf shelf’s low angle and kindling, the Clay Yard, the drying racks, the lowest rack with its broken birth-slates, the pan’s gone round ring, the yard well, the bare trough, the flagstones, the wheel-shed edge, the finger’s-width-open back room (not entered), the cold damper, the Debt Loft (heard only), the clay road, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  the second working week opened without a boundary drawn, the boy two hundred and sixteen days old and six months and thirty-six days and nobody saying so, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid for two hundred and sixteen days while the river’s note of water over water, the kiln’s four-and-a-gap and the boards’ four, four and a thumb-width knot kept three counts in three places that did not become one, for agreeing them would have wanted a payer and none stood to any (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082); the file turned out as instruments on a towel was exact, complete and worth nothing, six hearings beside and never among with the sixth from a person and no seventh, three near-full answers advanced and unpaid now holding two sayings about the pot that sang early and is not heard from, nine stoppings with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end and still ungiven, three held changes on three places with the loft scrape fourth, the pale line fifth and the held inch sixth, and the burned-slate word told three times on its own place beside Jorra’s dust and the two shut-room tellings with a hand between the three (T061/T082, T036/T076, T035/T031/T065/T095); word went up the clay road that stalls were being set at the Cross against Grain 10, a neighbour going up with boards on a barrow, and the boy took it as a direction with a date, for no market, Account-day, loaf, slate or sale came early into a working day (T077); Sella Vail came to the fire before the basket, gave every instruction to the wool, fire, pot, broom, running water and river wind and never the basket, said the house, moved her lips along a two-gapped row without a figure, glanced once at the clay jar cold under its glaze and shut her hand half over nothing, kept her finger on top of the shelf’s front edge so the charcoal stayed unread, told the fire it was the thaw, turned the coals with a broken pot, said The house will keep it, counted under her breath toward no opening, set the pot rim out with its handle two inches beyond the reaching hand and rested a half-beat longer at the setting without looking toward the bed, left the widow’s mark untouched with no opening in thirty-six days, and sent a neighbour’s cost-question about the month’s firing to the pot and the weather with nothing priced, refused or entered (T058/T079, T100, T077); Garl Vail was kept in objects and not in a story --- the salt-stiff coat with its left-shoulder crease, the seat’s twenty-year hollow and leftward lean, the clean dark line and finer grey called the thaw unswept, the proverb gone to a pot with no crack and the tile debt circled without a name, worse for being uncalled --- no lesson made, no collector called and his name unspoken for two hundred and sixteen days (T009/T013/T092); the yard went around the broken birth-slates, the pan’s gone round ring, the bare trough with its water called weather, the field’s empty place and the carriers’ place each with a look and a wide step and no number (T098); Tarn took the broom only after it had been instructed, told the wood Six counted. The next I don’t count with the knife at the very edge and the seventh at the lip beside Garl’s unforged collector sentence, brought the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stopped with no figure and no name, kept the Seed 16 breath unspent, nine stoppings and the collector road without a turn, no collector coming on Grain 7 (T036/T076); Jorra Vail parted meal-fine dust from slip as clot from vessel, spoke to the wheel and told a pot You’ll do, withheld the note known three turns ahead, gave no name to the men who went low into the back room before first grey, kept the two shut-room tellings at two, and held his bent finger in the cold damper until Sella’s unfinished sentence reached the pot as a remembered repetition, with he’s not Vail sealed and the promise ungiven (T035/T031/T062); Sella carried him home at the going of the light at the half-pace around the absences and set him on his bed, not in the loft, fold right and thread frozen; in the morning the hand went up an inch and came down at once against the fold, and in the small hours it held for the small intake only and came down before the letting go, an honest fraction filed on its sixth place with nothing laid across it and no payer named, and two hundred and sixteen stood exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody into Grain 8 (T061/T082).}
\CRday{Day 217}{Grain 8, Y.H. 813 (Eighthday)  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, hearth, loaf shelf’s low angle and kindling, the Clay Yard and its boards, the drying racks, the yard well, the bare trough, the flagstones, the wheel-shed edge, the finger’s-width-open back room (not entered), the cold damper, the Debt Loft (heard only), the clay road, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  the boy came into his two hundred and seventeenth day and six months and thirty-seven days with nobody saying so, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid for two hundred and seventeen days and the fire, river and boards keeping three counts that did not become one (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082); the chapter’s one meaningful change came on a wrong wind: a kiln-hand up from High Kiln with a barrow, lead glaze sweet at his mouth, let fall over the boards a third shaping of the old saying --- that there is a pot gone quiet on every row come the thaw --- so that three likenesses stood on the near-full tray with a finger between them, and the boy took them apart as a surgeon takes apart a wound and would not let them stand up together and call themselves a rule, for a rule is an account that has found a payer and no payer stood to any shaping, three likenesses not being three witnesses to one death and a silence reported not being a second hearing of the same pot, advanced and unpaid with no cause, no owner, no room, no figure, no lesson and no pot lost (T061/T082, T064); the sweet edge of lead glaze came up off High Kiln on that wrong wind, touched the fold and went out on the wind that brought it, a direction and not a second edge paid, no second green at a mouth and no seventh of anything (T064); Jorra, whose knowing of the full note had air under it and a want in it, kept it back from the wrong-wind man, let the saying stand as a saying, gave no name to what ailed the man carried out on Day 188, made no lesson of the green on the wind and lost no pot, his dusty forearms parted from his clean ones and his bent finger held in the cold damper until Sella’s sentence reached the pot as a remembered repetition (T035/T031/T062); at the yard well a rack woman with slip dried pale in her wrists asked what the month’s pots would want and a man off the clay road kept his number shut in his fist and put it back into his sleeve, both going to the pot and the weather with nothing priced, refused or entered, the printed one in twelve standing unchallenged, Berr’s box locked up the road with the true subtraction answering nothing for the carried man, Hessa’s slate unread at Greybank and the soft-cuffed clerk still set for his uncalled measure (T077, T015/T041/T047/T080/T090 held); Sella kept her back to the basket, her lips along the two-gapped row and her finger above the charcoal, set the pot handle two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, and left the widow’s mark untouched with no opening in thirty-seven days (T058/T079, T100); Tarn told the wood Six counted. The next I don’t count and stopped the ear-sentence at the word that would call the loan, with the Seed 16 breath unspent, nine stoppings and no collector on Grain 8 (T036/T076); in the morning the hand went up an inch and came down before the counted breath had finished, an honest miss, and in the small hours, with no breathing number anywhere in the house, it kept the river’s own low interval, the draw, the slack and the small pause, and came down on the next low note, the one-rhythm coordination remembered, filed on the sixth place and laid across nothing (T061/T082); two hundred and seventeen stood exact, unspent and spoken by nobody into Grain 9, the third shaping of the pot saying standing on its tray with no hand laying the three together and the wrong wind going out of the yard with the sweetness behind it and nothing paid.}
\CRday{Day 218}{Grain 9, Y.H. 813 (Ninthday)  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, hearth, loaf shelf’s low angle and kindling, the Clay Yard and its boards, the drying racks, the broken birth-slates beneath the lowest rack, the pan’s gone round ring, the yard well, the bare trough, the flagstones, the wheel-shed edge, the finger’s-width-open back room (not entered), the cold damper, the Debt Loft (heard only), the kiln mouth, the clay road toward the Cross, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  the boy came into his two hundred and eighteenth day and six months and thirty-eight days with nobody saying so, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid for two hundred and eighteen days and fire, river and boards keeping three counts that did not become one (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082); the burned-slate word came over the boards a fourth time from Slate Row, a voice along the boards where neighbours stood with their baskets, spoken over the boards and not to any basket on the same breath as the price of barley and the weather, with nobody saying whose slate, which room, what hand at the flame or why, and the boy took it apart as a surgeon takes apart a wound and set it on its own place beside Jorra’s dust and the two shut-room tellings with a hand between the three --- four tellings of a slate and still not a third telling of the room shut in the war, a voice from a direction not a witness, four tellings not four witnesses to one fire, a direction arrived nowhere, not a cause, hearing, seventh, stopping or payment and nothing a clerk could chart, advanced and not paid; no slate burned under any roof and no fire was lit at the kiln mouth, for a fire would have cost something and the telling cost nothing, and he did not lay the word about a slate across the three sayings about a pot (T035/T031/T065/T095, T061/T082); Jorra grew quieter and the household straightened around the quiet without an order, the quiet going before him into the shed the way a cold air goes before a door, his claim from the Broken Slates gathering interest unpaid while he’s not Vail stayed sealed and the promise of the boy’s name neither given nor withdrawn, and he had once said a slate burns in four minutes and timed it but did not say it now; a neighbour’s cost-question about the stalls going up for the tenth and a rack woman’s at the well about the month’s pots went to the pot and the weather and away level with nothing priced, refused or entered, while word went up the clay road of boards toward the Cross and of the reading block to be used on the morrow, the market not come and no slate opened, Berr’s box locked with the true subtraction, Hessa’s slate unread and the soft-cuffed clerk still set at the out-of-line landing (T077, T015/T041/T047/T080/T090 held); Sella kept her back to the basket and her finger above the charcoal, moved her lips along a two-gapped row without a figure, glanced once at the cold clay jar and shut her hand half over nothing, set the pot handle two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, pushed coal-black hair back with the burn-wrist so the grey streak showed pale, and left the widow’s mark untouched with no opening in thirty-eight days, her private roll unshown and Dessa’s cost unentered (T058/T079, T100); Garl was kept in objects with no lesson, no collector and his name unspoken for two hundred and eighteen days, the proverb gone to the pot and the tile debt circled without a name (T009/T013/T092); Tarn kept six where the house could check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl’s unforged sentence, brought the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stopped, filed it as a remembered stopping and not a new one, kept the Seed 16 breath unspent, nine stoppings with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, the warm stone cold in its loft pot and no collector on Grain 9 (T036/T076, T006); in the morning the hand went up an inch and came down at once against the fold under conditions that had sometimes answered, an object on its own tray and no failure hidden under the miss (T061/T082); in the small hours, with Sella gone to her bed and no breathing number in the house, he took the hand through the intake, hold and letting go of one of the breaths she counts at her fire, kept it through the little silence after her count had ended and brought it down on the river’s next low note --- the two-rhythm coordination remembered, not a change made again, filed on its sixth place with no payer named, and still not a longer reach, a miss, a hearing, a seventh, a stopping, a payment, a key, a power or a rule; he still could not close two inches to the pot handle, lift the crust or speak a number, and two hundred and eighteen went forward exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody into Day 219, Grain 10, with the seventh green owed as a colour and the seventh sighting of the foundling as a shape, neither come early and no loaf, slate or sale crossed the yard before the first market (T050/T051, T033/T034 held).}
\CRday{Day 219}{Grain 10, Y.H. 813 (Tenthday, the first Account-day and market of Grain)  —  the Vail kiln-house bed, hearth and loaf shelf’s low angle, the Clay Yard and the clay road, the Cross and the moot-post’s finger’s width of shade, the reading block, the pot board and stalls, the weighing board, the out-of-line landing below the north bridge, the bed under the roof, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  the file turned out before the grey as instruments on a towel was exact, complete and worth nothing, six hearings beside and never among with the sixth from a person and no seventh, nine stoppings with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, three held changes on three places with the loft scrape fourth, the pale line fifth and the held inch sixth, the burned-slate word told four times beside Jorra’s dust and the two shut-room tellings with a hand between the three, and the pan’s gone ring, the shelf’s two gaps, the fold’s crust and the field’s empty place on trays that did not touch (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082, T036/T076, T035/T031/T065/T095); the boy was two hundred and nineteen days old and six months and thirty-nine days with nobody saying so, the fire’s fifth unpaid for two hundred and nineteen days while the river’s fifth note, the kiln’s four-and-a-gap and the boards’ four, four and a knot kept three counts in three places that did not become one, and the morning hand went up an inch and came down at once against the fold, a miss with no failure hidden under it filed on its sixth place (T061/T082); Sella Vail came to the fire before the basket, gave every instruction to the wool, fire, pot, broom, running water and river wind and never the basket, said the house, kept her finger above the charcoal and set the pot handle two inches beyond the hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, and carried him up at the half-pace from every open slate to set the basket in the moot-post’s thin shade where no slate lay (T058/T079, T100); \textbf{the chapter’s one meaningful change came as two sightings and no more:} across the square at the pot board a silent woman with clay in the small crescents under her nails, a pale line across the back of one hand and the sweet green of lead glaze beside her lip turned a cup a quarter without lifting it and set it back exactly where it stood, and the boy filed the seventh green as a colour on a place of its own beside six behind it, joined to no ear and never Fenna in the narration (T050/T051 paid as a sighting only); at the market’s edge a shape in cast-offs with a man’s shoulders, breeches cut off at the knee, silt dried pale in the wrist creases, a gap where a front tooth had been and a green sliver on a string that caught the light and went dull turned its head toward a set-down pot a half-beat late and stopped in the middle, and the boy filed the seventh sighting as a shape beside six behind it, never joined to his own turning, never Ulda in the narration, with no loaf, slate or sale and the sale to the Waiting Room clerk left years ahead (T033/T034 paid as a sighting only); he took the colour and the shape apart as a surgeon takes apart a wound and set them on places that do not touch --- a colour is not a hearing and a shape is not a seventh of the full note, neither a tenth stopping, cause, name or romance, and a fourth likeness does not stand up and call itself a rule because a rule is an account that has found a payer --- while Berr Clay came up short off the clay road with his office cord folded square under his coat, wiped his thumb twice before touching nothing, passed a finger over the figure and read one in twelve twice over the basket, said The levy is called. It is not called by me and your house, never I, and went off toward High Kiln with the box locked and the true subtraction inside believing he had done a kindness, Hessa Rale carried the slate up the road before noon with the writing to her sleeve and no figure coming off it, the bell went four, four and a gap with nobody crossing himself, eight pigs went over the weighing board and the soft-cuffed clerk stayed set at the out-of-line landing for a measure nobody called, so that the district’s arithmetic changed where two hundred people stood and could not be changed back while the printed figure stood unchallenged and the figure read was still not the figure paid, answering nothing for the man carried out on Day 188 (T015/T041/T047, T077, T078, T080, T090, T058/T079); Sella carried him home at the going of the light at the half-pace, woodsmoke before in long low bars and river wind behind with water over water, wide around the pan’s gone ring, the bare dark trough, the broken birth-slates, the field’s empty place and the carriers’ place with no number, set him on the bed and not the loft and left the thread frozen, and in the small hours the hand stayed for the small intake and came down before the letting go had finished --- an honest fraction shorter than the whole breath, filed on the sixth place and not a reach, hearing, seventh, stopping, payment, held change, key, power or rule (T098, T061/T082).}
\CRday{Day 220}{Grain 11, Y.H. 813 (Firstday)  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, hearth, loaf shelf’s low angle and kindling, the Clay Yard, the drying racks, the yard well and the bare trough, the flagstones, the Vail wheel-shed edge and its finger’s-width-open back room (not entered), the cold damper, the Debt Loft (heard only), the clay road, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  an ordinary tending morning came after the market with no boundary drawn, the boy two hundred and twenty days old and six months and forty days with nobody saying so, the fire’s fifth unpaid for two hundred and twenty days while fire, river and boards kept three counts in three places that did not become one, the reading block standing empty a day behind at the Cross (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082); Grain’s changed arithmetic lay outside the roof like weather and went unread under it --- printed one in twelve unchallenged, figure read not figure paid, true subtraction locked in Berr’s box, Hessa’s slate unread, soft-cuffed clerk still set --- and the seventh green and seventh shape stayed a colour and a shape a day old on places that do not touch, with no eighth, no second look joined, no name and no promotion into a hearing, cause or romance (T015/T041/T047, T077, T080, T090 held, T050/T051, T033/T034 held advanced); cost-questions at the door and the well went to the pot and the weather and away level, a man off the clay road put his fist’s number back into his sleeve so it arrived nowhere, and the yard went around the clean dark line, the finer grey called thaw, the broken birth-slates, the pan’s gone round ring, the bare dark trough and the field’s empty place with a look and a wide step and no number, no third gap coming and no fourth likeness made a cause of two absences (T077, T009/T013/T092/T098); Sella came to the fire before the basket, said the house, moved her lips along a two-gapped row without a figure, glanced once at the cold clay jar and shut her hand half over nothing, kept her finger on top of the shelf’s front edge so the charcoal stayed unread, set the pot handle two inches beyond the hand with the half-beat and no look toward the bed, and left the widow’s mark untouched with no opening in forty days and Dessa’s cost unentered (T058/T079, T100); Tarn took the broom only after it was instructed, told the wood Six counted. The next I don’t count with six in the worn thumb-mark and the seventh at the lip beside Garl’s unforged collector sentence, stopped the ear-sentence at the word that would call the loan and filed the stopping as a remembered one, kept the Seed 16 breath unspent and nine stoppings with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, swept past the bright patch without the half-check and over the collector’s road without a turn, and no collector came on Grain 11 while the stone stayed cold in its loft pot (T036/T076, T006, T062); Jorra came through with meal-fine slate dust white in the creases of a fist, kept dusty and clean forearms on one tray, spoke to the wheel and told a pot You’ll do, withheld the knowing that had air under it and a want, let the three sayings stand as sayings, gave no name to what ailed the man carried out on Day 188, held his bent finger in the cold damper until Sella’s sentence reached the pot as a remembered repetition, kept he’s not Vail sealed and his promise ungiven, and grew quieter under the burned-slate word told four times while three or more unnamed men went low into the back room before first grey and got no name (T035/T031/T062/T065/T095, T061/T082); three or more men went low into the back room before first grey and no third telling of the counting room came (T065/T095); the morning hand went up an inch and came down before the counted breath had finished, down with the hold still ahead of it, an honest miss filed on its sixth place and laid across nothing, and in the small hours, with no count anywhere in the house, it kept the river’s own low interval --- draw, slack, small pause --- and came down on the next low note, the one-rhythm coordination remembered and not a change made again (T061/T082).}
\CRday{Day 221}{Grain 12, Y.H. 813 (Secondday)  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, hearth, loaf shelf’s low angle and kindling, the Clay Yard, the drying racks, the yard well and the bare trough, the flagstones, the Vail wheel-shed edge and its finger’s-width-open back room (not entered), the cold damper, the Debt Loft (heard only), the clay road, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  the boy came into his two hundred and twenty-first day and six months and forty-one days with nobody saying so, the fire’s fifth unpaid for two hundred and twenty-one days while fire, river and boards kept three counts in three places that did not become one, Grain 10 two mornings behind and Grain 20 (Day 229) eight mornings ahead with neither brought early (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082); the district’s changed arithmetic went on unread under the roof and the seventh green and seventh shape stayed a colour and a shape two days gathered, with no eighth, no joining, no name, no loaf, no slate and no sale (T050/T051, T033/T034 held advanced); a wrong wind came up off High Kiln before first grey with the sweet edge of lead glaze and a voice over the boards that let one of the three shapings of the pot saying stand --- a pot gone quiet on every row come the thaw --- and went on to the price of barley and the weather, and the boy took it apart as a surgeon takes apart a wound and left it a saying about a pot with no pot lost, no fourth likeness made a cause and no name for what ailed the man carried out on Day 188 (T061/T082, T064); cost-questions went to the pot and the weather and arrived nowhere, and the yard went around the clean dark line, the new finer grey called thaw, the rack space with its broken birth-slates, the pan’s gone round ring, the bare dark trough and the field’s empty place with a look and a wide step and no number (T077, T009/T013/T092/T098); Sella kept her instruction grammar, her half-pace, her jar-glance and hand half-shut, her lips along a two-gapped row with no figure, her finger above the charcoal, and set the pot handle two inches beyond the hand with the half-beat at the setting and no look toward the bed, the widow’s mark untouched with no opening in forty-one days and her private roll unshown (T058/T079, T100); Tarn said Six counted. The next I don’t count with six where the house can check and the seventh at the lip, stopped the ear-sentence at the calling word as a remembered stopping, kept nine with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, the Seed 16 breath unspent and the loan uncalled, and no collector on Grain 12, the warm stone cold in its loft pot (T036/T076, T006, T062); Jorra kept dusty and clean forearms on one tray, told a pot You’ll do and withheld the note, held his bent finger in the damper until Sella’s sentence reached the pot as a remembered repetition, kept the burned-slate word at four tellings and the two shut-room tellings at two, sealed he’s not Vail and left his promise ungiven, while three or more unnamed men went low into the back room before first grey and got no name (T035/T031/T062/T065/T095); the morning hand went up an inch toward the note and came down at once against the fold under conditions that had sometimes answered --- a miss with no failure hidden under it, filed on the sixth place --- and in the small hours he turned out the file as instruments on a towel and found it exact, complete and worth nothing: six hearings beside and never among with no seventh, three near-full answers, three shapings of the pot saying, told bell beside heard and told figure beside paid, nine stoppings with no tenth, three held changes with the loft scrape fourth, pale line fifth and held inch sixth, the seventh green a colour and the seventh shape a shape on places that do not touch, and the burned-slate word beside the dust and the two shut-room tellings with a hand between the three; then, with Sella gone to her bed and the two rooms not touching, the hand went up an inch, was taken through the intake, hold and letting go of one of Sella’s counted breaths, kept through the little silence after her count had ended and came down on the river’s next low note --- the two-rhythm coordination remembered, not a longer reach, a miss, a hearing, a seventh, a stopping, a payment, a held change, a key, a power or a rule, with no payer named and nothing joined, named, opened, called, spent or ended (T061/T082, T050/T051, T033/T034, T036/T076, T035/T031); two hundred and twenty-one stood exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody in Sarn, Sill or Grath, the seventh year at its very end and still ungiven, the charcoal unread and the stone cold in its loft pot, and the count went forward into Day 222, Grain 13, with nothing settled and nothing ended.}
\CRday{Day 222}{Grain 13, Y.H. 813 (Thirdday)  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, hearth, loaf shelf’s low angle and kindling, the Clay Yard, the drying racks, the lowest rack with its broken birth-slates, the pan’s gone round ring, the yard well, the bare trough, the flagstones, the Vail wheel-shed edge and its finger’s-width-open back room (not entered), the cold damper, the Debt Loft (heard only), the worked strips east of Low Kiln and the clay road at the going of the light, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  the boy came into his two hundred and twenty-second day and six months and forty-two days with nobody saying so, the file turned out before the grey as instruments on a towel exact, complete and worth nothing, six hearings beside and never among with the sixth from a person and no seventh, three near-full answers advanced and unpaid, three shapings of the pot saying, the told bell beside the heard and the told figure beside the paid, nine stoppings with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, three held changes with the loft scrape fourth, the pale line fifth and the held inch sixth, the burned-slate word on its own place beside Jorra’s dust and the two shut-room tellings with a hand between the three, and the hand lying down against the fold after the two-rhythm letting-go of the night before as a man lays a tool on a bench with no word about the work (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082); hot clay came first under tallow and wet wool and the sour Ash breath called the thaw, the kiln drew in fours with a gap and no bell, and the fire under the floor, the river’s fifth low note through the finger’s-width door and the boards’ four nails, four and a thumb-width knot kept three counts in three places that did not become one, for agreeing them would want a payer and none stood to any (T088, T061/T082); Sella came to the fire before the basket, gave the instruction to the wool, fire, pot, broom, running water and river wind and never the basket, said the house, glanced once at the clay jar and shut her hand half over nothing, moved her lips along a two-gapped row without a figure, kept her finger on top of the shelf’s front edge so the charcoal stayed unread, told the fire it was the thaw, turned the coals with a broken pot, said The house will keep it, counted under her breath toward no opening, pushed coal-black hair back with the burn-wrist so the grey streak showed pale, set the pot rim out with its handle two inches beyond the reaching hand and rested a half-beat longer at the setting with no look toward the bed, and left the widow’s mark untouched with no opening in forty-two days, her private roll unshown and Dessa’s cost unentered (T058/T079, T100); Garl was kept in objects with no story --- the salt-stiff coat and its left-shoulder crease, the hollow seat, the clean dark line and finer grey called the thaw unswept, the proverb gone to a pot with no crack and the tile debt circling without a name --- no lesson, no collector and his name unspoken for two hundred and twenty-two days (T009/T013/T092); Tarn took the broom only after it was instructed, told the wood Six counted. The next I don’t count with six in the worn thumb-mark and the seventh at the lip beside Garl’s unforged collector sentence, brought the ear-sentence all the way to the word that would call the loan and stopped with no figure and no name, filed it as a remembered stopping and not a new one, kept nine with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, the Seed 16 breath unspent and the loan uncalled, swept past the bright patch without the half-check and over the collector’s road without a turn, and no collector came on Grain 13 while the stone lay cold in its loft pot (T036/T076, T006, T062); Jorra came through with meal-fine grey slate dust past the bent finger and under the nails, kept dusty and clean forearms on one tray, spoke to the wheel and told a pot You’ll do, withheld the note known three turns ahead, gave no name to the men who went low into the back room before first grey, kept the burned-slate word at four tellings out of Slate Row and the two shut-room tellings at two, held his bent finger in the cold damper until Sella’s sentence reached the pot as a remembered repetition, and sealed he’s not Vail with the promise ungiven (T035/T031/T062/T065/T095); word went over the boards that the harvest had come to the worked strips and hands were going back into them, the first cut grain was counted in glances and handfuls and never in a figure, and the boy took it apart as a surgeon takes apart a wound and filed it on a place of its own, asking what it was, where it came from, what it asked and who had paid, naming no payer (T077); the yard began going around the empty place in the returning line where a hand went in on Seed 15 and did not come out, with a look and a wide step and no number, no name, cause, accident, body, identification of which hand, figure or payment, and no third gap came and no fourth likeness stood up to make a cause of it, the pan’s gone round ring, the rack space, the bare trough and the field’s empty place (T098 advanced and NOT paid, T060/T086/T097, T009/T013/T092); a neighbour at the door with a pot hitched on her hip and a rack woman at the well asked what the reaping would take and were told to ask the pot what a wet thing costs set down there, and a man off the clay road brought a number up out of a fist toward the well, looked at it and put it back into his sleeve so the figure arrived nowhere (T077); asked in the morning the hand went up an inch toward the note and came down at once against the fold, a miss with no failure hidden under it filed on the sixth place with no payer named, Grain 20 five mornings off and not brought early, and in the small hours it stayed for the small intake only and came down before the letting go had finished, an honest fraction and not a reach, hearing, payment, key, power or rule (T061/T082).}
\CRday{Day 223}{Grain 14, Y.H. 813 (Fourthday)  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, hearth, loaf shelf’s low angle and kindling, the Clay Yard, the drying racks, the lowest rack with its broken birth-slates, the pan’s gone round ring, the yard well, the bare trough, the flagstones, the Vail wheel-shed edge and its finger’s-width-open back room (not entered), the cold damper, the Debt Loft (heard only), the worked strips east of Low Kiln and the clay road at the going of the light, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  the boy came into his two hundred and twenty-third day and six months and forty-three days with nobody saying so, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid for the same count and the river, the boards and the fire keeping three counts in three places that did not become one (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082); the harvest’s second working morning brought a neighbour at the well asking what the reaping would take now that hands were back in the strips, and Sella glanced once at the clay jar cold under its glaze and sent the question to the pot and the weather with Ask the pot what a wet thing costs set down there. The house has said it, carrying the answer away level with nothing slopped, while a man come off the clay road brought a number up out of a fist toward the well, looked at it and put it back into his sleeve so that the figure arrived nowhere, not a number kept back but a number not paid (T077); Garl was kept to the day without a story, the salt coat and hollow seat holding his broader shape and twenty-year lean, the two unswept lines called the thaw, the proverb gone to the pot and the tile debt circling without a name, with no lesson, no collector and his name unspoken for two hundred and twenty-three days (T009/T013/T092); Tarn told the wood Six counted. The next I don’t count with the knife at the edge and Garl’s unforged sentence beside it, brought the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan as a remembered stopping with no figure and no name, counted nine with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, drew the Seed 16 breath at the top of the reach and did not spend it, kept the loan uncalled, swept over the flagstones past the bright patch without the half-check and over the collector’s road without a turn, and no collector came on Grain 14, the warm stone cold in its loft pot (T036/T076, T006, T062); Jorra came through with meal-fine grey slate dust white in the creases of a fist, kept dusty and clean forearms on one tray, told a pot You’ll do and withheld the note that had air under it and a want, gave no name to the men who went low into the back room before first grey, let the three sayings stand as sayings, kept the burned-slate word at four tellings and the two shut-room tellings at two, held his bent finger in the cold damper until Sella’s sentence reached the pot as a remembered repetition, and sealed he’s not Vail with the promise ungiven (T035/T031/T062/T065/T095); the grain came in as field things come into a house that keeps its days in loaves and glances, a first bundle set near the hearth under a fold of wool by hands that read its weight in their arms and knew nothing of cost, counted in glances and handfuls, entered on no slate and given no figure, and the boy filed it on a place of its own beside the row’s two unnamed gaps and the one crust in the fold, laying it across neither and naming no payer (T077, T060/T086, T071/T072); Sella carried him home at the going of the light at the half-pace with woodsmoke before her in long low bars and river wind behind with water over water, went wide around each absence with a look and no number, set him on his bed and not in the Debt Loft, put the fold right without a look at his face and left the thread frozen; asked in the morning the hand went up an inch and came down before the counted breath had finished, down with the hold still ahead of it, an honest miss filed on the sixth place and laid across nothing, and in the small hours, with no breathing number anywhere in the house, it kept the river’s own low interval, the draw, the slack and the small pause, and came down on the next low note, a one-rhythm coordination remembered and not a change made again (T061/T082).}
