then, with Sella gone to her bed and the two rooms not touching, the hand went up an inch toward the note of water over water and stayed, was taken through the small intake, the hold and the letting go of one of the breaths she counts at her fire, kept through the little silence after her count had ended and brought down on the river’s next low note --- the two-rhythm coordination remembered, not a longer reach, a miss entered, a hearing, a seventh, a tenth stopping, a payment, a held change, a key, a power or a rule, filed on the sixth place with no payer named and not spent or explained --- and two hundred and twenty-four stood exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody in Sarn, Sill or Grath, the seventh year at its very end and still ungiven, Grain 20 held five mornings off, the first grain covered near the fire and the place in the returning line gone around for the third day and still without a number, and the count went forward into Day 225, Grain 16, Sixthday.}
\CRday{Day 225}{Grain 16, Y.H. 813 (Sixthday)  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, hearth, loaf shelf’s low angle and kindling, the Clay Yard and the flagstones at its edge, the drying racks, the lowest rack with its broken birth-slates, the pan’s gone round ring, the yard well, the bare trough, the Vail wheel-shed edge and its finger’s-width-open back room (not entered), the cold damper, the Debt Loft (heard only), the worked strips east of Low Kiln and the clay road at the going of the light, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  the boy came into his two hundred and twenty-fifth day and six months and forty-five days with nobody saying so, the hand lying down against the fold after the night’s two-rhythm letting-go as a man lays a tool on a bench with no word for the work, the file turned out as instruments on a towel exact, complete and worth nothing, six hearings beside and never among with no seventh, three near-full answers and three shapings of the pot saying, nine stoppings with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, three held changes with the loft scrape fourth, the pale line fifth and the held inch sixth with twenty-four answers, and fire under the floor, river through the door and the boards’ four nails, four and a thumb-width knot keeping three counts in three places that did not become one (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082); one stiff brown-edged barley crust lay two inches from his ear with its empty place unnamed and no third, the thread at his mouth froze and was not wiped, cold stopped at cheek and temple and the bare wrist-joint, and the afterdrop waited past a warming nobody would perform (T060/T086); Sella came to the fire before the basket, gave every instruction to the wool, fire, pot, broom, running water and river wind and never to the basket, said the house, moved her lips along a two-gapped row without a figure, glanced once at the cold clay jar and shut her hand half over nothing, kept her finger on top of the shelf’s front edge so the charcoal stayed unread, told the fire it was the thaw, turned the coals with a broken pot, said The house will keep it, counted under her breath toward no opening, pushed coal-black hair back with the burn-wrist so the grey streak showed pale, set the pot rim out with its handle two inches beyond the hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, and left the widow’s mark untouched with no opening in forty-five days, her private roll unshown and Dessa’s cost unentered (T058/T079, T100); a neighbour at the door asked what the dressing would take now it was out of the stalk and was told Ask the pot what a wet thing costs set down there. The house has said it, while a man come off the clay road brought a number up out of a fist toward the well, looked at it and put it back into his sleeve, so the figure arrived nowhere, neither paid nor kept back (T077); \textbf{the chapter’s one meaningful change came in the afternoon:} the year’s first grain was taken out of its covering, carried to the flagstones, beaten out with a flail of ash-wood and leather, winnowed so the chaff went up on the river wind, and poured back near the hearth and covered again with wool --- bundle become dressed grain and gained no number, counted in glances and handfuls and by the carrying arm’s weight, entered on no slate, and laid across none of the absences (T077, T060/T086/T097); with the hands dressing the grain the yard went around the clean dark line, the finer grey called the thaw, the rack space with its broken birth-slates, the pan’s gone round ring, the bare trough, the field’s empty place and the place in the returning line where a hand went in on Seed 15 and did not come out, each with a look and a wide step and no number, no name, cause, accident, body, figure or payment, five walked-around things in a row and no payer under them (T098 advanced and NOT paid, T009/T013/T092); Garl was kept in objects and not in a story, the salt-stiff coat with its left-shoulder crease, the hollow seat, the two unswept lines, the proverb gone to the pot with no crack and the tile debt circled without a name, no collector on Grain 16 and his name unspoken for two hundred and twenty-five days (T009/T013/T092); Tarn took the broom only after it was instructed, told the wood Six counted. The next I don’t count with six in the worn thumb-mark and the seventh at the lip beside Garl’s unforged sentence, brought the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stopped as a remembered stopping, counted nine with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, drew the Seed 16 breath at the top of the reach and did not spend it, and went past the bright patch without the half-check and over the collector’s road without a turn, no collector coming up the clay road, the warm stone cold in its loft pot (T036/T076, T006, T062); Jorra came through with meal-fine grey slate dust past the bent finger and under the nails, parted dust from slip as clot from vessel, spoke to the wheel and told a pot You’ll do, withheld the note with air under it and a want, let the three sayings stand, gave no name to what ailed the man carried out on Day 188, grew quieter under the burned-slate word told four times out of Slate Row, held his bent finger in the cold damper until Sella’s sentence reached the pot as a remembered repetition, sealed he’s not Vail and left the promise of the boy’s name neither given nor withdrawn, while unnamed men went low into the back room before first grey and got no name (T035/T031/T062/T065/T095); Sella carried him home at the going of the light at the half-pace around every walked-around place, set him on the bed and not in the Debt Loft, put the fold right without a look at his face and left the thread frozen, and in the morning the hand went up an inch toward the note and came down at once under conditions that had once answered, an honest miss filed on the sixth place as the twenty-fifth answer, while in the small hours it held for the small intake only and came down before the letting go, the twenty-sixth, and two hundred and twenty-five stood exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody into Day 226 (T061/T082).}
\CRday{Day 226}{Grain 17, Y.H. 813 (Seventhday)  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, hearth, loaf shelf’s low angle and kindling, the Clay Yard, the flagstones, the drying racks, the lowest rack with its broken birth-slates, the pan’s gone round ring, the yard well, the bare trough, the Vail wheel-shed edge and its finger’s-width-open back room (not entered), the cold damper, the Debt Loft (heard only), High Kiln on the wrong wind and the clay road at the going of the light, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  a new day came without a word and nobody said so, the boy two hundred and twenty-six days old and six months and forty-six days, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid for the same count and fire, river and boards keeping three counts in three places that did not become one (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082); the dressed grain was taken out of its covering and spread thin on the flagstones to finish drying, and a woman turned it with the back of her hand, reading it by weight in glances and handfuls and keeping no figure, grit in the creases of her palm and nothing written down, so that grain beaten out and covered and grain spread to the wind were the same grain in two postures and neither had acquired a number (T077); a rack woman at the well with slip dried pale in the creases of her wrists asked what the storing would take now the grain was under wool and out on the stone, and Sella, not turning from the pot, sent her to Ask the pot what a wet thing costs set down there. The house has said it, carrying the answer away level with nothing slopped, while a man come down the clay road brought a number up out of a fist toward the water, looked at it and at the woman and the pot, and put it back into his sleeve, so the figure arrived nowhere (T077); Grain’s arithmetic went on unread under the roof --- printed one in twelve unchallenged, the figure read twice over a basket on Grain 10 still not the figure paid, Berr’s true subtraction locked in his box going up toward High Kiln, Hessa’s narrow slate up unread toward Greybank and the soft-cuffed clerk still set at the out-of-line landing for a measure nobody called --- three records going inward kept on separate trays and no payer stood under any (T015/T041/T047, T080, T090 held); the seventh green stayed a colour at a silent woman’s mouth and the seventh shape a shape at the market’s edge, seven mornings gathered with no eighth, no second look joined, no name, no loaf, no slate and no sale, neither called Fenna nor Ulda in the narration (T050/T051, T033/T034 held advanced); the yard went around the clean dark line, the finer grey called the thaw, the broken birth-slates, the pan’s gone round ring, the bare trough with its water called weather, the field’s empty place and the returning-line place with a look and a wide step and no number, seven walked-around things standing in a row with no payer under them (T009/T013/T092/T098); Sella kept her back to the basket, her lips along a two-gapped row without a figure though her hand had turned the grain, her glance at the cold clay jar and hand half-shut, her finger on top of the shelf’s front edge so the charcoal stayed unread, told the fire the thaw, turned the coals with a broken pot, said The house will keep it, counted under her breath toward no opening, pushed coal-black hair back with the burn-wrist so the grey streak showed pale, set the pot handle two inches beyond the hand with the half-beat and no look toward the bed, and left the widow’s mark untouched with no opening in forty-six days, her private roll unshown and Dessa’s cost unentered (T058/T079, T100); Tarn took the broom only after instruction and told the wood Six counted. The next I don’t count, gave the sill a small flat tap as he set the knife at the very edge with six where the house could check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl’s unforged sentence, stopped the ear-sentence at the calling word as a remembered stopping, held nine with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, drew the Seed 16 breath and did not spend it, and no collector came on Grain 17, the warm stone cold in its loft pot (T036/T076, T006, T062); a kiln-hand come up off High Kiln on a wrong wind let one of the three shapings of the pot saying stand over the boards --- a pot gone quiet on every row come the thaw --- and went on to the price of barley and the weather, and the boy took it apart as a surgeon takes apart a wound and left it a saying about a pot with no fourth likeness made a cause, no name for what ailed the man carried out on Day 188 and no pot lost, while the burned-slate word came over the boards a fourth time out of Slate Row and still arrived nowhere, a direction not a cause, the two shut-room tellings still two (T061/T082, T064, T065/T095); the sweetish green edge of lead glaze came up behind the kiln-hand, touched the fold and went out on the wind that brought it, a direction arrived nowhere and not a second edge paid, the seventh green still a colour with no eighth (T064, T050/T051 held); Jorra parted dust from slip as clot from vessel, told a pot You’ll do, withheld the near-full note, grew quieter under the burned slate, held his bent finger in the cold damper as a remembered repetition with the old iron taking the cold out of the fingertip and giving nothing back, and sealed he’s not Vail with the promise ungiven, while unnamed men went low into the back room before first grey and got no name (T035/T031/T062); Sella carried him home at the going of the light at the half-pace around every walked-around place and set him on his bed with the fold right and the thread frozen, the dressed grain lying thin under its own keeping and the two keepings not laid together; the morning hand went up an inch and came down before the counted breath had finished, the twenty-seventh answer, and in the small hours, with no count in the room and none borrowed from the room that did not touch his, it went up, stayed for the river’s own low interval of draw and slack and little pause, and came down on the next low note, the twenty-eighth, one rhythm and no second, filed on its sixth place with no payer named, and two hundred and twenty-six stood exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody into Day 227 (T061/T082).}
\CRday{Day 227}{Grain 18, Y.H. 813 (Eighthday)  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, hearth, loaf shelf’s low angle and kindling, the Clay Yard, the flagstones, the drying racks, the lowest rack with its broken birth-slates, the pan’s gone round ring, the yard well, the bare trough, the Vail wheel-shed edge and its finger’s-width-open back room (not entered), the cold damper, the Debt Loft (heard only), the worked strips’ edge and the clay road at the going of the light, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  a new day came and nobody said so, the boy two hundred and twenty-seven days old and six months and forty-seven days, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid for the same count and fire, river and boards keeping three counts in three places that did not become one (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082); he turned out the file as instruments on a towel and found it exact, complete and worth nothing, six hearings beside and never among with the sixth out of Dessa as the men lifted her and no seventh, three near-full answers, three shapings of the pot saying, the fourth burned-slate telling, the told bell beside the heard and the told figure beside the paid, nine stoppings with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, the Seed 16 breath unspent and the loan uncalled, three held changes with the loft scrape fourth, the pale line fifth and the held inch sixth with twenty-nine answers (T061/T082, T036/T076); \textbf{the dressing was finished:} Sella lifted the dressed grain off the flagstones by the handful, poured it back into its covering near the hearth and set the fold flat, so that grain cut, covered, beaten out, winnowed, spread thin and poured back lay dressed and stored, three changes of state and no figure over it anywhere, counted in glances and handfuls and by the carrying arm’s weight, entered on no slate and laid across none of the absences (T077); a neighbour at the door asked what the storing would take now the grain was under wool and was sent to the pot and the weather, and a man come down the clay road brought a number up out of a fist toward the well, looked at it as if he had forgotten what it was for, and put it back into his sleeve, so the cost carried went nowhere (T077); Grain 20 (Day 229), the second Account-day and market, stood two mornings ahead and was not brought early, the printed one in twelve unchallenged, the figure read on Grain 10 still not the figure paid, Berr’s subtraction locked in his box going up toward High Kiln, Hessa’s slate unread up the road toward Greybank and the soft-cuffed clerk still set below the north bridge for his uncalled measure (T015/T041/T047, T080, T090 held); the yard went around the clean dark line, the finer grey called the thaw, the broken birth-slates, the pan’s gone round ring, the bare trough, the field’s empty place and the returning-line place where a hand went in on Seed 15 and did not come out, each with a look and a wide step and no number, seven walked-around things in a row with no payer under them, no third gap and no fourth likeness made a cause, and the dressed grain and the returning-line place kept as two keepings and not laid together (T098 advanced and NOT paid, T009/T013/T092, T060/T086/T097); Sella kept her back to the basket and her lips along a two-gapped row without a figure, glanced once at the cold clay jar and shut her hand half over nothing, kept her finger on top of the shelf’s front edge so the charcoal stayed unread, told the fire the thaw, turned the coals with a broken pot, said The house will keep it, counted under her breath toward no opening, pushed coal-black hair back with the burn-wrist so the grey streak showed pale, set the pot handle two inches beyond the hand with the half-beat and no look toward the bed, and left the widow’s mark untouched with no opening in forty-seven days, her private roll unshown and Dessa’s cost unentered (T058/T079, T100); Garl was kept in objects and not in a story, salt coat, hollow seat, the two unswept lines called the thaw, the proverb gone to the pot and the tile debt circled without a name, no lesson, no collector and his name unspoken for two hundred and twenty-seven days (T009/T013/T092); Tarn took the broom only after instruction, told the wood Six counted. The next I don’t count with six where the house could check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl’s unforged sentence, brought the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stopped as a remembered stopping with no figure and no name, held nine with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, drew the Seed 16 breath at the top of the reach and did not spend it, swept past the bright patch without the half-check and over the collector’s road without a turn, and no collector came up or went down the clay road on Grain 18, the warm stone cold in its loft pot (T036/T076, T006, T062); Jorra came through with meal-fine grey slate dust past the bent finger and under the nails, parted dust from slip as clot from vessel, spoke to the wheel and told a pot You’ll do, withheld the knowing that had air under it and a want, let the three sayings stand, gave no name to what ailed the man carried out on Day 188, grew quieter under the burned-slate word told four times, held his bent finger in the cold damper until Sella’s sentence reached the pot as a remembered repetition, sealed he’s not Vail and left the promise neither given nor withdrawn, while unnamed men went low into the back room before first grey and got no name (T035/T031/T062/T065/T095); Sella carried him home at the going of the light at the half-pace around every walked-around place, set the basket on the bed under the roof and not in the Debt Loft, put the fold right without a look at his face and left the thread frozen, the dressed grain covered near the hearth with its figure still nowhere and the two keepings not laid together; in the morning the hand went up an inch toward the note, meant to come down on the next low note, and came down after it, short by a little space not enough to call a new distance, the twenty-ninth answer, and in the small hours, with Sella in her own bed and the two rooms not touching, the file lay exact, complete and worth nothing, the seventh green a colour and the seventh shape a shape gathered and unjoined, and he took the hand up an inch through the small intake, the hold and the letting go of one of the breaths she counts at her fire in the room that does not touch his, kept it through the little silence after her count had ended and brought it down on the river’s next low note --- two rhythms held against each other across a wall, remembered, not a change made again, the thirtieth answer filed on the sixth place with no payer named and not spent or explained, not a longer reach, a miss entered, a hearing, a seventh, a tenth stopping, a payment, a held change, a key, a power or a rule; two hundred and twenty-seven stood exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody in Sarn, Sill or Grath, the crust lay two inches from his ear with its empty place unnamed and no third, the thread was frozen and unwiped, the dressed grain lay covered with no figure over it and the returning-line place went around still without a number, and the count went forward into Day 228, Grain 19, Ninthday (T061/T082, T098).}
\CRday{Day 228}{Grain 19, Y.H. 813 (Ninthday)  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, hearth, loaf shelf’s low angle and kindling, the Clay Yard, the drying racks, the yard well and the bare trough, the flagstones’ shallow bright patch, the Vail wheel-shed edge and its finger’s-width-open back room (not entered), the cold damper, the Debt Loft (heard only), the worked strips east of Low Kiln and the clay road at the going of the light, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  the boy came into his two hundred and twenty-eighth day and six months and forty-eight days with nobody saying so, the hand lying down against the fold after the thirtieth answer as a man sets a tool on a bench and not as a sign, growth, reaching, gift or power, the file turned out as instruments on a towel and found exact, complete and worth nothing with six hearings beside and never among and no seventh, three near-full answers, three shapings of the pot saying, the fourth burned-slate telling, two shut-room tellings, the told bell beside the heard and the told figure beside the paid, nine stoppings with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, the Seed 16 breath unspent, three held changes with the loft scrape fourth, the pale line fifth and the held inch sixth, and fire under the floor, river through the finger’s-width door and the boards’ four nails, four and a thumb-width knot keeping three counts in three places that did not become one because agreeing them would want a payer and none stood to any (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082); one stiff brown-edged barley crust lay two inches from his ear with its empty place unnamed and no third, the thread at his mouth froze and was not wiped, cold stopped at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint with the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody would perform, and Sella came to the fire before the basket, gave every instruction to the wool, fire, pot, broom, running water and river wind and never to the basket, said the house, moved her lips along a two-gapped row without a figure, glanced once at the cold clay jar and shut her hand half over nothing, kept her finger on top of the shelf’s front edge so the charcoal stayed unread, told the fire it was the thaw, turned the coals with a broken pot, said The house will keep it, counted under her breath toward no opening, pushed coal-black hair back with the burn-wrist so the grey streak showed pale, set the pot rim out with its handle two inches beyond the hand and rested a half-beat longer at the setting with no look toward the bed, and left the widow’s mark untouched with no opening in forty-eight days and Dessa’s cost unentered (T058/T079, T100); the dressed grain lay dressed and stored under wool near the hearth, three changes of state and no figure over it, counted in glances and handfuls and by the carrying arm’s weight, and cost-questions at the door and the well went to the pot and the weather while a man off the clay road put his fist’s number back into his sleeve so the figure arrived nowhere (T077); the yard went around the clean dark line, the finer grey called the thaw, the rack space with its broken birth-slates, the pan’s gone round ring, the bare dark trough, the field’s empty place and the returning-line place where a hand went in on Seed 15 and did not come out, each with a look and a wide step and no number, seven walked-around things with no payer under them, no third gap and no fourth likeness made a cause (T098 advanced and NOT paid, T009/T013/T092); Garl was kept in objects and not in a story, the salt-stiff coat with its left-shoulder crease, the hollow seat, the two unswept lines, a charred slate in the kiln ash on its own place, the proverb gone to the pot with no crack and the tile debt circling without a name, his name unspoken for two hundred and twenty-eight days and no collector on Grain 19 (T009/T013/T092); Tarn took the broom only after it was instructed, told the wood Six counted. The next I don’t count with six in the worn thumb-mark where the house could check and the seventh at the lip where it could not beside Garl’s unforged collector sentence, brought the ear-sentence all the way to the word that would call the loan and stopped as a remembered stopping with no figure and no name, held nine with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, drew the Seed 16 breath and did not spend it, swept past the bright patch without the half-check and over the collector’s road without a turn, chest tight since the dark with Ash worked into his knuckles and the pale clip-ring at his left wrist, and no collector came up or went down the clay road while the warm stone lay cold in its loft pot (T036/T076, T006, T062); Jorra came through with meal-fine grey slate dust past the bent finger and under the nails, parted dust from slip as clot from vessel, kept dusty and clean forearms on one tray, spoke to the wheel before anyone and told a pot You’ll do, withheld the note with air under it and a want, let the three sayings stand as sayings, gave no name to what ailed the man carried out on Day 188, grew quieter under the burned-slate word told four times, held his bent finger in the cold damper ahead of Sella’s unfinished sentence as a remembered repetition with one iron and two bites, sealed he’s not Vail with the promise neither given nor withdrawn, while three or more unnamed men went low into the back room before first grey and got no name (T035/T031/T062/T065/T095); Sella carried him home at the going of the light at the half-pace around every walked-around place, set him on the bed and not in the Debt Loft, put the fold right without a look at his face and left the thread frozen, the loft settling as a direction and the stone still cold; and in the small hours, with no breathing number anywhere in the house, the hand went up an inch toward the river’s note and came down at once under conditions that had sometimes answered, the thirty-first answer, and then went up an inch again, held to the small intake only and came down before the letting-go, the thirty-second, both filed on the sixth place as objects and not powers, exact, complete and worth nothing (T061/T082).}
\CRday{Day 229}{Grain 20, Y.H. 813 (Tenthday)  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, hearth, loaf shelf’s low angle and kindling, the Clay Yard, the drying racks, the yard well and the bare trough, the worked strips east of Low Kiln, the clay road, the Cross, the moot-post’s finger’s width of shade, the reading block, the weighing board, the stalls, the pot board, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath, below the north bridge the out-of-line landing, and up the road toward High Kiln and Greybank  —  the boy came into his two hundred and twenty-ninth day and six months and forty-nine days with nobody saying so, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid for the same count and fire, river and boards keeping three counts in three places that did not become one (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082); the second Account-day and market of Grain came, Sella carrying him up at the half-pace from every open slate and setting the basket in the moot-post’s finger’s width of shade where no slate lay, standing half a pace off and giving the instruction to the wool and the river wind and never to the basket, the square assembling out of boards and noise with the reading block wet at one end, eight pigs waiting on the weighing board, stalls going up with the price of barley and the weather travelling together and two hundred people leaning and straightening before the morning was out (T058/T079); Berr Clay came up short off the clay road with the red wool cord of his office folded square under his coat and the green of tasted lead glaze at one mouth-corner, wiped his thumb twice on his apron before touching nothing, held a narrow slate unopened to his forearm with the writing inward, passed a finger over the figure and let his eyes rest a breath longer than the writing required, read One in twelve, as the notice says low into the top of the crowd, the figure going twice over the basket, once for the moot and once for the households that came late, said The levy is called. It is not called by me and to a man at the rail with a number out of a fist said a number goes into a slate and not into a bundle and that if your house wanted it again there would be a slate at the watch, your house never I, taking himself out of his sentence as neatly as a surgeon withdraws a hand, and went off toward High Kiln with the box locked and the true subtraction inside, believing he had done the district a kindness (T015/T041/T047); the district’s arithmetic changed for the second time in Grain where two hundred people stood and could not be changed back, the printed one in twelve unchallenged, the figure read still not the figure paid, the reading answering nothing for the man carried out on Day 188 or for the hand that went in on Seed 15 and did not come back, while the dressed grain lay covered under the Vail roof and was read over by a figure that did not know what it cost (T077, T098 advanced and NOT paid); the bell went four, four and a gap with nobody crossing himself, the heard bell kept beside the told (T078); Hessa Rale went up the clay road before noon with Berr’s narrow slate edge-on to her forearm and the writing to her sleeve, her hand to the slate before her eyes to the crowd, the strap corrected first and then the wrist turned, her coat shortened for the mud with the pale scurf unbrushed, saying I don’t read it. I carry it. There’s a difference, and the road doesn’t care which and to the woman who wanted more Cross to Greybank. Reading goes up before noon. I’ve got a road to walk, no figure coming off the slate and her reaching kept as the eighth such hand, joined to none (T080); the soft-cuffed clerk stayed set at the out-of-line landing below the north bridge where a fifth step should have stood for a measure nobody called, cuff grey from washing and grey again by midday, hand to the slate before eyes to the stalls, a buyer’s number going in before he looked up, not stepped around and not taken off (T090); the pot board kept the little print where a cup had been turned a quarter, the seventh green a colour and the seventh shape a shape on places that do not touch with no eighth, no second look joined, no loaf, no slate, no sale and no name, neither called Fenna nor Ulda in the narration (T050/T051, T033/T034 held advanced); Sella lifted the basket level at midday and went back at the half-pace, set him on the bed and not in the Debt Loft, and the box went up the road locked answering nothing (T058/T079); back under the roof a neighbour at the threshold asked what the storing would take now the grain was under wool and was sent to the pot and the weather, and a man come down the clay road stood at the yard well with a number brought up out of a fist, looked at it and put it back into his sleeve so the figure arrived nowhere, nothing priced, refused or entered (T077); Sella moved her lips along a two-gapped row with no figure, glanced once at the cold clay jar and shut her hand half over nothing, kept her finger on top of the shelf’s front edge so the charcoal stayed unread, and left the widow’s mark untouched with no opening in forty-nine days (T058/T079, T100); Tarn kept six where the house could check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl’s unforged sentence, stopped the ear-sentence at the calling word as a remembered stopping with no figure and no name, held nine with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, drew the Seed 16 breath and did not spend it, and no collector came up or went down the clay road on Grain 20 while the warm stone lay cold in its loft pot (T036/T076, T006, T062); Jorra parted dust from slip as clot from vessel, told a pot You’ll do and withheld the note with air under it and a want, let three sayings stand as sayings, kept the burned-slate word at four out of Slate Row and the two shut-room tellings at two, grew quieter under the word, held his bent finger in the cold damper ahead of Sella’s sentence as a remembered repetition, sealed he’s not Vail with the promise ungiven, while three or more men went low into the back room before first grey and got no name (T035/T031/T062/T065/T095); the yard went around the clean dark line, the finer grey called the thaw, the rack space with its broken birth-slates, the pan’s gone round ring, the bare trough, the field’s empty place and the returning-line place with a look and a wide step and no number, and Grain 21 stood one morning ahead unbrought (T009/T013/T092/T098); in the small hours he turned out the file again exact, complete and worth nothing, six hearings beside and never among with no seventh, three near-full answers, three sayings, the fourth burned-slate telling, the two shut-room tellings, told bell beside heard and told figure beside paid, nine stoppings with no tenth, three held changes with the loft scrape fourth, pale line fifth and held inch sixth, nothing joined, named, opened, called, spent or ended; the hand went up an inch toward the gap at the market’s edge, was held through the small intake and the hold with the letting-go still ahead, the thirty-third answer, and in the small hours went up an inch toward the river’s note and kept the river’s own low interval with no count anywhere in the house to hold it against, coming down on the next low note, the thirty-fourth, both filed on the sixth place with no payer named, exact and worth nothing (T061/T082).}
\CRday{Day 230}{Grain 21, Y.H. 813 (Firstday)  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, hearth, loaf shelf’s low angle and kindling, the Clay Yard, the drying racks, the lowest rack with its broken birth-slates, the pan’s gone round ring, the yard well, the bare trough, the flagstones, High Kiln on the wrong wind, the Vail wheel-shed edge and its finger’s-width-open back room (not entered), the cold damper, the Debt Loft (heard only), the worked strips east of Low Kiln, the boards over the yard and the clay road at the going of the light, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  the boy came into his two hundred and thirtieth day and six months and fifty days with nobody saying so, no bell and no market because a Firstday has no reading, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid for two hundred and thirty days and fire, river and boards keeping three counts in three places that did not become one (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082); one brown-edged barley crust lay two inches from his ear with its empty place unnamed and no third, the thread froze and was not wiped, and cold stopped at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint with the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody would perform; the first ordinary tending morning after the reading came with Sella going to the fire before the basket, giving every instruction to the wool, fire, pot, broom, running water and river wind and never to the basket, saying the house, telling the fire it was the thaw, turning the coals with a broken pot, counting under her breath toward no opening and pushing coal-black hair back with the burn-wrist so the grey streak showed pale; the dressed grain lay under its fold near the hearth counted in glances and handfuls and by the carrying arm’s weight, read over the day before by a number that did not know what it had cost and answering nothing for the hand that had gone in on Seed 15 (T077); the yard went around the clean dark line, the finer grey called the thaw, the rack space with its broken birth-slates, the pan’s gone round ring, the bare trough, the field’s empty place and the returning-line place with a look and a wide step and no number, seven walked-around things in a row with no payer under them (T009/T013/T092/T098 advanced and NOT paid); a wrong wind came up off High Kiln before the light was fully on the flagstones, carried the sweet edge of lead glaze over the boards, touched the fold and went out on the wind that brought it, a direction arrived nowhere and not a second edge paid, the seventh green still a colour with no eighth and no name spoken over it, and a voice off the terrace let one of the three shapings of the pot saying stand, a pot gone quiet on every row come the thaw, which the boy took apart as a surgeon takes apart a wound and set back, a saying and not a fourth likeness made a cause, no lesson, no name for what ailed the man carried out on Day 188 and no pot lost (T064, T050/T051 held, T061/T082); a woman with a pot hitched at her hip asked what the storing would take and was sent to the pot and the weather, and a man come down the clay road brought a number up out of a fist toward the well, looked at it and put it back into his sleeve so the figure arrived nowhere (T077); Sella moved her lips along a two-gapped row with no figure, glanced once at the cold clay jar and shut her hand half over nothing, kept her finger on top of the shelf’s front edge so the charcoal stayed unread, and left the widow’s mark untouched with no opening in fifty days (T058/T079, T100); Tarn took the broom only after instruction, told the wood Six counted. The next I don’t count with six in the worn thumb-mark and the seventh at the lip beside Garl’s unforged collector sentence, brought the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stopped as a remembered stopping with no figure and no name, held nine with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, drew the Seed 16 breath and did not spend it, agreed so entirely with those who wanted the thaw early and late that no argument could find a foot while wanting the late because it puts off the paying, swept over the bright patch without the half-check and over the collector’s road without a turn, and no collector came on Grain 21 while the warm stone lay cold in its loft pot (T036/T076, T006, T062); Jorra came through with meal-fine grey slate dust past the bent finger and under the nails, parted dust from slip as clot from vessel, spoke to the wheel and told a pot You’ll do, withheld the note known three turns ahead, let three sayings stand as sayings, kept the burned-slate word at four and the two shut-room tellings at two, grew quieter under the word until the household straightened around the quiet without an order, held his bent finger in the cold damper ahead of Sella’s sentence as a remembered repetition, and sealed he’s not Vail with the promise ungiven, while three or more men went low into the back room before first grey and got no name (T035/T031/T062/T065/T095); the morning hand went up an inch toward the note and came down at once under conditions that had once answered, the thirty-fifth answer, and in the middle of the morning a kiln-hand’s voice went over the boards with the price of barley behind it; in the afternoon a voice with no owner, room, hand at the flame or cause came back over the boards and asked Which row did the pot go quiet on?, and the weather answered first, the thaw late and grain dear before the month was out, and the price of barley answered after it, and the voice went off up the terrace and the row stood where it stood, a direction arrived nowhere with nobody leaning in to take the answer down; the boy took it apart as a surgeon takes apart a wound, asked for a row, set a row as a place, a place as wanting a witness and a witness as wanting a day when somebody stands somewhere and can be asked, and filed it on a seventh place of its own with a finger between it and the three pot sayings, the fourth burned-slate telling, the two shut-room tellings, the six hearings and the count --- NOT a fourth shaping of the pot saying, NOT a hearing, NOT a seventh of the full note, NOT a cause, NOT a name and NOT a fifth telling of the slate, a seed waiting on the far-off day a witness stood somewhere and could be asked (T101 planted and unpaid); Garl was kept in objects with his name unspoken for two hundred and thirty days and no collector on Grain 21, and Sella carried him home at the going of the light at the half-pace around every walked-around place, set him on the bed and not in the Debt Loft with the fold right and the thread frozen, then went to her own bed before the small hours and left the coals to keep themselves, so that there was no breathing number anywhere in the house and the two rooms did not touch; in the small hours he turned out the file as instruments on a towel and found it exact, complete and worth nothing, six hearings beside and never among with no seventh, three near-full answers, three sayings, the burned-slate word at four beside the two shut-room tellings with a hand between the three, told bell beside heard and told figure beside paid, nine stoppings with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, the Seed 16 breath unspent, three held changes with the loft scrape fourth, pale line fifth and held inch sixth, and T101’s seed on a seventh place of its own, nothing joined, named, opened, spent or ended; then the hand went up an inch toward the note, was taken through the small intake, the hold and the letting go of one of the breaths Sella counts at her fire in the room that does not touch his, kept through the little silence after her count had ended and brought down on the river’s next low note --- two rhythms across a wall, remembered, not a change made again, the thirty-sixth answer filed on the sixth place with no payer named; two hundred and thirty stood exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody in Sarn, Sill or Grath, the dressed grain lay covered with no figure over it, the returning-line place went around with a look and no number, the question about the row stood over the boards with nobody to own it, Grain 30 (Day 239) stood nine mornings ahead unbrought, and the count went forward into Day 231, Grain 22, Secondday (T061/T082, T071/T072, T098, T101).}
\CRday{Day 231}{Grain 22, Y.H. 813 (Secondday)  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, hearth, loaf shelf’s low angle and kindling, the Clay Yard, the drying racks, the lowest rack with its broken birth-slates, the pan’s gone round ring, the yard well, the bare trough, the flagstones, High Kiln on the wrong wind, the Vail wheel-shed edge and its finger’s-width-open back room (not entered), the cold damper, the Debt Loft (heard only), the worked strips east of Low Kiln and the clay road at the going of the light, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  the boy came into his two hundred and thirty-first day and six months and fifty-one days with nobody saying so, no bell and no market because a Secondday has no reading, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid for the same count and fire, river and boards keeping three counts in three places that did not become one because agreeing them would want a payer and none stood to any (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082); the hand lay down against the fold after the thirty-sixth answer as a man sets a tool on a bench and not as a sign, the file turned out as instruments on a towel exact, complete and worth nothing, six hearings beside and never among with no seventh, three near-full answers, three shapings of the pot saying, the burned-slate word at four and the two shut-room tellings at two, told bell beside heard and told figure beside paid with the true subtraction locked in Berr’s box answering nothing for the man carried out on Day 188, nine stoppings with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, three held changes with the loft scrape fourth, pale line fifth and held inch sixth with thirty-six answers (T061/T082); one stiff leathery brown-edged barley crust lay two inches from his ear with its empty place unnamed and no third, the thread froze and was not wiped, cold stopped at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint with the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody would perform; the dressed grain lay dressed and stored under wool near the hearth, three changes of state and no figure over it, counted in glances and handfuls and by the carrying arm’s weight, while a woman at the door asked what the storing would take and was sent to the pot and the weather, nothing priced, refused or entered (T077); the yard went around the clean dark line, the finer grey called the thaw, the rack space with its broken birth-slates, the pan’s gone round ring, the bare trough, the field’s empty place and the returning-line place where a hand went in on Seed 15 and did not come out, each with a look and a wide step and no number, seven walked-around things in a row with no payer under them, no third gap and no fourth likeness made a cause (T098 advanced and NOT paid, T009/T013/T092); Sella came to the fire before the basket, gave every instruction to the wool, fire, pot, broom, running water and river wind and never to the basket, said the house, moved her lips along a two-gapped row without a figure, glanced once at the cold clay jar and shut her hand half over nothing, kept her finger on top of the shelf’s front edge so the charcoal stayed unread, told the fire the thaw, turned the coals with a broken pot, said The house will keep it, counted under her breath toward no opening, pushed coal-black hair back with the burn-wrist so the grey streak showed pale, set the pot rim out with its handle two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, and left the widow’s mark untouched with no opening in fifty-one days (T058/T079, T100); Garl was kept in objects with his salt-stiff coat, hollow seat, two unswept lines, proverb gone to the pot with no crack and tile debt circling without a name, his name unspoken for two hundred and thirty-one days and no collector on Grain 22 (T009/T013/T092); Tarn took the broom only after it was instructed, told the wood Six counted. The next I don’t count with six in the worn thumb-mark where the house could check and the seventh at the lip where it could not beside Garl’s unforged collector sentence, brought the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stopped as a remembered stopping with no figure and no name, held nine with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, drew the Seed 16 breath and did not spend it, went past the bright patch without the half-check and over the collector’s road without a turn, chest tight since the dark with Ash in the knuckles and the pale clip-ring at his left wrist, and no collector came up or went down the clay road while the warm stone lay cold in its loft pot (T036/T076, T006, T062); Jorra came through with meal-fine grey slate dust past the bent finger and under the nails, parted dust from slip as clot from vessel, kept dusty and clean forearms on one tray, spoke to the wheel before anyone and told a pot You’ll do, withheld the note known three turns ahead with air under it and a want, let the three sayings stand as sayings, gave no name to what ailed the man carried out on Day 188, grew quieter under the burned-slate word told four times, held his bent finger in the cold damper ahead of Sella’s unfinished sentence as a remembered repetition with the iron’s two bites joined to no kiln, sealed he’s not Vail with the promise neither given nor withdrawn, while three or more men went low into the back room before first grey and got no name (T035/T031/T062/T065/T095); Sella carried him home at the going of the light at the half-pace around every walked-around place, set him on his bed and not in the Debt Loft, put the fold right without a look at his face and left the thread frozen; in the morning the hand went up an inch toward the note of water over water and came down at once under conditions that had sometimes answered, the thirty-seventh answer, and in the small hours it went up an inch toward the low note through the finger’s-width door and was held to the small intake only and came down before the letting-go, the thirty-eighth, both filed on the sixth place with no payer named as objects and not powers, so that two hundred and thirty-one stood exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody in Sarn, Sill or Grath, the seventh green a colour and the seventh shape a shape with no eighth, the question from Grain 21 waiting on its seventh place with one asking and no witness, Grain 30 (Day 239) eight mornings ahead unbrought, and the count went forward into Day 232, Grain 23, Thirdday (T061/T082, T101 held).}
\CRday{Day 232}{Grain 23, Y.H. 813 (Thirdday)  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, hearth, loaf shelf’s low angle and kindling, the Clay Yard, the drying racks, the yard well and the bare trough, the flagstones, High Kiln on the wrong wind, the boards over the yard and the terrace, the Vail wheel-shed edge and its finger’s-width-open back room (not entered), the cold damper, the Debt Loft (heard only), the worked strips east of Low Kiln and the clay road at the going of the light, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  the boy came into his two hundred and thirty-second day and six months and fifty-two days with nobody saying so, no bell and no market because a Thirdday has no reading, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid for the same count and fire, river and boards keeping three counts in three places that did not become one (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082); Sella turned the dressed grain under its wool and put her fingers into it for damp, finding it dry to her knuckle spread it thin on the flat stone to finish, changing its state again and gaining no figure, counted in glances and handfuls and by the carrying arm’s weight that knew weight and not cost and entered on no slate, while a neighbour at the threshold asked what the storing would take and was sent to Ask the pot. The weather knows the rest, and a man come down the clay road brought a number up out of a fist toward the yard well, looked at it and put it back into his sleeve so the figure arrived nowhere, nothing priced, refused or entered (T077); a wrong wind came up off High Kiln in the middle of the morning and carried the sweet edge of lead glaze over the boards, touched the fold and went out on the wind that brought it, a direction arrived nowhere and not a second edge paid, the seventh green still a colour and the seventh shape a shape with no eighth or name, and one of the three shapings of the pot saying --- a pot gone quiet on every row come the thaw --- stood again as a saying and not a fourth likeness made a cause, no lesson, no name for what ailed the man carried out on Day 188 and no pot lost (T064, T050/T051 and T033/T034 held, T061/T082); Sella moved her lips along the two-gapped row with no figure, glanced once at the clay jar cold under its glaze and shut her hand half over nothing, kept her finger on top of the shelf’s front edge so the charcoal stayed unread, and left the widow’s mark untouched with no opening in fifty-two days, because a morning and a shelf and a yard are not openings (T058/T079, T100); the yard went around the clean dark line, the finer grey called the thaw, the rack space with its broken birth-slates, the pan’s gone round ring, the bare trough, the field’s empty place and the returning-line place, each with a look and a wide step and no number (T009/T013/T092, T098 advanced and NOT paid); Tarn took the broom only after it was instructed, told the wood Six counted. The next I don’t count with six where the house could check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl’s unforged sentence, brought the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stopped as a remembered stopping, held nine with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, drew the Seed 16 breath and did not spend it, agreed so entirely with those who wanted the thaw early and those who wanted it late that no argument could find a foot while wanting the late because it puts off the paying, and no collector came on Grain 23, the warm stone cold in its loft pot (T036/T076, T006, T062); Jorra came through with meal-fine grey slate dust past the bent finger and under the nails, parted dust from slip as clot from vessel, spoke to the wheel and told a pot You’ll do, withheld the note known three turns ahead, kept the burned-slate word at four and the two shut-room tellings at two, held his bent finger in the cold damper until Sella’s sentence reached the pot as a remembered repetition, and sealed he’s not Vail with the promise ungiven, while three or more men went low into the back room before first grey and got no name (T035/T031/T062/T065/T095); \textbf{in the middle of the afternoon came the chapter’s one movement, T101 advanced and NOT paid:} a plain question came over the boards and not into the basket, in a voice with no owner, no room, no hand at the kiln and no cause, Which row did the pot go quiet on?, and the weather answered first on a small wrong wind off High Kiln with the sweet edge of lead glaze and the price of barley answered after it, and the voice went off up the terrace while the row stood where it stood, a direction arrived nowhere; the boy took it apart as a surgeon takes apart a wound --- what it asked, where it stood, what it would want before any man could answer it and who would stand under the answer to pay --- and found at the bottom no witness and no payer, then set the second telling on the seventh place beside the first with a finger between the two askings and a finger between them and the three pot sayings, the fourth burned-slate telling, the two shut-room tellings, the six hearings of the full note and the count, for two askings are not one witness and a witness stands somewhere and can be asked; NOT a fourth shaping of the pot saying, NOT a hearing, NOT a seventh of the full note, NOT a fifth telling of the slate, NOT a cause, NOT a name and NOT a fifth witness, a seed for the far-off day a witness stands somewhere and can be asked, while the three sayings stayed three, the burned-slate word four and the shut-room tellings two (T101 advanced, unpaid, T061/T082, T035/T031/T065/T095); Garl was kept in objects with his name unspoken for two hundred and thirty-two days and no collector on Grain 23, and Sella carried him home at the going of the light at the half-pace around every walked-around place, set him on his bed and not in the Debt Loft with the fold right and the thread frozen, and went to her own bed before the small hours and left the coals to keep themselves; in the small hours no voice came over the boards, and the hand went up an inch toward the low note through the finger’s-width door, was taken through the small intake and into the hold and came down before the letting-go of a counted breath, the thirty-ninth answer in the morning and the fortieth at night, and the fortieth stayed for the river’s own low interval with no count in the house to borrow and came down on the next low note, both filed on the sixth place with no payer named as objects and not powers, so that two hundred and thirty-two stood exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody in Sarn, Sill or Grath, the dressed grain lay covered with no figure over it, the question stood over the boards with two askings and nobody to own it, Grain 30 (Day 239) stood seven mornings ahead unbrought, and the count went forward into Day 233, Grain 24, Fourthday (T061/T082, T098, T101).}
\CRday{Day 233}{Grain 24, Y.H. 813 (Fourthday)  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, hearth, loaf shelf’s low angle and kindling, the Clay Yard, the drying racks, the lowest rack with its broken birth-slates, the pan’s gone round ring, the yard well, the bare trough, the flagstones, High Kiln on the wrong wind, the Vail wheel-shed edge and its finger’s-width-open back room (not entered), the cold damper, the Debt Loft (heard only), the worked strips east of Low Kiln and the clay road at the going of the light, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  the boy came into his two hundred and thirty-third day and six months and fifty-three days with nobody saying so, no bell and no market because a Fourthday has no reading, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid for the same count and fire, river and boards keeping three counts in three places that did not become one (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082); the first smell was hot clay under tallow and wet wool under that with the sour Ash breath of the corner called the thaw, the first sound the kiln drawing in fours with a gap, and one stiff leathery brown-edged barley crust lay two inches from his ear with its empty place unnamed and no third, the thread frozen and unwiped, cold stopped at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint with the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody would perform; the question from Grain 23 kept its two askings on a seventh place of its own with a finger between them and the six hearings, which had grown no seventh, two askings not one witness and a witness standing nowhere to be asked, a seed kept empty and not a hearing, cause or name (T101 advanced, unpaid); Sella went to the fire before the basket, gave her instructions to wool, fire, pot, broom, running water and river wind and never to the basket, told the fire it was the thaw, turned the coals with a broken pot, said The house will keep it, counted under her breath toward no opening, pushed coal-black hair back with the burn-wrist so the grey streak showed pale, set the pot rim out with its handle two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, and left the widow’s mark untouched with no opening in fifty-three days (T058/T079, T100); the year’s first grain lay dressed and stored four days gone under a fold of wool near the hearth, and she lifted the fold and turned it for damp, spread it thin to finish and gathered it back by the handful and set the fold flat again, a fourth change of state and still no figure, counted in glances, handfuls and by a carrying arm that knew weight and not cost, while a woman at the threshold and another at the well asked what the storing would take and were told to ask the pot and the weather, and a man come down the clay road brought a number up out of a fist toward the yard well, looked at it and the pot and the weather and put it back into his sleeve so the figure arrived nowhere, nothing priced, refused or entered (T077); a wrong wind got up off High Kiln in the middle of the morning and came over the boards with the sweet edge of lead glaze on it, touched the fold and went out again, a direction arriving nowhere and not a second edge paid, and the seventh green stayed a colour and the seventh shape a shape gathered at Grain’s first market and carried unjoined through the working mornings since, with no eighth of either, no second look joined, no name spoken over either, no loaf, no slate, no sale and no promotion into a hearing, a tenth stopping, a cause, a name or a romance, neither called Fenna nor Ulda in the narration (T064, T050/T051 and T033/T034 held); the yard went around the clean dark line, the finer grey called the thaw, the rack space with its broken birth-slates, the pan’s gone round ring with no scrape, crumb, print, chip or word kept on its own tray, the bare dark trough, the field’s empty place and the returning-line place where a hand went in on Seed 15 and did not come out, each with a look and a wide step and no number, seven walked-around things in a row with no payer under them, a thing gone around still a thing kept (T009/T013/T092, T098 advanced and NOT paid); Tarn took the broom only after it was instructed, told the wood Six counted. The next I don’t count with six in the worn thumb-mark and the seventh at the lip beside Garl’s unforged sentence, said Yes, house to those who wanted the thaw early and late and went on wanting the late because it puts off the paying, brought the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stopped as a remembered stopping with no figure and no name, held nine with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, drew the Seed 16 breath and did not spend it, and no collector came up or went down the clay road on Grain 24, the warm stone cold in its loft pot (T036/T076, T006, T062); Jorra came through with meal-fine grey slate dust past the bent finger and under the nails, parted dust from slip as clot from vessel, kept dusty and clean forearms on one tray, spoke to the wheel and told a pot You’ll do, withheld the note known three turns ahead, kept the burned-slate word at four and the two shut-room tellings at two with the question’s two askings on their own seventh place, held his bent finger in the cold damper until Sella’s sentence reached the pot as a remembered repetition, and sealed he’s not Vail with the promise neither given nor withdrawn, while three or more men went low into the back room before first grey and got no name (T035/T031/T062/T065/T095, T101 held); Garl was kept in objects with his name unspoken for two hundred and thirty-three days and no collector on Grain 22, 23 or 24, and Sella carried him home at the going of the light at the half-pace around every walked-around place, set him on his bed and not in the Debt Loft with the fold right and the thread frozen, and went to her own bed before the small hours and left the coals to keep themselves; in the small hours no breathing number sounded anywhere in the house and the two rooms did not touch, the only count being the one Sella kept at her fire, small intake, hold, letting-go, toward no opening, which he took for his own the way a man keeps a rhythm he has heard a thousand times, and he turned out the file as instruments on a towel and found it exact, complete and worth nothing, six hearings beside and never among with no seventh, three near-full answers, three pot sayings, the burned-slate word at four, the two shut-room tellings at two, told bell beside heard and told figure beside paid, nine stoppings with no tenth, three held changes with the loft scrape fourth, pale line fifth and held inch sixth, the seventh green a colour and the seventh shape a shape, the dressed grain covered and unfigured, the returning-line place gone around with no number, and the question standing with two askings and nobody to own it, nothing joined, named, opened, called, spent or ended (T061/T082, T071/T072, T098, T101); the hand went up an inch toward the low note through the finger’s-width door, was taken through the small intake, the hold and into the letting-go of one of Sella’s counted breaths and came down before the count had finished, the forty-first answer, and then in the chapter’s last small hours went up an inch again, was carried through the intake, hold and letting go of one of those breaths, kept through the little silence after her count had ended and brought down on the river’s next low note, the forty-second, a two-rhythm coordination held across the wall that does not touch, remembered and not a change made again, both filed on the sixth place with no payer named, so that two hundred and thirty-three stood exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody in Sarn, Sill or Grath, six months and fifty-three days told by nobody, the seventh year at its very end and still ungiven, Grain 30 (Day 239) six mornings ahead and unbrought, and the count went forward exact and unspent into Day 234, Grain 25, Fifthday (T061/T082, T101).}
\CRday{Day 234}{Grain 25, Y.H. 813 (Fifthday)  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, hearth, loaf shelf’s low angle and kindling, the Clay Yard, the drying racks, the yard well and the bare trough, the flagstones, High Kiln on the wrong wind, the Vail wheel-shed edge and its finger’s-width-open back room (not entered), the cold damper, the Debt Loft (heard only), the worked strips east of Low Kiln and the clay road at the going of the light, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  the boy came into his two hundred and thirty-fourth day and six months and fifty-four days with nobody saying so, no bell and no market because a Fifthday has no reading, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid for the same count and fire, river and boards keeping three counts in three places that did not become one because agreeing them would want a payer and none stood to any (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082); the hand lay down against the fold after the forty-second answer as a man sets a tool on a bench, the file turned out as instruments on a towel exact, complete and worth nothing, six hearings beside and never among with the sixth out of Dessa as the men lifted her and no seventh, three near-full answers, three shapings of the pot saying, the fourth burned-slate telling, the two shut-room tellings, told bell beside heard and told figure beside paid with the true subtraction locked in Berr’s box answering nothing for the man carried out on Day 188, nine stoppings with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, the Seed 16 breath unspent, three held changes with the loft scrape fourth, pale line fifth and held inch sixth, and the question on a seventh place with two askings and no witness (T061/T082, T101 held); one stiff leathery brown-edged barley crust lay two inches from his ear with its empty place unnamed and no third, the thread froze and was not wiped, cold stopped at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint with the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody would perform; Sella went to the fire before the basket, gave her instruction to wool, fire, pot, broom, running water and river wind and never to the basket, told the fire the thaw, turned the coals with a broken pot, said The house will keep it, counted under her breath toward no opening, pushed coal-black hair back with the burn-wrist so the grey streak showed pale, set the pot rim out with its handle two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, and left the widow’s mark untouched with no opening in fifty-four days (T058/T079, T100); the dressed grain lay under wool near the hearth, turned for damp and gathered back by the handful, changed and unfigured, counted in glances and handfuls and by a carrying arm that knew weight and not cost, while a neighbour at the threshold asked what the storing would take and was sent to the pot and the weather, and a man come down the clay road brought a number up out of a fist toward the yard well, looked at it and put it back into his sleeve so the figure arrived nowhere, nothing priced, refused or entered (T077); the yard went around the clean dark line, the finer grey called the thaw, the rack space with its broken birth-slates, the pan’s gone round ring, the bare dark trough, the field’s empty place and the returning-line place where a hand went in on Seed 15 and did not come out, each with a look and a wide step and no number, seven walked-around things with no payer under them, no third gap and no fourth likeness made a cause (T009/T013/T092, T098 advanced and NOT paid); Garl was kept in objects with his salt-stiff coat, hollow seat, two unswept lines, proverb gone to the pot with no crack and tile debt circling without a name, his name unspoken for two hundred and thirty-four days and no collector on Grain 25 (T009/T013/T092); Tarn took the broom only after it was instructed, told the wood Six counted. The next I don’t count with six in the worn thumb-mark where the house could check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl’s unforged collector sentence, brought the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stopped as a remembered stopping with no figure and no name, held nine with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, drew the Seed 16 breath and did not spend it, swept past the bright patch without the half-check and over the collector’s road without a turn, chest tight since the dark with Ash in the knuckles and the pale clip-ring at his left wrist, and no collector came up or went down the clay road while the warm stone lay cold in its loft pot (T036/T076, T006, T062); Jorra came through with meal-fine grey slate dust past the bent finger and under the nails, parted dust from slip as clot from vessel, spoke to the wheel and told a pot You’ll do, withheld the note known three turns ahead, let the three sayings stand as sayings, gave no name to what ailed the man carried out on Day 188, grew quieter under the burned-slate word told four times, held his bent finger in the cold damper ahead of Sella’s unfinished sentence as a remembered repetition, sealed he’s not Vail with the promise neither given nor withdrawn, while three or more men went low into the back room before first grey and got no name (T035/T031/T062/T065/T095); Sella carried him home at the going of the light at the half-pace around every walked-around place, set him on the bed and not in the Debt Loft with the fold right and the thread frozen, and went to her own bed before the small hours and left the coals to keep themselves; the hand went up an inch toward the note and held to the small intake only and came down before the letting-go, the forty-third answer in the morning and the forty-fourth at night, both filed on the sixth place with no payer named, objects and not powers, exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air (T061/T082); two hundred and thirty-four stood exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody in Sarn, Sill or Grath, the seventh green a colour and the seventh shape a shape with no eighth, the question from Grain 21 waiting with two askings and no witness, Grain 30 (Day 239) five mornings ahead unbrought, and the count went forward into Day 235, Grain 26, Sixthday (T061/T082, T101 held).}
\CRday{Day 235}{Grain 26, Y.H. 813 (Sixthday)  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, hearth, loaf shelf’s low angle and kindling, the Clay Yard, the drying racks, the yard well and the bare trough, the flagstones, High Kiln on the wrong wind, the boards over the yard and the terrace, the Vail wheel-shed edge and its finger’s-width-open back room (not entered), the cold damper, the Debt Loft (heard only), the worked strips east of Low Kiln and the clay road at the going of the light, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  the boy came into his two hundred and thirty-fifth day and six months and fifty-five days with nobody saying so, no bell and no market because a Sixthday has no reading, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid for the same count and fire, river and boards keeping three counts in three places that did not become one (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082); the file lay exact, complete and worth nothing with six hearings beside and never among and no seventh, three near-full answers, three shapings of the pot saying, the fourth burned-slate telling, the two shut-room tellings, told bell beside heard and told figure beside paid with Berr’s twice-wiped thumb on a tray of its own and the true subtraction locked in his box answering nothing for the man carried out on Day 188, nine stoppings with no tenth, the Seed 16 breath unspent, three held changes with the loft scrape fourth, pale line fifth and held inch sixth, and the question with two askings on a seventh place of its own (T061/T082, T101 held); one crust lay two inches from his ear with its empty place unnamed and no third, the thread froze and was not wiped, cold stopped at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint with the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody would perform; Sella went to the fire before the basket, told the wool to keep the river wind off his ears, told the fire it was the thaw, turned the coals with a broken pot, said The house will keep it, counted under her breath toward no opening, and turned the dressed grain under its wool for damp, put her fingers into it, spread it thin on the flat stone to finish and gathered it back by the handful and set the fold flat, so that it changed state three times in one morning and gained no figure, counted in glances and handfuls and by the carrying arm’s weight that knew weight and not cost, entered on no slate and laid across none of the absences (T077); a neighbour at the threshold asked what the storing would take now the grain was under wool and was sent to Ask the pot. The weather knows the rest, and a man come down the clay road brought a number up out of a fist toward the yard well, looked at it and put it back into his sleeve so the figure arrived nowhere, the figure read over the covered basket on Grain’s second Account-day still not the figure paid while the printed one in twelve stood unchallenged and the district’s changed arithmetic stood unread under this roof (T015/T041/T047 held, T077); a wrong wind off High Kiln brought the sweet edge of lead glaze over the boards, touched the fold and went out on the wind that brought it, a direction arrived nowhere and not a second edge paid, the seventh green still a colour and the seventh shape a shape with no eighth or name, and one of the three shapings of the pot saying --- a pot gone quiet on every row come the thaw --- stood again as a saying and not a fourth likeness made a cause, no lesson, no name for what ailed the man carried out on Day 188 and no pot lost (T064, T050/T051 and T033/T034 held, T061/T082); Sella moved her lips along the two-gapped row without a figure, glanced once at the clay jar and shut her hand half over nothing, kept her finger on top of the shelf’s front edge so the charcoal stayed unread, and left the widow’s mark untouched with no opening in fifty-five days (T058/T079, T100); Tarn kept six where the house could check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl’s unforged sentence, brought the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stopped as a remembered stopping, held nine with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, drew the Seed 16 breath and did not spend it, and no collector came on Grain 26 while the warm stone lay cold in its loft pot (T036/T076, T006, T062); Jorra parted dust from slip as clot from vessel, spoke to the wheel and told a pot You’ll do, withheld the note known three turns ahead, kept the burned-slate word at four and the shut-room tellings at two, held his bent finger in the cold damper ahead of Sella’s unfinished sentence as a remembered repetition, and sealed he’s not Vail with the promise ungiven, while three or more men went low into the back room before first grey and got no name (T035/T031/T062/T065/T095); the morning hand went up an inch toward the river’s low note and stayed a small interval between intake and letting-go and came down before the count in the other room had finished, the forty-fifth answer, and \textbf{in the middle of the afternoon came the chapter’s one movement, T101 advanced and NOT paid:} the plain question came a \textbf{third} time over the boards and not into the basket, Which row did the pot go quiet on?, in a voice with no owner, room, hand at the kiln or cause, and the weather answered first with a wrong wind off High Kiln and the sweet edge of glaze touching the fold, and the price of barley answered after it, a figure come up out of the square going over the boards on the same wind, and the voice went up the terrace while the row stood where it stood, with nobody leaning in to take the answer down; the boy opened it as a surgeon opens a wound --- a row is a place, a place wants a witness, a witness wants a day when somebody stands somewhere and can be asked, and at the bottom there was no payer --- and set the third telling on the seventh place beside the first two with a finger between each pair and a finger between them and the sayings, the tellings, the six hearings and the count, for three askings are not one witness and a witness stands somewhere and can be asked; NOT a fourth shaping of the pot saying, NOT a hearing, NOT a seventh of the full note, NOT a fifth telling of the slate, NOT a third telling of the shut room, NOT a cause, NOT a name and NOT a fifth witness, a seed for the far-off day a witness stands somewhere and can be asked, while the three sayings stayed three, the burned-slate word four and the shut-room tellings two (T101 advanced, unpaid, T061/T082, T035/T031/T065/T095); Garl was kept in objects with his name unspoken for two hundred and thirty-five days and no collector on Grain 26, and Sella carried him home at the going of the light at the half-pace around every walked-around place, set him on the bed and not in the Debt Loft with the fold right and the thread frozen, and went to her own bed before the small hours and left the coals to keep themselves; in the small hours no voice came over the boards and the hand went up an inch toward the river’s low note and kept the river’s own low interval with no count in the house to borrow and came down on the next low note, the forty-sixth answer, filed on the sixth place with no payer named, not a longer reach, miss, hearing, seventh, tenth stopping, payment, held change, key, power or rule; two hundred and thirty-five stood exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody in Sarn, Sill or Grath, six months and fifty-five days told by nobody, the widow’s mark untouched with no opening in fifty-five days, the question standing over the boards with three askings and nobody to own them, Grain 30 (Day 239) four mornings ahead unbrought, and the count went forward into Day 236, Grain 27, Seventhday (T061/T082, T071/T072, T101).}
\CRday{Day 236}{Grain 27, Y.H. 813 (Seventhday)  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, hearth, loaf shelf’s low angle and kindling, the Clay Yard, the drying racks, the lowest rack with its broken birth-slates, the pan’s gone round ring, the yard well, the bare trough, the flagstones, High Kiln on the wrong wind, the boards over the yard, the Vail wheel-shed edge and its finger’s-width-open back room (not entered), the cold damper, the Debt Loft (heard only), the worked strips east of Low Kiln and the clay road at the going of the light, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  the boy came into his two hundred and thirty-sixth day and six months and fifty-six days with nobody saying so, no bell and no market because a Seventhday has no reading, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid for the same count and fire, river and boards keeping three counts in three places that did not become one (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082);
