\CRday{Day 265}{Smoke 26, Sixthday, Y.H. 813  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, hearth, loaf shelf’s low angle, kiln mouth and boards, the drying racks and the cool stone at the rack end, the Clay Yard and its walked-around places, the yard well and the bare trough, the lowest rack with its broken birth-slates, the pan’s gone round ring, the field’s empty place and the returning-line place on the worked strips, the terrace, the kindling, the flagstones, the Vail wheel-shed edge and its finger’s-width-open back room (not entered), the cold damper, the Debt Loft (heard only), the clay road at the going of the light, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  Smoke 26 came on its own light and was not carried into a day that had already spent its own, the boy coming into his two hundred and sixty-fifth day and six months and eighty-five days with nobody saying so, no bell, market or Cross on a Sixthday, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid two hundred and sixty-five days with its payer unnamed, fire, river and boards keeping three counts in three places that did not become one because agreeing any two would want a payer, six hearings with no seventh and none invented to fill the empty place, the widow’s mark untouched because a roof, a rack, a well and a bed are not openings, Smoke 30 (Day 269) four mornings ahead and the first firing of Frost far off, both unbrought (T071/T072, T088, T058/T079, T061/T082); one crust two inches off with its empty place unnamed and no third, the thread frozen, cold at cheek, temple and wrist, the afterdrop waiting, the surgeon taking the inventory in its old order and entering none of it (T060/T086); Sella went to the fire before the basket, told the coals the thaw, turned them with a broken pot, said The house will keep it, counted toward no opening, pushed the coal-black hair back with the burn-wrist so the grey streak showed pale, glanced once at the clay jar and shut her hand half over nothing, kept her finger on top of the shelf’s front edge so the charcoal stayed unread, moved her lips along a two-gapped row without a figure, set the pot handle two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, and carried him out at the half-pace, going wide around the seven walked-around places, including the returning-line place where the hand went in on Seed 15, each with a look and a wide step and no number, seven in a row not an account until a payer stands and none standing (T100, T009/T013/T092, T098 carried); \textbf{the chapter’s one meaningful change came at the drying racks:} she drew the wool wholly back from the dressed grain on the cool stone at the rack end for the last time before the reading and turned the pieces one by one in the flat of her hand for damp and rot, rolling each as a potter turns a cup to find the thin place and setting it down where it lay, then laid the wool back, smoothed it and carried the dish away from the hearth without a figure, a word or an entry, so that the arithmetic read over it on Smoke 30 would know the cover and not the grain and do its work perfectly and so that the space between the figure and its price stayed unsigned; the boy watched as a surgeon watches a wound turned over and kept the finding that a thing can be handled closely and still enter nothing on a place of its own, not a lesson, a grievance or a doctrine and not laid across the house’s not-doings or his own kept gaps, for a joining would want a payer and none stood to either, the absence of a joining itself kept, entered nowhere and not spent (T077 advanced, not paid, T015/T041/T047 held, T061/T082); Ilva was glimpsed once at the yard well drawing with the pail against her knee, clay dried pale in her nail crescents and grey rack dust worked into the seam of one thumb, her hand going toward her sleeve and staying there, the notched birch strip not taken out, read, asked about or joined to the reed-cutter’s cord, the knots, the six pages, the tins, the charcoal under the shelf or any other private keeping, and her eyes going to the asker before her mouth answered the question put and not the one behind it --- Ask the pot what it cost. I keep the count, not the account --- so the boy filed no tenth hand-shape and the ninth stayed nine on its own tray with a finger between it and the eighth (T080 held); below the sill a child’s foot that had stayed cold after the flood was wrapped in a woman’s wool and called the cold by her and weather by the yard, the boy keeping the extremity going before the core and the afterdrop waiting beyond and naming no cause, no silt-leach and no cure, for there is no Grathic word for it and nobody in the yard has asked for one (T093/T094 carried, not paid); a wrong wind off High Kiln brought the sweet edge of lead glaze over the boards, touched the fold and went out on the wind that brought it, a direction arrived nowhere, not a second edge paid, not joined to the man carried out on Day 188, to any pot saying or to the pale line kept on its own place (T064); mid-afternoon, over the boards and not into the basket, a voice with no owner, room, hand at the kiln or cause said the row question again in a new form --- not a fresh asking but a report that somebody had been asking which row it went quiet on --- and the weather answered first, the price of barley after it, and the voice went off up the terrace with nobody leaning in to take an answer down; the boy took the shaping apart as a surgeon takes a wound apart, found no witness at the bottom of it and set it beside the five askings with a finger between, the askings still at five with no sixth asking, no witness and no row named, the shaping not a hearing, not a seventh of the full note, not a fifth telling of the burned slate at four, not a third telling of the shut counting room at two, not a fourth likeness of the three pot sayings with the premature Smoke 14 note apart, not a cause, not a name and not a payment (T101 advanced and unpaid); Tarn at the kindling instructed the broom before taking it up, said Yes, house and Six counted. The next I don’t count with six checkable and the seventh at the lip beside Garl’s unforged sentence, stopped the ear-sentence at the word that would call the loan as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, drew the Seed 16 breath unspent, his chest tight, Ash in the knuckle creases, the pale clip-ring at the wrist, the warm stone cold and unreconciled in its loft pot, and his stroke over the bright patch without the half-check (T036/T076, T006); Jorra at the wheel-shed parted dusty forearms from clean, told a pot You’ll do, withheld the note he knew three turns ahead, gave no name to the men who went low into the back room before first grey, held his bent finger in the cold damper ahead of Sella’s unfinished sentence as one piece of iron with two bites, kept burned slate at four, shut-room tellings at two, pot sayings at three with the premature note apart, he’s not Vail sealed and the promise neither given nor withdrawn (T035/T031/T062, T065/T095, T064); a neighbour’s cost-question went to the pot and the weather, and a man come down the clay road brought a number up out of a fist toward the well, looked at it and put it back into his sleeve so the figure arrived nowhere (T015/T041/T047 held); Sella carried him up at the going of the light at the half-pace, went wide around the seven places, set him on his bed under the roof and not in the Debt Loft, put the fold right without a look at his face, left the thread frozen, told the fire the thaw, turned the coals, counted under her breath toward no opening and went to her own bed, the widow’s mark hanging where it hangs and the one opening before Smoke 1 staying behind the household with no lesson, mending, sign or payer (T058/T079); the hand held up an inch through one whole interval of the river’s own going and came down on the next low note, borrowing no house count and supplying no stroke (one hundred and five), and in the small hours went up an inch for the small intake let go, then carried a second rhythm across the little silence after a count that had ended in the other room, the two intervals laid apart and not across one another, the silence kept whole and empty, and came down on the river’s next low note (one hundred and six), both filed on the sixth place with no payer named, not a reach, hearing, seventh, stopping, payment, held change, key, power or rule (T061/T082); 265 stood exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody in Sarn, Sill and Grath as the count went forward into Smoke 27 (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082).}
\CRday{Day 266}{Smoke 27, Seventhday, Y.H. 813  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, hearth, loaf shelf’s low angle, kiln mouth and boards, the drying racks and the cool stone at the rack end, the Clay Yard and its walked-around places, the yard well with its lip gone under the bucket and the bare trough, the lowest rack with its broken birth-slates, the pan’s gone round ring, the field’s empty place and the returning-line place on the worked strips, the terrace, the kindling, the flagstones, the Vail wheel-shed edge and its finger’s-width-open back room (not entered), the cold damper, the Debt Loft (heard only), the clay road at the going of the light, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  the boy came into his two hundred and sixty-sixth day and six months and eighty-six days with nobody saying so, the hand resting on the hundred and sixth answer as a tool put away, no bell, market or Cross on a Seventhday, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid two hundred and sixty-six days with its payer unnamed, fire, river and boards keeping three counts in three places that did not become one because agreeing any two would want a payer, six hearings beside and never among with no seventh, the heard bell beside the told and the told figure beside the paid with Smoke’s second arithmetic gone up the road in a locked box, the widow’s mark hanging where it hangs at shelf, well, rack, road, basket, yard, morning, afternoon and dusk, Smoke 30 (Day 269) three mornings ahead and not brought early and the first firing of Frost far off (T071/T072, T088, T058/T079, T077, T061/T082); one stiff leathery brown-edged crust lay two inches from his ear with its empty place unnamed and no third, the thread froze unwiped, cold stopped at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint, the afterdrop waited past a warming nobody would perform, and the surgeon entered none of it (T060/T086); the third working week went out as it had come in, an ordinary tending that had learned nothing from the reading, and he kept the nothing learned as a finding with no payer, not a lesson and not a grievance, not laid across the house’s not-doings or his own kept gaps (T071/T072, T061/T082); Sella went to the fire before the basket, told the coals the thaw, turned them with a broken pot, said The house will keep it, counted toward no opening, pushed the coal-black hair back with the burn-wrist so the grey streak showed pale, glanced once at the clay jar and shut her hand half over nothing, kept her finger on top of the shelf’s front edge so the charcoal stayed unread, moved her lips along a two-gapped row without a figure and set the pot handle two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed (T100); the dressed grain was drawn back only far enough to feel for damp, turned once in the flat of a hand and laid where it had lain under the wool again with a lighter touch than the day before, changed in state and given no figure and no word, so that the arithmetic read over it on Smoke 30 would know the cover and not the grain and the space between its figure and its price stayed unsigned, and the boy kept the not-learning as a finding with no payer, not a lesson or a grievance, and drew no line between it and the hand (T077, T061/T082); frost had gone out of the well lip under the bucket and the yard called the whole of it weather, kept on a place of its own with no cause, a neighbour’s cost-question went to the pot and the weather, and a man come down the clay road brought a number up out of a fist toward the well, looked at it and put it back into his sleeve so the figure arrived nowhere and none was supplied (T083/T085, T015/T041/T047 held); a wrong wind off High Kiln carried the sweet edge of lead glaze over the boards, touched the fold and went out on the wind that brought it, a direction arrived nowhere, not a second edge paid, not a fourth saying about a pot and not a likeness of the man carried out on Day 188 (T064); Garl was kept in objects with his name unspoken two hundred and sixty-six days, the salt-stiff coat, hollow wheel-seat and crackless proverb intact, the tile debt neither paid nor settled nor done with, and no collector up or down the clay road on Smoke 25, 26 or 27 (T009/T013/T092); the yard went around the seven walked-around places with a look and a wide step and no number, including the returning-line place where the hand went in on Seed 15 and did not come out, carried and not named, not paid and not joined to the shelf’s two gaps or the fold’s one crust (T009/T013/T092, T098 carried); Tarn at the kindling set six where the house could check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl’s unforged sentence, instructed the broom before taking it up, said Yes, house and Six counted. The next I don’t count, brought the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stopped there as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end and still ungiven, drew the Seed 16 breath unspent, his chest tight, Ash in the knuckles, the pale clip-ring at the wrist, the warm stone cold in its loft pot and unreconciled by not trying, the loan uncalled and his stroke over the bright patch without the half-check (T036/T076, T006); Jorra at the wheel-shed came through with meal-fine grey dust past the bent finger and white in a fist’s creases, parted dusty forearms from clean, spoke to the wheel before any person, told a pot You’ll do, withheld the note he knew three turns ahead, kept the burned-slate word at four, the two shut-room tellings at two and the three pot sayings with the premature Smoke 14 note apart, gave no name to the men who went low into the back room before first grey, held his bent finger in the cold damper ahead of Sella’s unfinished sentence, kept the five askings with the one further shaping and no witness, he’s not Vail sealed and the promise neither given nor withdrawn, and lost no pot and gave no name to what ailed the man carried out on Day 188 (T035/T031/T062, T065/T095, T064, T101); Sella carried him up at the going of the light at the half-pace, went wide around the seven places, set him on his bed under the roof and not in the Debt Loft, put the fold right without a look at his face, left the thread frozen, told the fire the thaw, turned the coals, counted under her breath toward no opening and went to her own bed, the one opening before Smoke 1 staying behind the household with no lesson, mending, sign or payer named; in the small hours he turned the file out as instruments on a towel and found the whole of it exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air --- six hearings with no seventh and none invented to fill the empty place, three near-full answers, three pot sayings with the premature Smoke 14 note apart, four low things with water over water a fifth, told bell beside heard and told figure beside paid with the second arithmetic up the road in a locked box, nine stoppings with no tenth, three held changes plus the loft scrape, the pale line and the held inch on six places, nine record-first hands with the ninth taken from the firing work and her strip unread in her sleeve, the seventh green a colour and the seventh shape a shape with no eighth, the covered grain unfigured, the pan’s ring, the shelf’s two gaps and the fold’s one crust with its gap on trays that do not touch, the finding that close handling is not entry on a place of its own, the row question at five askings with one further shaping and no witness, and the house’s not-doings on a place of their own with his own kept gaps on another and a finger between (T061/T082, T080 held, T101 advanced, T100, T077); the hand went up an inch, held for the small intake and the hold of one of the breaths the woman counted in the room that does not touch and came down before the letting-go, borrowing no stroke and crossing no silence (one hundred and seven), then went up again, held for the small intake, the hold and the letting-go, did not come down with her breath, kept the small height through the little silence after her count and went on past the river’s next low note to the one after it, holding across two of the river’s intervals with no second house count borrowed for the second, the house’s count kept on its own place, the river’s two notes on another and the little silence between kept empty on a third, with no stroke supplied to agree any two (one hundred and eight), and the boy made nothing of the likeness to the examined grain and would not let it stand up as a gift; 266 stood exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody in Sarn, Sill and Grath, one hundred and two answers having become one hundred and eight and none a reach, the seventh year at its very end and still ungiven, Smoke 30 three mornings ahead and unbrought, the first firing of Frost far off, the file open with every tray parted and every gap left gap, and the hand laid back against the fold on the hundred and eighth answer while the count went forward into Smoke 28, a day that had not earned its heading (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082).}
\CRday{Day 267}{Smoke 28, Eighthday, Y.H. 813  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, hearth, loaf shelf’s low angle, kiln mouth and boards, the drying racks and cool stone at the rack end, the Clay Yard and its walked-around places, the yard well and bare trough, the lowest rack with its broken birth-slates, the pan’s gone round ring, the field’s empty place and the returning-line place on the worked strips, the terrace, the kindling, the flagstones, the Vail wheel-shed edge and its finger’s-width-open back room (not entered), the cold damper, the Debt Loft (heard only), and the clay road, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  the boy came into his two hundred and sixty-seventh day and six months and eighty-seven days with nobody saying so, the hand put down against the fold on the hundred and eighth answer as a tool put away, no bell, market or Cross on an Eighthday, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid two hundred and sixty-seven days with its payer unnamed, fire under the floor, river through the finger’s-width door and the boards’ four nails, four and a knot, keeping three counts in three places that did not become one because agreeing any two would want a payer and none stood to any, six hearings beside and never among with no seventh and none invented to fill the empty place, the heard bell beside the told and the told figure beside the paid with Smoke’s second arithmetic gone up the road in a locked box, Smoke 30 two mornings ahead and the first firing of Frost far off, both unbrought (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082); \CRday{Day 268}{Smoke 29, Ninthday, Y.H. 813  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, hearth, loaf shelf’s low angle, kiln mouth and boards, the drying racks and cool stone at the rack end, the Clay Yard and its walked-around places, the yard well and stone lip, the bare trough, the lowest rack with its broken birth-slates, the pan’s gone round ring, the field’s empty place and the returning-line place on the worked strips, the terrace, the kindling, the flagstones, the Vail wheel-shed edge and its finger’s-width-open back room (not entered), the cold damper, the Debt Loft (heard only), and the clay road at the going of the light, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  Smoke 29 came on its own morning, earned by that light and not brought into a day that had not earned it, the boy coming into his two hundred and sixty-eighth day and six months and eighty-eight days with nobody saying so, no bell, market or Cross on a Ninthday, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid two hundred and sixty-eight days with its payer unnamed, three counts in three places that did not become one, six hearings with no seventh and none invented to fill the empty place, the widow’s mark untouched because a rack, a well, a yard and a bed are not openings, Smoke 30 one morning ahead and the first firing of Frost far off, both unbrought (T071/T072, T088, T058/T079, T061/T082); \CRday{Day 269}{Smoke 30, Tenthday, Y.H. 813  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, hearth, loaf shelf’s low angle, kiln mouth and boards, the drying racks and cool stone at the rack end, the Clay Yard and its walked-around places, the yard well and bare trough, the lowest rack with its broken birth-slates, the pan’s gone round ring, the field’s empty place and the returning-line place on the worked strips, the kindling, the flagstones, the Vail wheel-shed edge and its finger’s-width-open back room (not entered), the cold damper, the Debt Loft (heard only), the clay road, the Cross, the moot-post’s finger’s width of shade, the reading block, the pot board, the north bridge and the out-of-line landing, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  Smoke 30 came on its own morning, earned by that light and not brought into a day that had not earned it, the boy coming into his two hundred and sixty-ninth day and six months and eighty-nine days with nobody in Sarn, Sill or Grath saying so, the third and last Account-day and market of the second firing with no fourth to spend and no further market in this chapter, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid two hundred and sixty-nine days with its payer unnamed, fire under the floor, river through the finger’s-width door and the boards’ four nails, four and a knot, keeping three counts in three places that did not become one, six hearings beside and never among with no seventh, the widow’s mark hanging where it hangs untouched at shelf, well, rack, road, basket, yard, market, morning, afternoon, dusk and going of the light because a market and a reading are not openings, and the first firing of Frost far off and unbrought (T071/T072, T088, T058/T079, T061/T082); one crust two inches off with its empty place unnamed and no third, the thread frozen, cold at cheek, temple and wrist, the afterdrop waiting, the surgeon taking the inventory as a field is taken in the order the wounds present themselves and entering none of it (T060/T086); Sella went to the hearth before the basket, told the coals the thaw, turned them with a broken pot at the kiln mouth, said The house will keep it, counted under her breath toward no opening, pushed the coal-black hair back with the burn-wrist so the grey streak showed pale, glanced once at the clay jar cold under its glaze and shut her hand half over nothing, kept her finger on top of the shelf’s front edge so the charcoal stayed unread, moved her lips along a two-gapped row without a figure, set the pot rim out with its handle two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, then carried him at the half-pace up the clay road and set the basket in the moot-post’s finger’s width of shade at the Cross where no slate lay, standing half a pace off through the reading and the bell and giving no instruction or reason to the basket (T100, T058/T079); two hundred leaned in over the reading block and eight pigs went over the wet boards while an assessor of Sill wrote the eight down before anybody could ask which eight he meant; Berr Clay came up short off the clay road with the red wool cord of his office folded square under his coat and the green of tasted lead glaze at one mouth-corner, wiped his thumb twice before touching nothing, passed a finger over the figure, held a narrow slate unopened to the forearm and read One in twelve, as the notice says low into the crowd twice over the basket, once for the moot and once for the households that came late, then called the levy and denied it with The levy is called. It is not called by me and your house, never I, and went off toward High Kiln with the box locked with the third true subtraction inside, believing he had done a kindness (T015/T041/T047); the district’s arithmetic changed for the third time in Smoke where two hundred people stood and could not be changed back, the printed figure stood unchallenged, the figure read was still not the figure paid and the price of the dressed grain covered under wool at the rack end stayed unsigned, and the boy kept the finding that a figure read a third time over the same basket is no nearer the covered thing than a chart over a covered body, that three readings are three and not one account and that the not-knowing is as complete after the third as after the first, on a place of its own with no payer, not a lesson, grievance or doctrine and not laid across the house’s not-doings, the grain or his own kept gaps (T077, T061/T082, T071/T072); before noon Hessa Rale went up the clay road toward Greybank with Berr’s narrow slate held edge-on to her forearm and the writing turned to her sleeve, her hand to the slate before her eyes to the crowd, answering the question put with I don’t read it. I carry it. There’s a difference, and the road doesn’t care which and Cross to Greybank. Reading goes up before noon. I’ve got a road to walk, no figure coming off the slate and her eighth record-first hand staying advanced and not paid (T080); below the north bridge the soft-cuffed Fishstairs clerk stayed set at the out-of-line landing for a measure nobody called with his slate inward and his hand to it before his eyes to the stalls, and nobody took him off (T090); the bell went over the market longer than a church bell, four, four and a gap, with nobody crossing himself, the heard bell kept beside the told bell of the Long Night and the gap not folded into the three counts under the roof, not heard as a seventh and not brought under any roof (T078, T061/T082); across the square the seventh green stayed a colour at a silent woman’s mouth at the pot board with a pale line on the back of one hand, and at the market’s edge the seventh shape stayed a shape in cast-offs with a man’s shoulders on a child’s frame and a green sliver at the throat that turned half a beat late toward a pot near the eel shade, no eighth of either, no name, no loaf, slate or sale and never Fenna or Ulda in the narration (T050/T051, T033/T034 held); the hand went up an inch toward the river’s low note and held for the small intake without borrowing the bell’s four, four and a gap, came down on the river’s next low note while the market and the bell’s gap went on where they were (one hundred and thirteen), and at the close in the small hours went up again, held for the small intake, the hold and the letting-go of one of the breaths counted in the room that does not touch, did not come down with that breath, kept the small height through the little silence after her count and went on past the river’s note to the one after it, carrying two of the house’s rhythms across the empty interval with no second house count borrowed and leaving the bell’s gap in the square with a finger between and no stroke supplied to agree any three (one hundred and fourteen), both filed on the sixth place with no payer named, exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air, not a reach, hearing, seventh, stopping, payment, held change, key, power or rule (T061/T082, T078, T071/T072); Sella carried him home at the going of the light at the half-pace, went wide around the seven places, set him on his bed under the roof and not in the Debt Loft, put the fold right without a look at his face, left the thread frozen, told the fire the thaw, turned the coals, said The house will keep it, counted under her breath toward no opening and went to her own bed, and no collector came up the clay road on Smoke 28, 29 or 30 and none went down it with the tile debt neither paid nor settled nor done with (T009/T013/T092); in the small hours he turned the file out on the towel and found it exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air --- six hearings with no seventh, three near-full answers, three pot sayings with the premature Smoke 14 note apart, four low things with water over water a fifth, told bell beside heard and told figure beside paid with Smoke’s third arithmetic gone up the road in a locked box and unread, nine stoppings with no tenth, three held changes plus the loft scrape, the pale line and the held inch on six places with the finding of the third reading on a place of its own, nine record-first hands with Ilva’s ninth on its own tray and her strip unread, the seventh green a colour and the seventh shape a shape with no eighth, the covered grain unfigured with the figure read over it not knowing its cost, the pan’s ring, the shelf’s two gaps and the fold’s one crust with its unnamed place on trays that do not touch, the row question at five askings with one shaping, no witness and no row named, and the house’s not-doings on a place apart from his own gaps with a finger between and no joining (T061/T082, T080 held, T101 held, T100, T077); 269 stood exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody in Sarn, Sill and Grath, one hundred and eight answers had become one hundred and fourteen and none was a reach, the seventh year stood at its very end and had still not given, Smoke went out without a boundary drawn and neither month-name corrected, Frost stood one morning ahead and was not reached for and the first firing of Frost (Day 271) was far off, and the file lay open on the towel with every tray parted and every gap left gap while the hand lay back against the fold on the hundred and fourteenth answer and the count went forward into Frost 1, a day that had not earned its heading (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082).}
\CRday{Day 270}{Frost 1, Firstday, Y.H. 813  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, hearth, loaf shelf’s low angle, kiln mouth and boards, the drying racks and the cool stone at the rack end, the Clay Yard and its walked-around places, the yard well and bare trough, the lowest rack with its broken birth-slates, the pan’s gone round ring, the field’s empty place and the returning-line place on the worked strips, the terrace, the kindling, the flagstones, the Vail wheel-shed edge and its finger’s-width-open back room (not entered), the cold damper, the Debt Loft (heard only), and the clay road, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  the boy came into his two hundred and seventieth day and six months and ninety days with nobody saying so, the hand laid down against the fold on the hundred and fourteenth answer as a tool put away where the next hand will find it without looking, no bell, market or Cross on a Firstday, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid two hundred and seventy days with its payer unnamed while fire under the floor, river through the finger’s-width door and the boards’ four nails, four and a knot kept three counts in three places that did not become one because agreeing any two would want a payer and none stood to any (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082); one stiff leathery brown-edged barley crust two inches off with its empty place unnamed and no third, the thread frozen unwiped, cold at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint, the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody would perform, the surgeon taking the inventory in its old order and entering none of it even on the place where he keeps the things he does not enter (T060/T086); Sella went to the hearth before the basket, told the coals the thaw, turned them with a broken pot, said The house will keep it, counted under her breath toward no opening, pushed coal-black hair back with the burn-wrist so the grey streak showed pale, kept her finger above the charcoal so the tally stayed unread, moved her lips along a two-gapped row without a figure, glanced once at the clay jar and shut her hand half over nothing, set the pot handle two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, carried him at the half-pace from every open slate and went wide around the clean dark line and the finer grey called the thaw, and left the widow’s mark hanging, touched once before the kiln on Smoke 1 and at no shelf, well, rack, road, basket, yard, morning, hearth or bed, the one touch that would come on the morrow’s kiln not brought early and not made a rehearsal or a sign (T058/T079, T100); the dressed grain lay covered and unfigured on the cool stone at the rack end with the space between the figure that would go over it and what it had cost unsigned, and Smoke’s third arithmetic lay behind unread up the clay road in Berr’s locked box with the figure read still not the figure paid (T077, T015/T041/T047); Ilva drew water at the well with the pail against her knee, clay pale in her nail crescents and rack dust in one thumb seam, kept her hand in her sleeve and answered Ask the pot what it cost. I keep the count, not the account, the boy filing no tenth record-first hand and the ninth staying nine with a finger between it and the eighth (T080 held); Garl was kept in objects with his name unspoken two hundred and seventy days, the salt-stiff coat, hollow wheel-seat, crackless proverb and uncalled tile debt intact, and no collector came up the clay road or went down it (T009/T013/T092); Tarn at the kindling had the knife at the very lip with six checkable and the seventh at the lip beside Garl’s unforged sentence, said Yes, house to early and late thaw and kept the late because it puts off the paying, told the wood Six counted. The next I don’t count, brought the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stopped there as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, drew the Seed 16 breath unspent, his chest tight, Ash in the knuckle creases, the pale clip-ring at the wrist, the loft stone cold and unreconciled, and his stroke over the bright patch without the half-check (T036/T076, T006); Jorra at the wheel-shed parted meal-fine dust from clean as a surgeon parts clot from vessel, spoke to the wheel and a pot before any person, withheld the note he knew three turns ahead, gave no name to the men who went low into the back room before first grey, held his bent finger in the cold damper ahead of Sella’s unfinished sentence, kept burned slate at four, shut-room tellings at two, three pot sayings with the premature Smoke 14 note apart, five askings with one shaping and no witness, he’s not Vail sealed and the promise neither given nor withdrawn (T035/T031/T062, T065/T095, T101, T064); the file turned out on the towel in the small hours was exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air, with six hearings no seventh, three near-full answers, nine stoppings no tenth, three held changes plus the loft scrape, the pale line and the held inch on six places with one hundred and fourteen answers, nine record-first hands with Ilva’s ninth unread, the seventh green a colour and the seventh shape a shape with no eighth, the finding of the third reading and the house’s not-doings on places of their own with a finger between, and the row question at five askings with one shaping and no witness (T061/T082, T080 held, T101 held, T100); the hand went up an inch for the small intake and down on the next low note, borrowing no house count (one hundred and fifteen), and carried one of the house’s rhythms across the little silence after a count in the other room and laid it there as an object without filling the silence or crossing a second count (one hundred and sixteen), both filed on the sixth place with no payer named, not a reach, hearing, seventh, stopping, payment, held change, key, power or rule (T061/T082); 270 stood exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody in Sarn, Sill and Grath, and the first firing of Frost stood one morning ahead, unbrought and not made a promise (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082).}
\CRday{Day 271}{Frost 2, Secondday, Y.H. 813  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, loaf shelf’s low angle, hearth, kiln mouth and boards, the drying racks and cool stone at the rack end, the Clay Yard and its walked-around places, the yard well and bare trough, the lowest rack with its broken birth-slates, the pan’s gone round ring, the field’s empty place and the returning-line place, the kindling, the flagstones, the Vail wheel-shed edge and its finger’s-width-open back room (not entered), the cold damper, the Debt Loft (heard only), and the clay road, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  the count crossed in the dark from two hundred and seventy to two hundred and seventy-one, six months and ninety-one days told by nobody, no market, Cross or bell on a Secondday, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid two hundred and seventy-one days with its payer unnamed, fire under the floor, river low over lower at the door and the boards’ four, four and a knot kept three counts in three places that did not become one, six hearings beside and never among with no seventh and none invented to fill the empty place, and the boy taking the body in its old order of crust, unnamed gap, frozen thread, cold and afterdrop and entering none of it (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082, T060/T086); \textbf{the chapter’s one meaningful change came at the kiln mouth in the first light:} Sella went there before the basket and before any word, with the carried coal in a clay dish under blind ash, and put her hand to the widow’s mark at her throat, held it one breath, let go and did not go back, lifted the clay lid with the back of her burn-hand with the fingers curled out of the way, and tipped the coal under the back of a broken pot; the fire took, answering four low pulls with the silence where the fifth should have stood and its payer unnamed two hundred and seventy-one days, and nobody praised the opening, nobody said what it mended, no slate was entered, no bond changed hands, no payer named and no lesson made (T058/T079 and T088 advanced, not paid); the boy read it as an opening and nothing more, the surgeon in him seeing a thing mended and not allowed by anybody, least of all himself, to call it mended, and he made no doctrine of four months’ openings and did not lay the three behind it across it to make a cause, for a cause wants a payer and none stood; Tarn’s seventh year stood at its very end and had still not given, the loft debt was neither settled nor named nor forgiven by the flame, and no tenth stopping stood up to keep the nine company; afterward she told the coals the thaw, turned them with a broken pot, said The house will keep it, counted toward no opening, kept her finger above the charcoal, moved her lips along a two-gapped row, glanced at the clay jar and shut her hand half over nothing, set the pot handle two inches out with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, put the fold right without a look at his face and left the thread frozen, giving every instruction to the fire, the wool, the pot, the broom and the running water and never to the basket, and she did not touch the mark again at a hearth or a shelf, for a hearth keeps a fire and a shelf is a shelf (T100); the dressed grain lay covered and unfigured on the cool stone at the rack end and the arithmetic that would read over it did not know what it cost, with the space between figure and price unsigned and Smoke’s third arithmetic still unread in Berr’s locked box up the clay road (T077, T015/T041/T047); the yard went around the seven walked-around places with a look and no number, including the returning-line place where a hand went in on Seed 15 and did not come out, carried and not named (T009/T013/T092, T098); Garl was kept in objects with his name unspoken two hundred and seventy-one days and no collector up or down the clay road; Tarn at the kindling kept six where the house could check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl’s unforged sentence, said Yes, house to early and late thaw and kept the late, brought the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stopped as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth, drew the Seed 16 breath unspent, his chest tight, Ash in the knuckles, the pale clip-ring at the wrist and the loft stone cold and unreconciled (T036/T076, T006); Jorra parted dusty forearms from clean, spoke to the wheel and a pot before any person, withheld the note he knew three turns ahead, held his bent finger in the cold damper ahead of Sella’s unfinished sentence, kept burned slate at four, shut-room tellings at two, three pot sayings with the premature note apart, five askings with one shaping and no witness, the promise ungiven and he’s not Vail sealed (T035/T031/T062, T065/T095, T101, T064); she turned the grain once beneath the wool for damp with a touch lighter than the day before and gave it no figure, and a wrong wind off High Kiln brought the sweet edge of lead glaze over the boards, touched the fold and went out on the wind that brought it, a direction arrived nowhere and no fourth likeness made a cause (T077, T064); below the sill a child’s foot that had stayed cold after the flood was wrapped in a woman’s wool and called the cold by her and weather by the yard, the extremity going before the core and the afterdrop waiting beyond, with no cause, silt-leach or cure named (T093/T094 carried); the heard bell in the square stood beside the told bell of the Long Night with its gap where it struck and was not brought under the roof or heard as a seventh of the full note (T078); the hand went up an inch, held for the hold of one of the breaths counted in the room that does not touch and came down before the letting-go, crossing no silence and supplying no fifth (one hundred and seventeen), and held through one whole interval of the river’s own going, borrowing no house count and taking nothing from the two-gapped row (one hundred and eighteen), both filed on the sixth place with no payer named and nothing promoted into a reach, hearing, seventh, stopping, payment, held change, key, power or rule (T061/T082); 271 stood exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody, six months and ninety-one days were told by nobody, the fire’s fifth was unpaid the same number of days, the lean quarter of its warmth stayed with its payer unnamed toward the far-off accounting of the Keeping, and Frost 3 waited in the dark beyond the door, unearned and not brought early (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082).}
\CRday{Day 272}{Frost 3, Thirdday, Y.H. 813  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, loaf shelf’s low angle, hearth, kiln mouth and boards, the drying racks and cool stone at the rack end, the Clay Yard and its walked-around places, the yard well and bare trough, the lowest rack with its broken birth-slates, the pan’s gone round ring, the field’s empty place and the returning-line place, the terrace, the kindling, the flagstones, the Vail wheel-shed edge and its finger’s-width-open back room (not entered), the cold damper, the Debt Loft (heard only), and the clay road at the going of the light, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  Frost came on its own morning, earned by the light in the door and not brought into a day that had not earned it, the count going from two hundred and seventy-one to two hundred and seventy-two the way a man lays one board beside another without measuring the seam, six months and ninety-two days told by nobody, no market, Cross or bell on a Thirdday, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid two hundred and seventy-two days with its payer unnamed, fire under the floor, river low over lower through the finger’s-width door and the boards’ four, four and a knot kept three counts in three places that agreed with nobody, six hearings beside and never among with no seventh, and the boy taking the body in its old order of crust, unnamed gap, frozen thread, cold and afterdrop and entering none of it, wanting the crust lifted and the want louder than the knowledge (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082, T060/T086); the first firing stood behind the household with no lesson, no sign, no mending anybody would name and no payer, and the boy made no doctrine of four months’ openings, keeping the not-making as a finding with no payer on a place of its own with a finger between it and the house’s not-doings and his own kept gaps (T058/T079, T061/T082); Sella went to the fire before the basket and before any instruction, said The house will keep it where another woman would have said I and the boy where another would have said my son, set the pot handle two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, kept her finger above the charcoal and her lips along a two-gapped row without a figure, put the fold right without a look at his face and left the thread where it was, and did not touch the widow’s mark at a morning, a hearth or a shelf, for none is an opening (T100, T058/T079); she lifted a corner of the wool on the cool stone at the rack end and turned the dressed grain once beneath it for damp with a touch lighter than the day before and set it back where it had lain, changed in state and given no figure, the space between figure and price unsigned and Smoke’s third arithmetic unread up the clay road in a thane’s locked box (T077, T015/T041/T047); she carried him at the half-pace and went wide around the seven places with a look and no number, including the returning-line place where the hand went in on Seed 15 and did not come out, and the yard went around the same places in the afternoon the way a woman carries a full pail (T009/T013/T092, T098); Garl was kept in objects with his name unspoken two hundred and seventy-two days, the salt coat, hollow wheel-seat and crackless proverb intact and the tile debt neither paid nor settled nor done with, and no collector came up the clay road on Frost 1, 2 or 3 and none went down it (T009/T013/T092); Tarn at the kindling kept six where the house could check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl’s unforged sentence, said Yes, house to early and late thaw and kept the late because it puts off the paying, brought the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stopped there as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, drew the Seed 16 breath unspent, his chest tight, Ash in the knuckle creases, the pale clip-ring at the wrist, the warm stone cold and unreconciled in its loft pot and the sill scrape on its own place, and his stroke over the bright patch without the half-check (T036/T076, T006); three or more men went low into the back room before first grey and got no name from Jorra, who parted meal-fine dust from clean, told a pot You’ll do and the wheel it did not care whose hands, withheld the full note he knew three turns ahead, held his bent finger in the cold damper ahead of Sella’s unfinished sentence, kept burned slate at four, shut-room tellings at two, three pot sayings with the premature Smoke 14 note apart, five askings with one shaping and no witness, the promise ungiven and he’s not Vail sealed (T035/T031/T062, T065/T095, T101); the file was turned out on the towel in the small hours and found exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air, six hearings no seventh, three near-full answers, nine stoppings no tenth, three held changes plus the loft scrape and the pale line, the held inch on a sixth place with one hundred and twenty answers, Ilva’s ninth hand with her strip unread and no tenth, the seventh green a colour and the seventh shape a shape with no eighth, the covered grain unfigured, the pan’s ring, the shelf’s two gaps and the fold’s one crust on trays that do not touch, the five askings with one shaping and no witness, and the house’s not-doings apart from his own gaps with a finger between (T061/T082, T080 held, T101 held, T100, T077); the hand went up an inch, took the small intake and hold of a woman’s low counting from the room whose floor did not touch his and came down before that count’s letting-go, leaving the little silence after it whole and empty, crossed by no rhythm and filled by no stroke and made into no gift, hearing, sixth of anything or payment (one hundred and nineteen), and in the small hours went up again, held past that letting-go and through the little silence, set the held interval and the empty interval side by side on the sixth place with a finger between and neither made to agree with the fifth missing under the floor, borrowed no house count, supplied no fifth to the kiln, crossed no silence that did not belong to the river and came down on the river’s next low note (one hundred and twenty), both filed with no payer named, exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air, the restraint the whole of the day’s event and not promoted (T061/T082); at the going of the light Sella carried him up, set him on his bed under the roof and not in the Debt Loft, put the fold right without a look at his face, told the fire the thaw, turned the coals with a broken pot, said The house will keep it, counted toward no opening and went off, the mark hanging where it hangs; 272 stood exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody in Grath and Sill, six months and ninety-two days were told by nobody, the fire’s fifth was unpaid the same number of days, the heard bell stood beside the told, the seventh year stood at its very end and still ungiven, the loan stood uncalled in the ruts, and nothing had been opened, named, called, paid or ended on this Thirdday; Frost went toward its fourth morning without a boundary drawn and without a lesson made of four months’ openings, the next opening standing far off in a later month’s first firing, and Frost 4 waited in the dark beyond the door, unearned and not brought early (T071/T072, T088, T058/T079, T061/T082).}
\CRday{Day 273}{Frost 4, Fourthday, Y.H. 813  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, hearth, loaf shelf’s low angle, kindling and boards, the drying racks and cool stone at the rack end, the Clay Yard and its walked-around places, the yard well with frost fronds on its stone lip, the bare trough, the lowest rack with its broken birth-slates, the pan’s gone round ring, the field’s empty place and the returning-line place on the worked strips, the flagstones with the shallow bright patch, the Vail wheel-shed edge and its finger’s-width-open back room (not entered), the cold damper, the Debt Loft (heard only), and the clay road, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  Frost 4 came on its own light, earned by that morning and not brought into a day that had not earned it, the boy coming into his two hundred and seventy-third day and six months and ninety-three days with nobody saying so, no market, Cross or bell on a Fourthday, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid two hundred and seventy-three days with its payer unnamed, fire under the floor, river low over lower at the finger’s-width door and the boards’ four nails, four and a knot keeping three counts in three places that did not become one because agreeing any two would want a payer and none stood to any, the heard bell’s four, four and a gap staying in the square beside the told bell of the Long Night and not folded in, six hearings beside and never among with no seventh and none invented to fill the empty place, and Frost 10 six mornings ahead and unbrought (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082, T078); one stiff leathery brown-edged barley crust lay two inches from his ear with its empty place unnamed and no third, the thread froze unwiped in the dry heat, cold stopped at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint, the afterdrop waited past a warming nobody would perform, the surgeon taking the inventory in its old order and entering none of it even on the place where he keeps the things he does not enter, wanting the crust lifted and knowing a cold patient cannot clot, both true with the second louder (T060/T086); Sella went to the fire before the basket and gave no instruction to the basket, told the coals it was the thaw, turned them with the back of a broken pot, said The house will keep it where another woman would have said I, counted under her breath toward no opening, pushed coal-black hair back with the burn-wrist so the grey streak showed pale off the coals, kept her finger on top of the shelf’s front edge so the charcoal stayed unread, moved her lips along a two-gapped row without a figure, glanced once at the clay jar cold under its lead glaze and shut her hand half over nothing, set the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, carried him at the half-pace and went wide around the seven places with a look and a wide step and no number, and turned the dressed grain once beneath the wool for damp with a lighter touch and gave it no figure so the arithmetic to come would not know what it cost (T058/T079, T100, T077); the widow’s mark hung where it hung, touched once before the kiln on Frost 2 and at no morning, hearth, shelf, well, rack, road, basket, yard, afternoon, dusk or going of the light, and the first firing of Frost stood behind the household with no lesson, sign, mending anybody would name or payer, four openings being four and not a rule and the next standing in a later month’s first firing, far off (T058/T079); a woman come up from the strips with a pot asked what the keeping and storing would take now the grain was under wool and the visits coming and was sent to the pot and the weather, nothing priced, refused or entered, and a man come down the clay road with dried pale scurf of mud on his coat skirt brought a number up out of a fist toward the well, looked at it and put it back into his sleeve so the figure arrived nowhere, a figure read still not the figure paid (T015/T041/T047 held); a wrong wind off High Kiln brought the sweet edge of lead glaze over the boards, touched the fold and went out on the wind that brought it, a direction arrived nowhere and no fourth likeness made a cause (T064); the yard went around the seven walked-around places including the returning-line hand that went in on Seed 15 and did not come out, carried and not named, not paid and not joined to the shelf’s two gaps, the fold’s one crust or the dressed grain (T009/T013/T092, T098 carried); Garl was kept in objects with his name unspoken two hundred and seventy-three days, the salt-stiff coat, hollow wheel-seat, crackless proverb and uncalled tile debt intact, and no collector came up or went down the clay road (T009/T013/T092); Tarn took the broom only after it was instructed, said Yes, house to early and late thaw and kept the late because it puts off the paying, kept six where the house could check and the seventh at the very lip of the kindling sill beside Garl’s unforged sentence, told the wood Six counted. The next I don’t count, brought the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stopped there as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, drew the Seed 16 breath unspent, his chest tight, Ash worked into the knuckle creases, the pale clip-ring at his wrist, the loft stone cold and unreconciled, and his stroke over the bright patch without the half-check (T036/T076, T006); before first grey men whose names the house did not take went low into the back room and Jorra came through with meal-fine grey slate dust ground small as meal past the bent finger and white in a fist that had opened, parted dusty forearms from clean as a surgeon parts clot from vessel, spoke to the wheel before any person, told a pot You’ll do, withheld the full note he knew three turns ahead, put his bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella’s unfinished sentence, kept burned slate at four, shut-room tellings at two, three pot sayings with the premature Smoke 14 note apart, five askings with one shaping and no witness, and the promise neither given nor withdrawn (T035/T031/T062, T065/T095, T101); in the small hours the file was turned out on the towel and found exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air, six hearings no seventh, nine stoppings no tenth, nine record-first hands with Ilva’s ninth unread, the held interval and empty interval side by side on the sixth place with a finger between, and every gap left gap; the hand went up an inch toward the river’s note, took the small intake of a count from the room whose floor does not touch his, held it and came down on the river’s next low note, borrowing no house count and supplying no fifth (one hundred and twenty-one), and took the intake and hold of one of those counted breaths and came down before its letting-go, leaving the little silence after it whole and empty on a place of its own, not crossed and not filled (one hundred and twenty-two), both filed on the sixth place, exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air, not reaches, hearings, sevenths, stoppings, payments, held changes, keys, powers or rules and not allowed to stand up as gifts; 273 stood exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody in Sarn, Sill and Grath, six months and ninety-three days were told by nobody, the fire’s fifth was unpaid the same number of days, the heard bell stood beside the told, the seventh year stood at its very end and still ungiven, and the loan stood uncalled in the ruts (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082).}
\CRday{Day 274}{Frost 5, Fifthday, Y.H. 813  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, hearth, loaf shelf’s low angle, boards and kindling, the Clay Yard and its walked-around places, the yard well with heavier rime on its stone lip, the bare trough, the lowest rack with its broken birth-slates, the pan’s gone round ring, the field’s empty place and the returning-line place, the drying racks and cool stone at the rack end, the flagstones, the Vail wheel-shed edge and its finger’s-width-open back room (not entered), the cold damper, the Debt Loft (heard only), and the clay road, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  Frost 5 came on its own morning, earned by that light and not brought into a day that had not earned it, the boy coming into his two hundred and seventy-fourth day and six months and ninety-four days with nobody saying so, no market, Cross or bell on a Fifthday, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid two hundred and seventy-four days with its payer unnamed, three counts in three places that did not become one, the heard bell’s gap in the square not folded in, six hearings with no seventh, Frost 10 five mornings ahead and unbrought, the house smelling of hot clay cooled under tallow, wet wool and the sour mineral breath of the unswept corner called the thaw, and the boy taking the body in its old order of crust, unnamed gap, frozen thread, cold and waiting and entering none of it (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082, T060/T086); Sella’s grammar held exactly, fire before basket, instruction to the fire, the wool, the pot, the broom and the running water and never to the basket, The house will keep it where another woman would have said I, the pot rim two inches out with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, the fold put right without a look at his face, the thread left frozen, her finger on top of the shelf’s front edge, her lips along a two-gapped row with no figure, the mark untouched at a morning, a hearth, a rack and a basket because none is an opening, and the dressed grain turned once beneath the wool for damp with a lighter touch and given no figure while Smoke’s third arithmetic stayed unread in Berr’s locked box up the clay road, the figure read still not the figure paid (T058/T079, T100, T077, T015/T041/T047); \textbf{the chapter’s one meaningful change, advanced and not paid:} standing with her back to the basket and moving her lips along the two-gapped row, Sella’s finger went beneath the front edge where the charcoal tally lay and stayed for the length of two of the breaths she counts, where on Day 166 it stayed for one, then came away without looking, without a word and without going back, the charcoal not read, copied, counted or joined to the gaps above; the boy read the two breaths as a surgeon reads a small change in a field and filed the returned held beat on the shelf’s own place beside the Day 161 fraction, the Day 166 held beat and the Tallow 22 flagstone half-check, not as a new place, not as a fourth likeness standing up as a cause, not a reading, not a payment, not a gift, no payer named (T100 advanced, NOT paid, T061/T082); Ilva was glimpsed once at the yard well drawing with the pail against her knee, clay dried pale in her nail crescents and fine grey rack dust worked into the seam of one thumb which she did not scrub out, her hand going toward her sleeve and staying there, the notched birch not taken out, read, asked about or taken a figure from and not joined to the charcoal, the cord, the knots, the pages, the tins, the missing hand or the pale line, her eyes going to the asker before her mouth answered the question put and not the one behind it --- Ask the pot what it cost. I keep the count, not the account --- and nobody turning twice, so the boy filed no tenth record-first hand and the ninth stayed nine with a finger between it and the eighth, she not knowing she was read (T080 held); a woman with a pot asking what the month’s firings had taken went off level with her question still on her, nothing priced, refused or entered; Tarn’s stroke went over the bright patch without the half-check, the loft scrape and the carried man’s pale line staying on their own places, three or more men going low into the back room before first grey and getting no name, Jorra parting dusty forearms from clean and asking no question that would join the dust to a cause, keeping burned slate at four, shut-room tellings at two, three pot sayings with the premature note apart, five askings with one shaping and no witness, and the promise ungiven (T035/T031/T062, T065/T095, T101); the row question gained no sixth asking and no second shaping, the pan’s gone ring, the two shelf gaps, the fold’s one crust, the field’s empty place and the returning-line hand stayed on separate trays with no third gap and no fourth likeness made a cause, and a child’s foot below the sill stayed wrapped in wool, called the cold by her and weather by the yard, with no cause, silt-leach or cure named (T093/T094); Tarn kept six where the house could check and the seventh at the lip of the sill beside Garl’s unforged sentence, said Yes, house and Six counted. The next I don’t count, stopped the ear-sentence at the word that would call the loan as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, drew the Seed 16 breath unspent, his chest tight, Ash in the knuckle creases, the pale clip-ring at his wrist, the warm stone cold and unreconciled in its loft pot, and no collector up or down the clay road (T036/T076, T006); in the small hours the hand went up an inch, took the small intake and hold of a counted breath, stayed past its letting-go and through the little silence and came down on the river’s next low note, carrying one of the house’s rhythms across the interval with no second house count borrowed and no fifth supplied (one hundred and twenty-three), and then took the small intake of one counted breath and the small intake of the next and held the two intakes apart with a finger between, the letting-go between them left where it was and no rhythm made out of the two (one hundred and twenty-four), both filed on the sixth place, exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air, not reaches, hearings, sevenths, stoppings, payments, held changes, keys, powers, doctrines or rules and not promoted into gifts; 274 stood exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody, six months and ninety-four days were told by nobody, the fire’s fifth was unpaid the same number of days, the count in wood stayed in wood, and nothing had been opened, named, called, paid or ended on this Fifthday (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082).}
\CRday{Day 275}{Frost 6, Sixthday, Y.H. 813  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, hearth, loaf shelf’s low angle, boards and kindling, the Clay Yard and its walked-around places, the yard well with rime on the step, the bare trough, the lowest rack with its broken birth-slates, the pan’s gone round ring, the field’s empty place and the returning-line place, the drying racks and cool stone at the rack end, the flagstones, the Vail wheel-shed edge and its finger’s-width-open back room (not entered), the cold damper, the Debt Loft (heard only), and the clay road at the going of the light, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  Frost 6 came on its own morning, earned by the light at the finger’s-width door and not brought into a day that had not earned it, the count going from two hundred and seventy-four to two hundred and seventy-five the way a man lays one board beside another without measuring the seam, six months and ninety-five days told by nobody, no market, Cross or bell on a Sixthday, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid two hundred and seventy-five days with its payer unnamed, rime on the step and the river low over lower under the finger’s-width door, three counts in three places that did not become one, six hearings with no seventh, and the boy taking the body in its old order of crust, unnamed gap, frozen thread, cold and afterdrop and entering none of it, wanting the crust lifted with the want louder than the knowledge (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082, T060/T086); Sella’s grammar held through the week, fire before basket, instruction to fire, wool, pot, broom and running water and never to the basket, The house will keep it, the pot rim two inches out with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, the fold put right without a look at his face, the thread left frozen, her finger kept on top of the shelf’s front edge so the charcoal stayed unread, uncopied and unfigured, her lips along a two-gapped row with no figure, one glance at the clay jar and her hand shut half over nothing, the grey streak pale off the coals, and the mark not touched at a hearth, shelf, rack, yard, basket or morning because none is an opening, the two held breaths of the Fifthday staying where they were laid and not standing up as a rule (T058/T079, T100); the dressed grain was turned once more beneath the wool with a lighter touch and given no figure, the arithmetic to come not knowing what it cost and the space between figure and price unsigned, the first firing of Frost not looked at again as sign, lesson, mending or payment, four openings being four and not a rule, the household’s refusal to make a doctrine of its own openings kept as a finding with no payer and a finger between it and the house’s not-doings and his own gaps, and Frost 10 four mornings ahead and unbrought (T077, T058/T079, T061/T082); Garl was kept in objects with his name unspoken two hundred and seventy-five days, the salt-stiff coat, hollow wheel-seat, crackless proverb and uncalled tile debt intact and worse for being uncalled, no collector coming up or down the clay road on Frost 4, 5 or 6 (T009/T013/T092); the yard went around the seven walked-around places with a look and a wide step and no number, the returning-line hand carried and not named, seven being seven and not an account (T098); Tarn took the broom only after it was instructed, said Yes, house to early and late thaw and kept the late, kept six where the house could check and the seventh at the lip where it could not, told the wood Six counted. The next I don’t count, brought the ear-sentence to the calling word and stopped as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, drew the Seed 16 breath unspent, his chest tight, Ash in the knuckle creases, the pale clip-ring at his wrist, the loft scrape coming as a sound with a direction from above and behind, the loft stone cold and unreconciled and not laid across the shelf’s returned beat, his stroke over the bright patch without the half-check (T036/T076, T006); Jorra parted dusty forearms from clean as a surgeon parts clot from vessel, spoke to the wheel and a pot before any person, withheld the note he knew three turns ahead, put his bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella’s unfinished sentence, gave no name to the men who went low into the back room before first grey, kept burned slate at four, shut-room tellings at two, three pot sayings with the premature Smoke 14 note apart, five askings with one shaping and no witness, and the promise neither given nor withdrawn, he’s not Vail sealed (T035/T031/T062, T065/T095, T101); in the small hours the hand went up an inch, took the small intake and hold of a counted breath and came down on the river’s next low note while that count was still letting go, the letting-go left outside the holding and entered nowhere, a separation made by ending early and not by filling, and not called a freedom because nobody there could take anything (one hundred and twenty-five), and at the close went up again, took the small intake and hold, stayed past the letting-go and through the little silence, set the held interval and the empty interval side by side with a finger between, borrowed no house count, supplied no fifth, took nothing from the two-gapped row, the charcoal or the covered grain and came down on the river’s next low note (one hundred and twenty-six), both filed on the sixth place, exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air, not reaches, hearings, sevenths, stoppings, payments, held changes, keys, powers, doctrines, freedoms or rules, and not allowed to stand up as gifts; the file lay open on the towel with every gap left gap and every tray parted from its neighbour, and 275 stood exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody in Sarn, Sill and Grath, six months and ninety-five days were told by nobody, the fire’s fifth was unpaid the same number of days, the heard bell stood beside the told, the seventh year stood at its very end and still ungiven, the loan stood uncalled in the ruts, nothing had been opened, named, called, paid or ended on this Sixthday, and Frost went on toward its seventh morning without a boundary drawn, the river’s low note going quiet after the hand came down (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082).}
\CRday{Day 276}{Frost 7, Seventhday, Y.H. 813  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, loaf shelf’s low angle, hearth, boards and finger’s-width door, the Clay Yard and its walked-around places, the yard well and trough bare and dark, the drying racks and cool stone at the rack end, the lowest rack with its broken birth-slates, the pan’s gone round ring, the field’s empty place and the returning-line place on the worked strips, the kindling, the flagstones with the shallow bright patch, the Vail wheel-shed edge and its finger’s-width-open back room (not entered), the cold damper, the Debt Loft (heard only), and the clay road, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  Frost 7 came on its own light, earned by that morning and not brought into a day that had not earned it, no market, Cross or bell on a Seventhday, the count crossing from two hundred and seventy-five to two hundred and seventy-six the way a board laid beside a board gives a dry knock and asks nothing of the seam, six months and ninety-six days told by nobody, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid two hundred and seventy-six days with its payer unnamed, fire under the floor, river low over lower at the finger’s-width door and the boards’ four nails, four and a knot keeping three counts in three places that did not become one because agreeing any two would want a payer and none stood to any, the heard bell’s four, four and a gap staying in the square beside the told bell of the Long Night and not folded in, six hearings beside and never among with no seventh and none invented to fill the emptiness, Frost 10 three mornings ahead and unbrought, and the boy taking the body in its old order of crust, unnamed gap, frozen thread, cold and afterdrop and entering none of it even on the place where he keeps the things he does not enter, the surgeon’s clean satisfaction at an exact coordination checked by the boy’s louder want of the crust and the checking not called a virtue (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082, T060/T086, T078); Sella went to the fire before the basket, told the coals the thaw, turned them with the back of a broken pot, said The house will keep it where another woman would have said I, counted under her breath toward no opening, pushed coal-black hair back with the burn-wrist so the grey streak showed pale, kept her finger on top of the shelf’s front edge so the charcoal stayed unread, uncopied and unfigured, moved her lips along a two-gapped row with no figure, glanced once at the clay jar and shut her hand half over nothing, set the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, put the fold right without a look at his face and left the thread frozen, giving every instruction to the fire, the wool, the pot, the broom and the running water and never to the basket, and the widow’s mark hanging where it hangs, touched once before the kiln on Frost 2 and at no morning or hearth on Frost 7 because neither is an opening (T058/T079, T100); the dressed grain lay covered and unfigured on the cool stone at the rack end, turned once beneath the wool for damp with a lighter touch, the space between figure and price unsigned and Smoke’s third arithmetic unread up the clay road in Berr’s locked box, the figure read still not the figure paid (T077, T015/T041/T047); Garl was kept in objects with his name unspoken two hundred and seventy-six days, the salt-stiff coat, hollow wheel-seat, crackless proverb and uncalled tile debt intact and worse for being uncalled, and no collector came up the clay road or went down it (T009/T013/T092); the yard went around the seven walked-around places with a look and a wide step and no number, the rope stiffening in the cold and the trough taking a skin at its edges but neither named, and the returning-line hand carried and not named, seven being seven and not an account (T009/T013/T092, T098, T083/T085 planted); a woman come up from the strips with a pot asked what the keeping and the storing would take now the grain was under wool and the visits coming and was sent to the pot and the weather with nothing priced, refused or entered, the visits left as visits with no date and no market named (T015/T041/T047 held); Tarn took the broom only after it was instructed, said Yes, house to early and late thaw and kept the late because it puts off the paying, told the wood Six counted. The next I don’t count, brought the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stopped there as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, drew the Seed 16 breath unspent, his chest tight, Ash in the knuckle creases, the pale clip-ring at his wrist, the loft stone cold and unreconciled, and his stroke over the bright patch without the half-check (T036/T076, T006); three or more men went low into the back room before first grey and got no name from the house, and Jorra came through with meal-fine slate dust past the bent finger, parted dusty forearms from clean as a surgeon parts clot from vessel, spoke to the wheel and a pot before any person, withheld the full note he knew three turns ahead, put his bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella’s unfinished sentence, kept burned slate at four, shut-room tellings at two, three pot sayings with the premature Smoke 14 note apart, five askings with one further shaping and no witness, the promise neither given nor withdrawn and he’s not Vail sealed (T035/T031/T062, T065/T095, T101, T064); in the small hours the hand went up an inch, took the small intake of the river’s own going and carried it across the little silence after one of the counted breaths in the next room with no house count borrowed and no fifth supplied, one house rhythm carried across the river’s interval (one hundred and twenty-seven), and in the afternoon went up again, took the hold of one counted breath and came down on the river’s note while that count was still letting go, leaving the letting-go and the little silence after it whole and outside the holding, an ending made early and not a freedom because nobody under the roof had taken anything (one hundred and twenty-eight), both filed on the sixth place, exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air, not reaches, hearings, sevenths, stoppings, payments, held changes, keys, powers, doctrines, freedoms or rules, and not allowed to stand up as gifts; 276 stood exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody in Sarn, Sill and Grath, six months and ninety-six days were told by nobody, the fire’s fifth was unpaid the same number of days, the file lay open on the towel with every gap left gap, and nothing had been opened, named, called, paid or ended on this Seventhday, Frost going on toward its eighth morning without a boundary drawn and the next opening standing far off in a later month’s first firing (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082).}
\CRday{Day 277}{Frost 8, Eighthday, Y.H. 813  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, loaf shelf’s low angle, hearth and boards, the Clay Yard and its walked-around places, the yard well with the stayed white fronds on its north lip, the trough taking a skin, the drying racks and cool stone at the rack end, the lowest rack with its broken birth-slates, the pan’s gone round ring, the field’s empty place and the returning-line place, the flagstones with the shallow bright patch, the Vail wheel-shed edge and its finger’s-width-open back room (not entered), the cold damper, the Debt Loft (heard only), and the clay road, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  Frost 8 came on its own morning, earned by the light at the finger’s-width door and not brought into a day that had not earned it, no market, Cross or bell on an Eighthday, the bell’s four, four and a gap kept in the square beside the told bell with nobody crossing himself, the count going from two hundred and seventy-six to two hundred and seventy-seven, six months and ninety-seven days told by nobody, the fire’s fifth unpaid two hundred and seventy-seven days with its payer unnamed, rime lying heavier on the step, three counts in three places that did not become one, six hearings with no seventh, and the boy taking the body in its old order of crust, unnamed gap, frozen thread, cold and afterdrop and entering none of it (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082, T060/T086, T078); Sella’s grammar held exactly, fire before basket, instruction to fire, wool, pot, broom and running water and never the basket, The house will keep it, the pot rim two inches out with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, the fold put right without a look at his face, the thread left frozen, her finger on top of the shelf’s front edge so the charcoal stayed unread, her lips along a two-gapped row with no figure, one glance at the clay jar and her hand shut half over nothing, the widow’s mark untouched at a morning, a hearth and a rack because none is an opening, and the dressed grain turned once beneath the wool for damp and given no figure while Smoke’s third arithmetic stayed unread in Berr’s locked box up the clay road, the figure read still not the figure paid (T058/T079, T100, T077, T015/T041/T047); \textbf{the chapter’s one meaningful change, advanced and not paid:} the white fronds Frost wrote on the north lip of the well did not go when the sun came up, as they had gone by noon on Frost 4, and stood fine and stacked like the little branches of a burnt tree after a bucket knocked one edge into grey meal;
