a woman said Weather and went on with her pail, another said It’ll go and did not say when, nobody put a figure on drawing a bucket through it, and the white was still there at noon and in the afternoon and past the going of the light; the rope stiffened in the hand until a woman made two pulls of one pull, the trough took a skin at its edges thin as the film on a pot set off the coals, and the coals were banked an hour earlier at the going of the light with nobody giving the hour a name, each shift set on its own place and entered nowhere, and the nearness of Frost 10 not paying it (T083/T085 advanced, NOT paid); the boy set the stayed white beside the white that had gone by noon on Frost 4 and beside the wrong wind’s sweet edge of lead glaze off High Kiln on Frost 2 that touched the fold and went out on the wind that brought it, three objects on three places with a finger between, writing no cause across any two, the surgeon noting a surface laid over a depth and the boy wanting the crust lifted, the noting bought nothing and the wanting louder (T061/T082, T064); Ilva came for water with the pail against her knee, clay dried pale in her nail crescents and fine grey rack dust worked into the seam of one thumb which she did not scrub out, her hand going toward her sleeve and staying there, the notched birch not taken out, read, asked about or taken a figure from and not joined to the charcoal, the cord, the knots, the pages, the tins, the missing hand or the pale line, her eyes going to the asker before her mouth answered the question put and not the one behind it --- Ask the pot what it cost. I keep the count, not the account --- and nobody turning twice, so the boy filed no tenth record-first hand and the ninth stayed nine with a finger between it and the eighth, she not knowing she was read (T080 held); the shallow bright patch lay where it had lain since Seed 22 and the broom went over it without the half-check, the loft scrape and the carried man’s pale line staying on their own places, Jorra keeping dusty forearms from clean and asking no question that would join the dust to a cause, the damper one iron with two bites, the back room its finger’s width of open and its low voices with no name given to the men, burned slate at four, shut-room tellings at two, three pot sayings with the premature Smoke 14 note apart, and no sixth asking coming over the boards, the silence a keeping and not a sixth witness (T035/T031/T062, T065/T095, T101); in the small hours the hand went up an inch, held one intake of a counted breath from the room whose floor does not touch and held the next intake after it with a finger between, the letting-go of the first left where it was and neither intake made to agree with the fifth missing under the floor (one hundred and twenty-nine), and in the afternoon went up again, took the small intake of one counted breath and the hold of the next and bridged the two over the river’s low note, no house count borrowed for the bridge (one hundred and thirty), both filed on the sixth place, exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air, not reaches, hearings, sevenths, stoppings, payments, freedoms, keys, powers, doctrines or rules and not allowed to stand up as gifts; Sella carried him up at the going of the light, set him on his bed under the roof and not in the Debt Loft, put the fold right without a look, left the thread frozen, told the fire the thaw, banked the coals an hour early and went off without explaining the count; 277 stood exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody, six months and ninety-seven days were told by nobody, the fire’s fifth was unpaid the same number of days, and nothing had been opened, named, called, paid or ended on this Eighthday, the frost going on toward its ninth morning without a boundary drawn.}
\CRday{Day 278}{Frost 9, Ninthday, Y.H. 813  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, loaf shelf’s low angle, hearth, boards and finger’s-width door, the Clay Yard and its walked-around places, the yard well with the stayed white on its north lip and the flat stone where the plate of ice was set, the trough skinned over, the drying racks and cool stone at the rack end, the lowest rack with its broken birth-slates, the pan’s gone round ring, the field’s empty place and the returning-line place, the flagstones with the shallow bright patch, the Vail wheel-shed edge and its finger’s-width-open back room (not entered), the cold damper, the Debt Loft (heard only), and the clay road, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  Frost 9 came on its own morning, earned by the thin white light over the sill and not brought into the day before it, a Ninthday with no market, Cross, bell or reading, Frost 10 standing one morning ahead and not brought early and no figure from the reading reaching any hour of this day, the count carried across exact, two hundred and seventy-eight days and six months and ninety-eight days told by nobody, the fire’s fifth unpaid two hundred and seventy-eight days with its payer unnamed, rime heavier on the step than on the two mornings gone, the river running low over lower under the door, three counts in three places that did not become one, six hearings with no seventh, the heard bell in the square beside the told bell, and the boy taking the body in its old order of crust, unnamed gap, frozen thread, cold and afterdrop and entering none of it (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082, T060/T086, T078); Sella had gone to the fire before the basket, told the coals the thaw, turned them with a broken pot, said The house will keep it, kept her finger on top of the shelf’s front edge so the charcoal stayed unread, moved her lips along a two-gapped row with no figure, glanced once at the clay jar and shut her hand half over nothing, stood the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, put the fold right without a look at his face, left the thread frozen, and did not touch the widow’s mark at a morning, hearth, rack or basket because none is an opening (T058/T079, T100); the stayed frost lay on the north lip of the well and the trough had skinned over from edge to edge in the two days of it, and Sella went to the trough with the back of the broken pot, pressed the flat of it to the skin and heard it give with a thin dry sound, lifted a plate of ice clear at the rim and clouded where the silt had risen into it, set it on a flat stone beside the well where no foot went, and drew what the yard called weather, telling the weather where to stand, giving nobody a figure and saying nothing to the basket; the boy watched the lifting as a membrane taken off a collection, a surface laid over a depth, and kept the broken plate on a place of its own beside the stayed frost and the white fronds of Frost 4, not joined to the two gaps above the shelf, the fold’s one crust and its empty place or the field’s empty place, no third gap and no fourth likeness made a cause, the surgeon’s knowing and the yard’s weather-word on two places with a finger between and neither laid across the other (T083/T085 advanced, NOT paid, T060/T086, T061/T082); the dressed grain was turned a second time that morning because the cool stone had gone cold under two days of stayed frost, lifted with a lighter touch than the morning before and laid back under the wool and given no figure, Smoke’s third arithmetic staying unread up the clay road in Berr’s locked box, the figure read still not the figure paid and no signature on the space between, the arithmetic that would read over it on the morrow not knowing what it cost (T077, T015/T041/T047); the first firing of Frost stood behind the household and she did not look at it again, no lesson, sign, mending or payer made of it, four openings being four and not a rule and the next standing in a later month’s first firing, far off (T058/T079); Garl stayed in objects with his name unspoken two hundred and seventy-eight days, the salt coat, hollow wheel-seat, clean dark line with the finer grey thaw beside it unswept, crackless proverb and uncalled tile debt intact, and no collector came up the clay road on Frost 7, 8 or 9 and none went down it, the yard going around the seven walked-around places with a look and no number and the returning-line hand carried and not named (T009/T013/T092, T098); Tarn kept six in the worn thumb-mark where the house could check and the seventh at the very lip beside Garl’s unforged sentence, said Six counted. The next I don’t count, brought the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stopped as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, drew the Seed 16 breath unspent, his chest tight, Ash in the knuckle creases, the pale clip-ring at his wrist, the loft stone cold and unreconciled by not trying, which is not forgiveness, and his stroke over the bright patch without the half-check (T036/T076, T006); Jorra stood a moment at the shed edge with meal-fine dust past the bent finger, parted dusty forearms from clean, spoke to the wheel and a pot before any person, withheld the full note he knew three turns ahead, kept his bent finger in the cold damper, gave the back-room men no name, kept burned slate at four, shut-room tellings at two, three pot sayings with the premature Smoke 14 note apart and the row at five askings with one shaping and no witness, the promise neither given nor withdrawn and he’s not Vail sealed (T035/T031/T062, T065/T095, T101, T064); toward the going of the morning the hand went up an inch, stayed past the letting-go of one counted breath and through the little silence after it, set the held interval beside the empty interval with a finger between and came down on the river’s next low note before that note had fairly begun, an ending made early kept whole outside the intakes it had crossed (one hundred and thirty-one), and in the small hours the file was turned out on the towel as instruments are turned out for a night a man will not be called to --- six hearings with no seventh, heard bell beside told, three pot sayings with the premature Smoke 14 note apart, burned slate at four, shut-room tellings at two, five askings with one shaping and no witness, nine stoppings with no tenth, nine hands with Ilva’s ninth unread, the seventh green a colour and the seventh shape a shape, Smoke’s arithmetic locked and the grain covered and unfigured --- and the hand took the small intake of the river’s own going and the hold of one counted breath, set them side by side with a finger between and came down on the river’s next low note, neither interval promoted into a reach, a hearing, a gift or a keeping (one hundred and thirty-two), both filed on the sixth place, exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air; the hand laid back against the fold, 278 stood exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody in Sarn, Sill and Grath, six months and ninety-eight days were told by nobody, the fire’s fifth was unpaid the same number of days with its payer unnamed, the file lay open on the towel with every gap left gap and every tray parted, the stayed frost lay white on the well lip called weather and entered nowhere, the plate of ice stood where it had been set out of the path of feet, Frost 10 stood one morning ahead and was not brought into this day, and nothing was opened, named, called, paid or ended on this Ninthday, the river’s low note going quiet after the hand came down (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082, T083/T085).}
\CRday{Day 279}{Frost 10, Tenthday, Y.H. 813  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, loaf shelf’s low angle, hearth and boards, then the Clay Yard, the road to the Cross, the reading block under the moot-post with its finger’s width of shade, the pot board, the Court table at the Slate Row fringe, the out-of-line landing below the north bridge, the four ways out of the square toward Slate Row, High Kiln and the Bone Orchard, and home again at the going of the light, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  Frost 10 came on its own light as the month’s first Account-day and market, earned by that morning and not brought into the day behind it, the boy coming into his two hundred and seventy-ninth day and six months and ninety-nine days with nobody saying so, the count crossing from two hundred and seventy-eight to two hundred and seventy-nine the way a board laid beside a board gives a dry knock, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid two hundred and seventy-nine days with its payer unnamed, fire under the floor, river low over lower at the finger’s-width door and the boards’ four, four and a knot keeping three counts in three places that did not become one, the bell’s four, four and a gap heard at the Cross kept in the square beside the told bell of the Long Night and not folded in, six hearings with no seventh, the stayed frost white on the well lip and the plate of ice on its flat stone still called weather, and the boy taking the body in its old order of crust, unnamed gap, frozen thread, cold and afterdrop and entering none of it (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082, T060/T086, T078, T083/T085 held); \textbf{the chapter’s one meaningful change, advanced and not paid:} the district’s arithmetic changed for the new month at the reading block under the moot-post and could not be changed back, Berr Clay coming up short off the clay road with the red wool cord of his office folded square under his coat and the green of tasted lead glaze at one mouth-corner, under the hot clay the smell of nothing at all, his large clean hands wiping the thumb twice before touching nothing, holding a narrow slate unopened to the forearm, passing a finger over the figure and letting his eyes rest on the writing a breath longer than the writing required, reading \emph{one in twelve, as the notice says} low into the two hundred, sending the figure over the basket once for the moot and once for late households, calling the levy and denying it with \emph{The levy is called. It is not called by me} and \emph{your house}, never \emph{I}, taking himself out of his own sentence as a surgeon takes a hand out of a field before the dressing goes on and going off toward High Kiln with the box locked and Frost’s first true subtraction inside, believing he had done a kindness, while the printed figure stood unchallenged and the figure read was still not the figure paid (T015/T041/T047 advanced, NOT paid, T077); the reading answered nothing for the man carried out on Day 188, the hand that went in on Seed 15, or the dressed grain covered and unfigured under wool at the rack end read over by a number that did not know what it cost and leaving the space between figure and price unsigned, three absences in three places with no fourth likeness made a cause (T077, T098); an assessor of Sill wrote eight pigs down before anyone could ask which eight he meant, Hessa Rale went up the clay road toward Greybank before noon with Berr’s narrow slate edge-on to her forearm and the writing to her sleeve, her hand to the slate before her eyes to the crowd, answering \emph{I don’t read it. I carry it. There’s a difference, and the road doesn’t care which} and \emph{Cross to Greybank. Reading goes up before noon. I’ve got a road to walk}, her eighth record-first hand on a place of its own with no figure off the slate (T080 advanced, not paid), and below the north bridge the soft-cuffed clerk stayed set at the out-of-line landing for a measure nobody called, a buyer’s number going in before his eyes found the man who had said it, the market selling over him as water over a stone (T090, T080); at the pot board a silent woman’s sweetish green stayed a colour and a pale line on the back of her hand stayed on its own place, and at the market’s edge a foundling’s shape in cast-off clothes turned half toward a pot after the knock and went back, a turn after the knock and not a hearing, neither named, given a loaf, a slate or a sale, and no eighth of either (T050/T051, T033/T034 held); Sella carried the basket at the half-pace from every open slate, went wide around the seven places, set it in the moot-post’s finger’s width of shade where no slate lay and stood half a pace off through the reading and the bell, and carried him home at the going of the light saying nothing of what had been read over him, setting him on his bed under the roof and not in the Debt Loft, putting the fold right without a look at his face, leaving the thread frozen, telling the fire the thaw, turning the coals with a broken pot and saying The house will keep it, her finger above the charcoal, her lips along a two-gapped row with no figure, one glance at the clay jar and her hand half over nothing, and no instruction at any hour to the basket (T058/T079, T100); Garl stayed in objects with his name unspoken two hundred and seventy-nine days and no collector came up or down the clay road for the reading, the widow’s mark hanging where it hangs at a market, a road and a going of the light, for none is an opening, and the first firing of Frost not looked at again as a sign, lesson, mending or payment (T009/T013/T092, T058/T079); in the small hours the hand went up an inch, took the small intake of the river’s own going and carried it across the little silence left by one of the counted breaths in the room whose floor does not touch his, and came down on the next low note, one house rhythm into a day full of figures, the interval given no figure, no house count borrowed and no fifth supplied (one hundred and thirty-three), and went up again, took the small intake of the heard bell’s gap and the hold of one counted breath from a woman counting turnips at the edge of the shade, set them side by side with a finger between and came down on the river’s remote note, the heard bell kept beside the told, not agreed with the figure read over the basket and not a seventh of the full note (one hundred and thirty-four), both filed exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air, not reaches, hearings, sevenths, stoppings, payments, held changes, keys, powers, gifts or rules; 279 stood exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody in Sarn, Sill and Grath, six months and ninety-nine days were told by nobody, the fire’s fifth was unpaid the same number of days, and nothing was opened, named, called, paid or ended on this Tenthday, the district’s arithmetic changed for the new month and the boy’s changed by nothing at all, his the one count nobody entered (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082, T015/T041/T047).}
\CRday{Day 280}{Frost 11, Firstday, Y.H. 813  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, loaf shelf’s low angle, hearth and finger’s-width door, the Clay Yard and its walked-around places, the yard well with the stayed white and the flat stone where the plate of ice stood, the trough skinned over, the drying racks and cool stone at the rack end, the lowest rack with its broken birth-slates, the pan’s gone round ring, the field’s empty place and the returning-line place, the flagstones with the shallow bright patch, the kindling, the Vail wheel-shed edge and its finger’s-width-open back room (not entered), the cold damper, the Debt Loft (heard only), and the clay road, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  Frost 11 came on its own morning and was not brought into the day behind it, the count going from two hundred and seventy-nine to two hundred and eighty the way a man lays one board beside another without measuring the seam, six months and one hundred days told by nobody, no market, Cross or bell on a Firstday, the reading of the tenth standing where the yard left it eight mornings short of the twentieth and nothing of it coming back under the roof as a lesson, a figure or a payment, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid two hundred and eighty days with its payer unnamed, the room smelling of hot clay cooled under tallow, wet wool and the sour mineral breath of the unswept corner called the thaw, the river low over lower at the finger’s-width door, the kiln in fours with its gap and not a bell, three counts in three places that did not become one, six hearings with no seventh, the empty seventh place not filled to make a row come out even, and the boy taking the body in its old order of crust, unnamed gap, frozen thread, cold and afterdrop and entering none of it even on the place where he keeps the things he does not enter (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082, T060/T086, T078); Sella went to the fire before the basket, told the coals it was the thaw, turned them with a broken pot, said The house will keep it where another woman would have said I, kept her finger on top of the shelf’s front edge so the charcoal stayed unread, moved her lips along a two-gapped row with no figure, glanced once at the clay jar and shut her hand half over nothing, set the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, put the fold right without a look at his face and left the thread frozen, giving every instruction to the fire, the wool, the pot, the broom and the running water and never to the basket, and the widow’s mark hanging untouched at a morning, a hearth and a basket, because none is an opening (T058/T079, T100); she lifted a corner of the wool on the cool stone at the rack end and turned the dressed grain once for damp with a lighter touch and set it back where it had lain, no figure going with the turning, the number that had read over it at the Cross the day before not knowing what it cost and the space between figure and price without a signature, Frost’s first arithmetic locked in Berr’s box up the clay road and the printed one in twelve unchallenged, the figure read still not the figure paid (T077, T015/T041/T047); she carried him up the yard at the half-pace and went wide around the seven walked-around places with a look and a wide step and no number, the clean dark line and its finer grey neighbour unswept, the broken birth-slates under the lowest rack, the pan’s gone ring on a tray of its own, the skinned trough and white lip, the field’s empty place and the returning-line hand carried and not named, seven being seven and not an account (T009/T013/T092, T098); the stayed frost-bloom lay on the well lip and the plate of ice stood on its flat stone, both called weather, neither given a figure, sign, cause, lesson, mending or payer, the surgeon’s reading of a covering laid over a depth kept on a place of its own beside the gone white of Frost 4 with no fourth likeness of three (T083/T085 held, T060/T086); Garl stayed in objects with his name unspoken two hundred and eighty days, the salt coat, hollow wheel-seat, clean dark line with its finer grey thaw and the tile debt worse for being uncalled, and no collector came up or down the clay road (T009/T013/T092); no sixth asking came over the boards and the silence was a keeping and not a sixth witness, the row at five askings with one shaping and no witness, no sixth hearing of the full note, burned slate at four, shut-room tellings at two, nine stoppings with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, nine record-first hands with no tenth, the seventh green a colour and the seventh shape a shape with no eighth, none laid across another and none called a rule (T101, T061/T082, T065/T095, T036/T076, T080, T050/T051, T033/T034); the house kept itself by not-doings --- the fifth pull unsupplied, the charcoal unread, the two lines unswept, the debt uncalled, the grain unfigured, the thread unwiped and the crust unlifted --- and the boy kept the house’s keeping on one place and his own gaps on another with a finger between (T061/T082, T060/T086); in the afternoon Ilva drew water at the yard well with the pail against her knee, clay dried pale in her nail crescents and grey rack dust in one thumb seam she did not scrub out, her hand going toward her sleeve and staying there, the notched birch not taken out, read, asked about, taken a figure from or joined to the charcoal, the cord, the knots, the pages, the tins, the missing hand or the pale line, her eyes going to the asker before her mouth answered the question put and not the one behind it --- \emph{Ask the pot what it cost. I keep the count, not the account} --- and nobody turning twice, so the boy filed no tenth record-first hand and the ninth stayed nine with a finger between it and the eighth, she not knowing she was read, two private keepings standing side by side and neither opened, the count staying in wood where no slate could take a figure off it (T080 held at nine, NOT paid); Tarn at the kindling kept six in the worn thumb-mark where the house could check and the seventh at the very lip where it could not beside Garl’s unforged sentence, said Six counted. The next I don’t count, brought the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stopped as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, drew the Seed 16 breath unspent, his chest tight, Ash in the knuckle creases, the pale clip-ring at his wrist, his stroke over the bright patch without the half-check, and the loft stone cold and unreconciled by not trying, which is not forgiveness (T036/T076, T006); Jorra at the shed edge came through with meal-fine grey slate dust past the bent finger, parted dusty forearms from clean as a surgeon parts clot from vessel, spoke to the wheel and a pot before any person, withheld the note he knew three turns ahead, put his bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella’s unfinished sentence, and the back room kept its finger’s width of open and its low voices with no name given and not said to be cold (T035/T031/T062); at the going of the light Sella set him on his bed under the roof, not the loft, put the fold right without a look, left the thread frozen, told the fire the thaw and went off; in the small hours the hand went up an inch, took the small intake of the river’s own going and let it go on the same note without holding, without carrying it across a silence belonging to another’s counting and without borrowing a house breath to close it, and came down, the letting-go kept whole and not an ending made early, not a freedom and not a gift, for a freedom wants a taker and nobody under this roof had taken anything (one hundred and thirty-five), and went up again, took two intakes from the room whose floor does not touch his, held them apart with a finger between, the first left where it was and not carried into the second, and bridged them over the river’s note, the bridge kept as an object on the sixth place and not a span crossed, no house count borrowed and no fifth supplied (one hundred and thirty-six), both filed exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air, not reaches, hearings, sevenths, stoppings, payments, held changes, keys, powers, gifts or rules; 280 stood exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody, six months and one hundred days were told by nobody, the fire’s fifth was unpaid the same number of days, the stayed frost lay white on the well lip and the plate of ice stood where it had been set, and nothing was opened, named, called, paid or ended on this Firstday, Frost 20 standing eight mornings ahead and not brought into this one (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082, T083/T085 held).}

on the space between figure and price (T077, T015/T041/T047); Garl stayed in objects with his name unspoken two hundred and eighty-two days, the salt coat, hollow wheel-seat, clean dark line with its finer grey thaw unswept, crackless proverb and uncalled tile debt intact, and no collector came up the clay road or went down it (T009/T013/T092); the yard went around the seven walked-around places with a look and a wide step and no number and the returning-line hand was carried and not named, the stayed frost-bloom lying white on the well lip and the plate of ice standing on its flat stone out of the path of feet, both called weather and given no figure, sign, cause, lesson, mending or payer, the surgeon’s reading of a skin laid over a depth kept on a place of its own beside the gone white of Frost 4 with no fourth likeness made a cause (T009/T013/T092, T098, T083/T085 held); Tarn at the kindling kept six in the worn thumb-mark where the house could check and the seventh at the lip where it could not beside Garl’s unforged sentence, told the wood Six counted. The next I don’t count, said Yes, house to early and late with the late kept because it puts off the paying though the paying stood in the ruts, brought the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stopped as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, drew the Seed 16 breath unspent, his chest tight, Ash in the knuckle creases, the pale clip-ring at his wrist, his stroke over the bright patch without the half-check, and the loft stone cold and unreconciled by not trying, which is not forgiveness (T036/T076, T006); Jorra came through with meal-fine dust past the bent finger, parted dusty forearms from clean as a surgeon parts clot from vessel, spoke to the wheel and a pot before any person, withheld the note he knew three turns ahead, put his bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella’s unfinished sentence, and kept the back room’s finger’s width of open and low voices with no name given, burned slate at four, shut-room tellings at two, three pot sayings with the premature Smoke 14 note apart, five askings with one shaping and no witness, he’s not Vail sealed and the promise neither given nor withdrawn (T035/T031/T062, T065/T095, T101, T064); no sixth asking came over the boards and the silence was a keeping and not a sixth witness, no sixth hearing came and the empty seventh place was not filled; in the small hours the hand went up an inch, took the small intake of the river’s own going through the finger’s-width door, carried it across the little silence left by one of the counted breaths in the next room with no house count borrowed and no fifth supplied, and came down on the next low note, one house rhythm carried across the river’s interval (one hundred and thirty-nine), and in the afternoon went up again, took the small intake of one counted breath from the room whose floor does not touch and the hold of the next, set them side by side with a finger between, left the letting-go between them where it was and came down on the river’s next low note, two intakes held apart as objects on the sixth place and neither made to agree with the fire’s missing fifth (one hundred and forty), both filed exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air, not reaches, hearings, sevenths, stoppings, payments, held changes, keys, powers, doctrines or rules; the hand laid back against the fold, 282 stood exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody in Low Kiln, Sill and Grath, six months and one hundred and two days were told by nobody, the fire’s fifth was unpaid the same number of days with its payer unnamed, the crust lay two inches off with its empty place unnamed, the file lay open on the towel with every gap left gap, the frost lay white on the well lip called weather and entered nowhere, Frost 20 (Day 289) stood five mornings ahead and was not brought into this day, and nothing was opened, named, called, paid or ended on this Thirdday, the river’s low note going quiet after the hand came down (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082, T083/T085 held).}
\CRday{Day 283}{Frost 14, Fourthday, Y.H. 813  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, loaf shelf’s low angle, hearth, boards and finger’s-width door, the Clay Yard, the yard well with the stayed frost-bloom and the flat stone where the plate of ice stood, the trough skinned over, the drying racks and cool stone at the rack end, the lowest rack with its broken birth-slates, the pan’s gone round ring, the field’s empty place and the returning-line place, the flagstones with the shallow bright patch, the kindling, the Vail wheel-shed edge and its finger’s-width-open back room (not entered), the cold damper, the Debt Loft (heard only), and the clay road, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  Frost 14 came on its own morning with no market, Cross or bell, the count crossing from two hundred and eighty-two to two hundred and eighty-three the way a board laid beside a board gives a dry knock and asks nothing of the seam, six months and one hundred and three days told by nobody, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid two hundred and eighty-three days with its payer unnamed, three counts in three places that did not become one, six hearings with no seventh and the empty place not filled, the heard bell kept in the square beside the told, the district’s arithmetic changed on the tenth where two hundred stood and the boy’s arithmetic not changed at all, and the boy taking the body in its old order of crust, unnamed gap, frozen thread, cold and afterdrop, the surgeon’s exact knowledge that a cold patient cannot clot buying nothing at two inches of air (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082, T060/T086, T078); Sella’s grammar held exactly, fire before basket, instruction to tools and never the basket, The house will keep it, the pot rim two inches out with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, the fold righted without a look, the thread left frozen, her finger above the charcoal, her lips along the two-gapped row with no figure, one glance at the clay jar and the hand half over nothing, the widow’s mark untouched at a morning and a basket because neither is an opening, the first firing of Frost not looked at again as a lesson and four openings being four and not a rule (T058/T079, T100); she lifted a corner of the wool at the rack end and turned the dressed grain once with a lighter touch and gave no figure, the arithmetic that read over it on Frost 10 not knowing what it cost and the space between figure and price unsigned, Frost’s first arithmetic locked in Berr’s box up the clay road and the printed one in twelve unchallenged, the figure read still not the figure paid (T077, T015/T041/T047); the yard went around the seven walked-around places with a look and a wide step and no number, the stayed frost called weather, the plate of ice standing where it was set, Garl in objects with his name unspoken two hundred and eighty-three days, no collector on the clay road, the held counts exact and unadvanced --- five askings with one shaping and no witness, nine stoppings with no tenth, nine hands with Ilva’s ninth unread, six hearings with no seventh, seventh green a colour and seventh shape a shape with no eighth, no third gap and no fourth likeness made a cause --- and in the small hours the hand held one intake past that count’s letting-go and through the little silence after it, left the silence whole and empty and not filled to make a row come out even, and came down on the river’s next low note (one hundred and forty-one), while nothing in the morning’s light foretold a word from the well’s direction (T009/T013/T092, T098, T083/T085 held, T101, T036/T076, T080, T061/T082); \textbf{the chapter’s one meaningful change, planted and not paid:} in the afternoon at the yard well Ilva was glimpsed once drawing water with the pail against her knee, clay dried pale in her nail crescents and grey rack dust worked into the seam of one thumb which she did not scrub out, her hand going toward her sleeve and staying there, the short strip of notched birch not taken out, read, asked about or taken a figure from and not joined to the charcoal, the cord, the knots, the pages, the tins, the missing hand or the pale line, her eyes going to the asker before her mouth answered the question put and not the one behind it --- Ask the pot what it cost. I keep the count, not the account --- and nobody turning twice, so the boy filed no tenth record-first hand and the ninth stayed nine with a finger between it and the eighth, she not knowing she was read, the count staying in wood where no slate could take a figure off it (T080 held at nine, \textbf{not paid}); an unnamed woman waiting her turn with a bucket, speaking to the boards and the well-roof and not into the basket and not to any person, said as a direction arrived nowhere that the runner who carried Berr Clay’s slate once carried a figure that named a person she knew --- no owner of the voice standing anywhere to be asked, no room, no hand at a slate, no name for the person, no figure spoken, no confession and no cause --- and went on with her bucket with nobody turning twice; the boy took the saying apart as a surgeon takes a wound apart and set it on a place of its own beside Hessa Rale’s eighth record-first hand with a finger between, a shaping toward the far-off day she must choose whether to read what she had carried for years, not a hearing, not a seventh, not a tenth hand, not a cause, not a confession, not a joining, not a witness and \textbf{not paid}, and did not join it to Ilva’s strip a pace away, to Berr’s twice-wiped thumb, to the soft-cuffed clerk’s inward slate, to Marra, to the charcoal or to any private keeping, nor let one stray saying stand up and call itself a rule, for a rule is an account that has found a payer and none stood (T080 advanced, \textbf{not paid}, T015/T041/T047); the shallow bright patch kept its place since Seed 22 under a broom stroke without the half-check, the loft scrape and the carried man’s pale line stayed on separate places, Tarn at the kindling kept six checkable and the seventh at the lip beside Garl’s unforged sentence and stopped the ear-sentence at the word that would call the loan as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth, Jorra parted dusty forearms from clean, spoke to the wheel and a pot before any person, withheld the note he knew three turns ahead and put his bent finger into the cold damper, the back room kept its finger’s width of open and low voices with no name given, he’s not Vail stayed sealed and the promise neither given nor withdrawn, and no sixth asking came over the boards and no further shaping, the silence a keeping and not a sixth witness (T036/T076, T006, T035/T031/T062, T065/T095, T101, T064); at the going of the light Sella carried him up at the half-pace, set him on his bed under the roof and not in the Debt Loft, put the fold right without a look at his face, left the thread frozen, told the fire the thaw, kept her finger above the charcoal and gave no instruction to the basket, the widow’s mark hanging where it hangs at a going of the light because a going of the light is not an opening (T058/T079, T100); in the small hours the hand took two intakes from the room whose floor does not touch, set them apart with a finger between and bridged them over the river’s next low note, the bridge laid down as an object on the sixth place and not a span crossed, no house count borrowed and no fifth supplied, the letting-go between the intakes left where it was and the saying at the well left where it had been said (one hundred and forty-two), exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air, not a reach, a hearing, a seventh, a stopping, a payment, a held change, a key, a power, a doctrine or a rule; the turn was from a voice that carried a figure it would not name to a boy who carried nothing and would not make a witness where none stood; 283 stood exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody in Low Kiln, Sill and Grath, six months and one hundred and three days were told by nobody, the fire’s fifth was unpaid the same number of days, the file lay open on the towel with every gap left gap and every tray parted by a finger’s width, the saying stood on a place of its own beside the eighth hand with a finger between and no witness under it, the dressed grain lay covered under wool at the rack end, the frost lay white on the well lip called weather and entered nowhere, the plate of ice stood clouded with silt where it had been set, Frost 20 (Day 289) stood five mornings ahead and was not brought into this day, and nothing was opened, named, called, paid or ended on this Fourthday, the river’s low note going quiet after the hand came down (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082, T080 advanced and not paid, T083/T085 held).}
\CRday{Day 284}{Frost 15, Fifthday, Y.H. 813  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, loaf shelf’s low angle, hearth, boards and finger’s-width door, the Clay Yard, the yard well with the stayed frost-bloom and the flat stone where the plate of ice stood, the trough skinned over, the drying racks and cool stone at the rack end, the lowest rack with its broken birth-slates, the pan’s gone round ring, the field’s empty place and the returning-line place, the flagstones with the shallow bright patch, the kindling, the Vail wheel-shed edge and its finger’s-width-open back room (not entered), the cold damper, the Debt Loft (heard only), and the clay road, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  Frost 15 came on its own morning and was not brought into the day behind it, the boy coming into his two hundred and eighty-fourth day with nobody to tell him so, the count going from two hundred and eighty-three to two hundred and eighty-four the way a man lays one board beside another without measuring the seam, six months and one hundred and four days told by nobody, no market, Cross or bell on a Fifthday, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid two hundred and eighty-four days with its payer unnamed, fire under the floor, river low over lower at the finger’s-width door and the boards’ four, four and a knot keeping three counts in three places that agreed with nobody, the bell’s four, four and a gap in the square beside the told bell, six hearings with no seventh and the empty place not filled, and the boy taking the body in its old order of crust, unnamed gap, frozen thread, cold and afterdrop and entering none of it, wanting the crust lifted and unable to close two inches on the pot handle, both true and the second louder (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082, T060/T086, T078); Sella went to the fire before the basket, pushed coal-black hair back with the burn-wrist so the grey streak at her temple showed pale, said Keep it, then. The house will keep it and It was the thaw, turned the coals with the back of a broken pot, kept her finger on top of the shelf’s front edge so the charcoal stayed unread, moved her lips along the two-gapped row with no figure, glanced once at the clay jar and shut her hand half over nothing, set the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, carried him down at the half-pace from every open slate, turned the dressed grain once beneath the wool with a touch lighter than the morning before and lighter again than the morning before that and gave no figure, and did not touch the widow’s mark at a morning, a hearth or a rack, because none is an opening and the first firing of Frost stands behind the household with its face turned away and the next opening far off in a later month’s first firing (T058/T079, T100, T077); the yard went around the seven walked-around places with a look and a wide step and no number, the stayed frost-bloom white on the well lip and the plate of ice on its flat stone both called weather and entered nowhere, Garl in objects with his name unspoken two hundred and eighty-four days and no collector up or down the clay road, and the returning-line hand carried and not named (T009/T013/T092, T098, T083/T085 held); the Frost 14 well-saying stood on a place of its own beside Hessa’s eighth hand with a finger between, one saying and \textbf{no second shaping on this day}, no witness, no confession, no joining and not paid, and the boy did not make Ilva’s ninth hand a tenth to answer it or let the held interval and the empty interval or the saying stand up and call themselves a doctrine, for a doctrine is an account that has found a payer and none stands; the other keepings stayed exact and unadvanced --- five askings with one shaping and no witness, nine stoppings with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end and still ungiven, nine record-first hands with the ninth unread, six hearings with no seventh, seventh green a colour and seventh shape a shape with no eighth, the shelf’s two gaps and the fold’s one crust with its unnamed empty place and no third gap or fourth likeness --- and the loft scrape and the carried man’s pale line lay on separate places, Ash in the unswept corner was called the thaw, and not-doings kept the house while the boy kept his gaps on another place with a finger between (T080 held, not paid, T101, T036/T076, T061/T082, T060/T086); in the small hours the hand took the small intake of the river’s own going and let it go on the same note without holding and without carrying it across a silence belonging to somebody else’s counting, and came down, the letting-go kept whole and not an ending made early, not a freedom and not a gift, for a freedom wants a taker and nobody under this roof had taken anything (one hundred and forty-three); the afternoon went on without arriving anywhere, Frost went out of the district without a boundary drawn and neither of the district’s two habits of naming its months was set right or left wrong, no lesson was made of Frost’s first reading and none made now, the yard went around its places once more with the stayed frost past the going of the light still called weather, Sella carried him up at the going of the light at the half-pace, set him on his bed under the roof and not in the Debt Loft, put the fold right without a look, left the thread frozen, told the fire it was the thaw, turned the coals with a broken pot, said The house will keep it, kept her finger above the charcoal, moved her lips along the two-gapped row, glanced once at the clay jar and shut her hand half over nothing, and gave no instruction at any hour to the basket, the widow’s mark hanging where it hangs at a going of the light because a going of the light is not an opening (T058/T079, T100); Tarn at the kindling kept six where the house could check and the seventh at the lip where it could not beside Garl’s unforged sentence, stopped the ear-sentence at the word that would call the loan as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth, drew the Seed 16 breath unspent, his chest tight, Ash in the knuckles, the pale clip-ring at his wrist, his stroke over the bright patch without the half-check, the loft stone cold and unreconciled by not trying, which is not forgiveness, and Jorra parted dusty forearms from clean, spoke to the wheel and a pot before any person, withheld the note he knew three turns ahead and put his bent finger into the cold damper, the back room keeping its finger’s width of open and low voices with no name given, burned slate at four, shut-room tellings at two, three pot sayings with the premature Smoke 14 note apart, five askings with one shaping and no witness, he’s not Vail sealed and the promise neither given nor withdrawn, and no sixth asking or hearing came (T036/T076, T006, T035/T031/T062, T065/T095, T101, T064); in the small hours the file was turned out on the towel as instruments are turned out for a man who will never be called to use them, each thing by its weight before the eye fell on it --- six hearings with no seventh, the heard bell beside the told, three pot sayings with the premature Smoke 14 note apart, burned slate at four, shut-room tellings at two, five askings with one shaping and no witness, nine stoppings with no tenth, nine hands with Ilva’s ninth unread, seventh green a colour and seventh shape a shape, Frost’s arithmetic locked in Berr’s box, the grain covered and unfigured, the Frost 14 saying on its own place beside Hessa’s eighth with a finger between and not allowed to stand up with the three held changes, the loft scrape, the carried man’s pale line, the held inch or the held and empty intervals and call the whole a rule --- the inventory complete and useless and kept anyway, the file not closed; the hand took the held interval and the empty interval from the file, set them side by side with a finger between, borrowed no house count, supplied no fifth, crossed no silence that belonged to another’s breathing and came down on the river’s next low note, neither interval promoted into a reach, a hearing, a gift, a keeping, a seventh, a stopping, a payment, a held change, a key, a power, a doctrine or a rule, one hundred and forty-four beside one hundred and forty-three, and he made nothing of it and would not let it stand up as a gift, because a gift wants a taker and nobody under this roof had taken anything (one hundred and forty-four); the turn was from completion to continuation; the hand laid back against the fold, 284 stood exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody in Low Kiln, Sill and Grath, six months and one hundred and four days were told by nobody, the fire’s fifth was unpaid the same number of days with its payer unnamed, nothing was opened, named, called, paid or ended, the file lay open on the towel with every gap left gap and every tray parted by a finger’s width, the boy lay with the crust two inches off and its empty place unnamed, the frost lay white on the well lip where the yard had left it called weather and entered nowhere, the plate of ice stood where it had been set clouded where the silt rose into it, Frost 20 (Day 289) stood five mornings ahead and was not brought into this day, and the river’s low note went quiet after the hand came down (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082, T083/T085 held, T080 held and not paid, T058/T079, T015/T041/T047).}
\CRday{Day 285}{Frost 16, Sixthday, Y.H. 813  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, loaf shelf’s low angle, hearth, boards and finger’s-width door, the Clay Yard, the yard well with the stayed frost-bloom and the flat stone where the plate of ice stood, the trough skinned over, the drying racks and cool stone at the rack end, the lowest rack with its broken birth-slates, the pan’s gone round ring, the field’s empty place and the returning-line place, the flagstones with the shallow bright patch, the kindling, the Vail wheel-shed edge and its finger’s-width-open back room (entered by unnamed men before first grey, not by the narration), the cold damper, the Debt Loft (heard only), and the clay road, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  Frost 16 came on its own first light and was not brought into a day that had not earned it, the boy coming into his two hundred and eighty-fifth day with the hundred and forty-fourth answer put away as a tool where the next hand would find it without looking and the count crossing from two hundred and eighty-four to two hundred and eighty-five the way a man lays one board beside another without measuring the seam, six months and one hundred and five days told by nobody, no market, Cross or bell on a Sixthday, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid two hundred and eighty-five days with its payer unnamed, fire under the floor, river low over lower at the finger’s-width door and the boards’ four, four and a knot keeping three counts in three places that agreed with nobody because agreeing any two would want a payer and none stood, the bell’s four, four and a gap in the square beside the told bell, six hearings with no seventh and the empty place kept empty, and the boy taking the body in its old order of crust, unnamed gap, frozen thread, cold and afterdrop and entering none of it, wanting the crust lifted and unable to close two inches on the pot handle, both true and the second louder (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082, T060/T086, T078); Sella went to the fire before the basket, told the coals it was the thaw, turned them with the back of a broken pot, said The house will keep it where another woman would have said I, pushed coal-black hair back with the burn-wrist so the grey streak showed pale, kept her finger on top of the shelf’s front edge so the charcoal stayed unread, moved her lips along the two-gapped row with no figure, glanced once at the clay jar and shut her hand half over nothing, drew the wool up telling it and not the boy what it was for, set the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, turned the dressed grain once for damp beneath the wool with a touch lighter than the morning before and gave no figure, and did not touch the widow’s mark at a morning, a hearth and a basket, because none is an opening and the first firing of Frost stands behind the household with no lesson made of it and the next opening far off in a later month’s first firing (T058/T079, T100, T077); the yard went around the seven walked-around places with a look and a wide step and no number, the stayed frost-bloom white on the well lip and the plate of ice on its flat stone both called weather and entered nowhere, the yard’s count of firings kept in wood where no slate could take a figure off it, Garl in objects with his name unspoken two hundred and eighty-five days, the tile debt worse for being uncalled and no collector up or down the clay road, and the returning-line hand carried and not named (T009/T013/T092, T098, T083/T085 held); the other keepings stayed exact and unadvanced --- five askings with one shaping and no witness, nine stoppings with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end and still ungiven, nine record-first hands with Ilva’s ninth unread and no tenth, six hearings with no seventh, seventh green a colour and seventh shape a shape with no eighth, the shelf’s two gaps and the fold’s one crust with its unnamed empty place and no third gap or fourth likeness --- and the house’s not-doings were kept on one place and the boy’s own gaps on another with a finger between, neither standing up as a rule, for a rule is an account that has found a payer and none stands; the Frost 14 well-saying stood on a place of its own beside Hessa’s eighth hand with a finger between, one saying and \textbf{no second shaping}, no witness, no confession, no joining and not paid (T080 held); Tarn at the kindling kept six counted in the worn thumb-mark and the seventh at the very lip beside Garl’s unforged collector sentence, told the wood Six counted. The next I don’t count, said Yes, house to early and late and kept the late because it puts off the paying though the paying stood in the ruts, stopped the ear-sentence at the word that would call the loan as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth, drew the Seed 16 breath unspent, his chest tight, Ash in the knuckles, the pale clip-ring at his wrist, his stroke over the bright patch without the half-check, the loft stone cold and unreconciled by not trying (T036/T076, T006), and Jorra parted dusty forearms from clean, spoke to the wheel and a pot before any person, withheld the note he knew three turns ahead and put his bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella’s unfinished sentence, the back room keeping its finger’s width of open and low voices with no name given, burned slate at four, shut-room tellings at two, three pot sayings with the premature Smoke 14 note apart, five askings with one shaping and no witness, he’s not Vail sealed and the promise neither given nor withdrawn, and no sixth asking or hearing came (T035/T031/T062, T065/T095, T101, T064); in the small hours the hand took the small intake of the river’s own going through the finger’s-width door and carried it across the little silence left by one counted breath in the next room, borrowing no house count and supplying no fifth, and came down on the river’s next low note, one house rhythm carried across the river’s interval on an ordinary morning, exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air, kept as an honest coordination and not a reach, hearing, seventh, stopping, payment, held change, key, power, freedom, gift, doctrine or rule, one hundred and forty-five beside one hundred and forty-four (T061/T082); at the going of the light Sella carried him up at the half-pace, set him on his bed under the roof and not in the Debt Loft, put the fold right without a look, left the thread frozen, told the fire it was the thaw, turned the coals with a broken pot, said The house will keep it, kept her finger above the charcoal, moved her lips along the two-gapped row, glanced once at the clay jar and shut her hand half over nothing, and gave no instruction at any hour to the basket, the widow’s mark hanging where it hangs because a going of the light is not an opening; \CRday{Day 286}{Frost 17, Seventhday, Y.H. 813  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, loaf shelf’s low angle, hearth, boards and finger’s-width door, the Clay Yard and the yard well where Ilva
