at the clay jar and shut her hand half over nothing, drew the wool up telling it and not the boy what it was for, set the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, turned the dressed grain once for damp beneath the wool with a touch lighter than the morning before and gave no figure, the arithmetic that read over it on Frost 10 not knowing what it cost and the space between figure and price unsigned, went around the seven walked-around places with a look and a wide step and no number, and did not touch the widow’s mark at a morning, a hearth and a basket, because none is an opening (T058/T079, T100, T077); the other keepings stayed exact and unadvanced --- five askings with one shaping and no witness, nine stoppings with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, nine record-first hands with Ilva’s ninth unread, six hearings with no seventh, seventh green a colour and seventh shape a shape with no eighth, the shelf’s two gaps and the fold’s one crust with its unnamed empty place and no third gap or fourth likeness --- and the stayed frost-bloom white on the well lip and the plate of ice on its flat stone were called weather and entered nowhere, Garl in objects with his name unspoken two hundred and eighty-six days and no collector up or down the clay road, the returning-line hand carried and not named (T009/T013/T092, T098, T083/T085 held); in the afternoon Ilva drew water at the yard well with the pail against her knee, clay dried pale in the crescents of her nails and rack dust worked into the seam of one thumb which she did not scrub out, and to a woman with a pot who asked what the month’s firings had taken now the first reading had gone up the road and the district’s arithmetic had changed where two hundred people stood and could not be changed back, her hand went toward her sleeve and stayed there, the short strip of notched birch bark not taken out, read, asked about or given a figure off, her eyes going to the asker before her mouth answered the question put and not the one behind it: Ask the pot what it cost. I keep the count, not the account. She said no figure and went on with her water with nobody turning twice; the boy read the order of reaching, filed \textbf{no tenth} record-first hand, kept the ninth nine on its own tray with a finger between it and the eighth, left the count in wood where no slate could take a figure off it, and did not join the strip to anything or make her a reader of her own keeping, and she did not know she had been read (T080 held at nine, not paid); the Frost 14 well-saying stood on a place of its own beside Hessa’s eighth hand with a finger between, one saying and \textbf{no second shaping on this day}, not joined to the strip in a sleeve a pace away or to any private keeping, no witness, no confession and not paid (T080 held); the shallow bright patch on the flagstones was kept as it had been since Seed 22 with the broom stroke going over it without the half-check, the loft scrape on a place of its own and the carried man’s pale line on another; Tarn at the kindling kept six where the house could check and the seventh at the very lip beside Garl’s unforged sentence, told the wood Six counted. The next I don’t count, said Yes, house to early and late and kept the late because it puts off the paying though the paying stood in the ruts, stopped the ear-sentence at the word that would call the loan as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth, drew the Seed 16 breath unspent, his chest tight, Ash in the knuckles, the pale clip-ring at his wrist, his stroke over the bright patch without the half-check, no collector coming, the loft stone cold and unreconciled by not trying (T036/T076, T006), and Jorra parted dusty forearms from clean, spoke to the wheel and a pot before any person, withheld the note he knew three turns ahead and put his bent finger into the cold damper, the back room keeping its finger’s width of open and low voices with no name given, burned slate at four, shut-room tellings at two, three pot sayings with the premature Smoke 14 note apart, five askings with one shaping and no witness, he’s not Vail sealed and the promise neither given nor withdrawn, and no sixth asking, no second shaping of the saying and no sixth hearing came (T035/T031/T062, T065/T095, T101, T064); in the small hours the hand took the small intake of one counted breath from the room whose floor does not touch his, held it past that count’s letting-go and through the little silence that came after it, and came down on the river’s next low note, the little silence left whole and empty and not filled to make a row come out even, the held intake and the empty interval laid side by side on the sixth place with a finger between, one hundred and forty-seven beside one hundred and forty-six, an honest coordination and not a reach, hearing, seventh, stopping, payment, held change, key, power, freedom, gift, doctrine or rule (T061/T082); at the going of the light Sella carried him up at the half-pace, set him on his bed under the roof and not in the Debt Loft, put the fold right without a look, left the thread frozen, told the fire it was the thaw, turned the coals with a broken pot, said The house will keep it, kept her finger above the charcoal, moved her lips along the two-gapped row, glanced once at the clay jar and shut her hand half over nothing, and gave no instruction at any hour to the basket, the widow’s mark hanging where it hangs because a going of the light is not an opening; in the small hours the hand took two intakes from the room whose floor does not touch his, set them apart with a finger between, and bridged them over the river’s next low note, the bridge laid down as an object on the sixth place and not crossed as a span, no house count borrowed, no fifth supplied and the well-saying left where it was said, one hundred and forty-eight beside one hundred and forty-seven, the boy’s refusal to join the voice at the well to the strip in the sleeve the same refusal that kept nine hands nine (T061/T082, T080 held); the hand laid back against the fold, 286 stood exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody in Low Kiln, Sill and Grath, six months and one hundred and six days were told by nobody, the fire’s fifth was unpaid the same number of days with its payer unnamed, nothing was opened, named, called, paid or ended, the file lay open on the towel with every gap left gap, the boy lay with the crust two inches off and its empty place unnamed, the frost lay white on the well lip called weather and entered nowhere, the plate of ice stood where it had been set clouded with silt, Frost 20 (Day 289) stood three mornings ahead and was not brought into this day, and the river’s low note went quiet after the hand came down (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082, T083/T085 held, T080 held and not paid, T058/T079, T015/T041/T047).}
\CRday{Day 287}{Frost 18, Eighthday, Y.H. 813  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, loaf shelf’s low angle, hearth, boards and finger’s-width door, the Clay Yard, the yard well with the stayed frost-bloom and the flat stone where the plate of ice stood, the trough skinned over, the drying racks and cool stone at the rack end, the lowest rack with its broken birth-slates, the pan’s gone round ring, the field’s empty place and the returning-line place, the flagstones with the shallow bright patch, the kindling, the Vail wheel-shed edge and its finger’s-width-open back room (entered by unnamed men before first grey, not by the narration), the cold damper, the Debt Loft (heard only), the towel at the head of the bed, and the clay road, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  Frost 18 came on its own morning, earned by its own light and not by any count kept under a roof, and was not poured into the day behind it, the boy coming into his two hundred and eighty-seventh day two hundred and eighty-seven days old and six months and one hundred and seven days with nobody in Low Kiln, Sill or Grath saying so, the number exact and complete set edge to edge against a house that keeps its days in loaves, glances and the unnamed space where a loaf should have stood, no market, Cross or bell on an Eighthday, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid two hundred and eighty-seven days with its payer unnamed, fire under the floor, river low over lower at the finger’s-width door and the boards’ four, four and a knot keeping three counts in three places that agreed with nobody, the bell’s four, four and a gap in the square beside the told bell, six hearings with no seventh and the empty place kept empty, and the boy taking the body in its old order of crust, unnamed gap, frozen thread, cold and afterdrop and entering none of it, the order not having changed in two hundred and eighty-seven mornings, wanting the crust lifted and unable to close two inches on the pot handle, both true and the second louder (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082, T060/T086, T078); Sella came to the hearth before the basket and gave the instruction to the fire and the pot and the wool and never to the thing she carried, said the house where another woman would have said I and the boy where another woman would have said my son and never finished a sentence that would have required her to say what she felt, set the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, put the fold right without a look at his face, left the thread frozen where it lay because nobody had told her about the thread and she had told nobody, kept her finger on top of the shelf’s front edge so the charcoal stayed unread, moved her lips along the two-gapped row with no figure, glanced once at the clay jar and shut her hand half over nothing, pushed coal-black hair back with the burn-wrist so the grey streak showed pale, turned the dressed grain once for damp with a touch lighter than the morning before and lighter again than the morning before that and gave no figure, went around the seven walked-around places with a look and a wide step and no number, her broom going over the shallow bright patch on the flagstones without the half-check, and did not touch the widow’s mark at a morning, a hearth and a rack, because none is an opening and the first firing of Frost stands behind the household with no lesson made and the next opening far off and unbrought (T058/T079, T100, T077); the stayed frost-bloom lay white on the well lip and the plate of ice stood on its flat stone clouded with silt, both called weather and entered nowhere with no sign, cause, lesson, mending or payer made of either, Garl in objects with his name unspoken two hundred and eighty-seven days, the tile debt worse for being uncalled and no collector up or down the clay road, the returning-line hand carried and not named, and the dressed grain still covered and unfigured under wool at the rack end with the arithmetic that read over it on Frost 10 not knowing what it cost (T009/T013/T092, T098, T083/T085 held, T015/T041/T047); the other keepings stayed exact and unadvanced --- five askings with one shaping and no witness, nine stoppings with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, nine record-first hands with Ilva’s ninth unread and no tenth, six hearings with no seventh, seventh green a colour and seventh shape a shape with no eighth, the shelf’s two gaps and the fold’s one crust with its unnamed empty place and no third gap or fourth likeness --- and the Frost 14 well-saying stood on a place of its own beside Hessa’s eighth hand with a finger between, \textbf{one saying and no second shaping on this day}, no witness, no confession, no joining and not paid, and the boy did not let it or the held interval and the empty interval stand up and call themselves a doctrine, for a doctrine is an account that has found a payer and none stands (T080 held, T101, T036/T076, T061/T082); Tarn at the kindling kept six where the house could check and the seventh at the very lip beside Garl’s unforged collector sentence, told the wood Six counted. The next I don’t count, said Yes, house to early and late and kept the late because it puts off the paying though the paying stood in the ruts, stopped the ear-sentence at the word that would call the loan as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth, drew the Seed 16 breath unspent, his chest tight, Ash in the knuckles, the pale clip-ring at his wrist, his stroke over the bright patch without the half-check, the loft stone cold and unreconciled by not trying (T036/T076, T006), and Jorra came through from the wheel-shed with meal-fine grey dust ground small as meal into both forearms, parted dusty forearms from clean, spoke to the wheel and a pot before any person, withheld the note he knew three turns ahead and put his bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella’s unfinished sentence so the household straightened around his silence, the back room keeping its finger’s width of open and low voices with no name given, burned slate at four, shut-room tellings at two, three pot sayings with the premature Smoke 14 note apart, five askings with one shaping and no witness, he’s not Vail sealed and the promise neither given nor withdrawn, and no sixth asking or hearing came (T035/T031/T062, T065/T095, T101, T064); in the small hours the hand took the small intake of the river’s own going and let it go on the same note without holding, and came down, the letting-go kept whole and not an ending made early, not a freedom and not a gift, for a freedom wants a taker and nobody under this roof had taken anything, one hundred and forty-nine beside one hundred and forty-eight (T061/T082); the afternoon went on without arriving anywhere, Frost’s last working day thinning the way a pot comes off the coals and is set on a cold stone, neither of the district’s two habits of naming its months set right or left wrong, no lesson made of Frost’s first reading and none made now, the yard calling the stayed frost weather past the going of the light and nobody moving the plate of ice; at the going of the light Sella carried him up at the half-pace, set him on his bed under the roof and not in the Debt Loft, put the fold right without a look, left the thread frozen, told the fire it was the thaw, turned the coals with a broken pot, said The house will keep it, kept her finger above the charcoal, moved her lips along the two-gapped row, glanced once at the clay jar and shut her hand half over nothing, set the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, and gave no instruction at any hour to the basket, the widow’s mark hanging where it hangs because a going of the light is not an opening (T058/T079, T100); in the small hours the file was turned out on the towel at the head of the bed as instruments are turned out for a man who will never be called to use them, each thing by its weight before the eye fell on it --- six hearings with no seventh, the heard bell beside the told, three pot sayings with the premature Smoke 14 note apart, burned slate at four, shut-room tellings at two, five askings with one shaping and no witness, nine stoppings with no tenth, nine hands with Ilva’s ninth unread, seventh green a colour and seventh shape a shape, Frost’s arithmetic locked in Berr’s box, the grain covered and unfigured, the Frost 14 saying on its own place beside Hessa’s eighth with a finger between and forbidden to stand up with the three held changes, the loft scrape, the carried man’s pale line, the held inch or the held and empty intervals and call the whole a rule --- the inventory complete and useless and kept anyway, the file not closed; the hand took the held interval and the empty interval from the file, set them side by side with a finger between and came down on the river’s next low note, neither interval promoted into a reach, hearing, gift, keeping, seventh, stopping, payment, held change, key, power, doctrine or rule, one hundred and fifty beside one hundred and forty-nine, and a round number of answers and a hundred and fifty hand-movements did not stand up and call themselves a doctrine, for a doctrine is an account that has found a payer and none stands, and he made nothing of the threshold and would not let it stand up as a gift, because a gift wants a taker and nobody under this roof had taken anything (T061/T082); the turn was from completion to continuation; the hand laid back against the fold, 287 stood exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody in Low Kiln, Sill and Grath, six months and one hundred and seven days were told by nobody, the fire’s fifth was unpaid the same number of days with its payer unnamed, nothing was opened, named, called, paid or ended, the file lay open on the towel with every gap left gap and every tray parted by a finger’s width, the boy lay with the crust two inches off and its empty place unnamed, the frost lay white on the well lip called weather and entered nowhere, the plate of ice stood where it had been set clouded with silt, Frost 20 (Day 289) stood two mornings ahead and was not brought into this day, and the river’s low note went quiet after the hand came down (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082, T083/T085 held, T080 held and not paid, T058/T079, T015/T041/T047).}
\CRday{Day 288}{Frost 19, Ninthday, Y.H. 813  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, loaf shelf’s low angle, hearth, boards, pot board and towel, then the Clay Yard with its seven walked-around places, the yard well and flat stone, the drying racks and rack end, the kindling and flagstones, the wheel-shed edge and its finger’s-width-open back room (a direction and a sound only), the Debt Loft (heard only), and back under the roof in the small hours, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  Frost 19 came on its own ordinary morning with no market, Cross or bell, the boy coming into his two hundred and eighty-eighth day with the hundred and fiftieth answer laid down as a tool where the next hand would find it without looking, the count crossing from two hundred and eighty-seven to two hundred and eighty-eight exact, six months and one hundred and eight days told by nobody, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid two hundred and eighty-eight days with its payer unnamed, three counts in three places that did not become one, six hearings with no seventh, the heard bell in its square beside the told, Frost 20 standing one morning ahead and unbrought, and the boy taking the body in its old order of crust, unnamed gap, frozen thread, cold and afterdrop and entering none of it (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082, T060/T086, T078); Sella went to the fire before the basket, said The house will keep it, turned the coals with a broken pot, kept her finger above the charcoal and her lips along the two-gapped row, glanced once at the clay jar and shut her hand half over nothing, turned the dressed grain beneath the wool with a lighter touch and no figure, set the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, left the widow’s mark untouched because a morning is not an opening, and gave every instruction to the fire, the wool, the pot, the broom and the running water and never to the basket; the yard went wide around the seven walked-around places with a look and a wide step and no number, the stayed frost lay white on the well lip and the silt-clouded plate of ice stood on its flat stone out of the path of feet and both were called weather, and Garl stayed in objects with his salt-stiff coat and hollow wheel-seat and uncalled tile debt, his name unspoken two hundred and eighty-eight days and no collector on the clay road; Tarn at the kindling kept six checkable and the seventh at the lip beside Garl’s unforged collector sentence, said Six counted. The next I don’t count in the tone of a man stating the weather and Yes, house to both those who wanted the thaw early and those who wanted it late, and brought the ear-sentence as far as the word that would call the loan before stopping, a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, his Seed 16 breath unspent, Ash in his knuckles and the pale clip-ring at his wrist; Jorra at the wheel-shed edge kept dusty and clean forearms on one tray, spoke to the wheel and a pot before any person, put his bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella’s unfinished sentence, and withheld the note he knew three turns ahead while the burned slate stood at four, the shut-room tellings at two, three pot sayings with the Smoke 14 note apart, the row at five askings with one shaping and no witness and he’s not Vail sealed; in the afternoon a voice came over the boards and the well-roof with no owner standing anywhere to be asked, no room, no hand at a slate, no name, no figure, no confession and no cause, and gave the Frost 14 well-saying a second shaping, asking what a runner carries in a slate that has a name in it, which the boy took apart as a surgeon takes a wound apart and filed on a place of its own beside the first saying and beside Hessa Rale’s eighth record-first hand with a finger between every pair, not a hearing, not a seventh, not a tenth hand, not a cause, not a confession, not a joining, not a witness and not paid, never making Hessa a reader and never letting two shapings stand up as a rule (T080 advanced, not paid); and in the small hours the hand took the small intake of the fire’s silence across the interval to the going of the first morning under this roof (one hundred and fifty-one) and two intakes held apart with a finger between, the second shaping set where the first had stood and the first where it had stood (one hundred and fifty-two), each exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air, neither promoted into a reach, a hearing, a seventh, a stopping, a payment, a doctrine or a rule, the surgeon’s clean satisfaction checked by the infant’s louder want of the crust and the checking not called a virtue.}
\CRday{Day 289}{Frost 20, Tenthday, Y.H. 813  —  under the Vail roof at the bed, hearth and towel, the Clay Yard and clay road, the Cross, the reading block under the moot-post with its finger’s width of thin shade, the pot board across the square, the out-of-line landing below the north bridge, and home again at the going of the light, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  Frost 20 came on its own morning as the month’s second Account-day and market, earned by that light and not brought into the day behind it, the count crossing from two hundred and eighty-eight to two hundred and eighty-nine exact, six months and one hundred and nine days told by nobody, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid two hundred and eighty-nine days, three counts in three places that did not become one, six hearings with no seventh, no bell borrowed before its morning, and the boy taking the body in its old order of crust, unnamed gap, frozen thread, cold and afterdrop and entering none of it (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082, T060/T086); Sella’s grammar held exactly, fire before basket, instruction to the tools and never the basket, the dressed grain lifted and turned beneath the wool with a progressively lighter touch and no figure though a number was already travelling up the clay road that would not know what it cost, the widow’s mark untouched because a reading is not an opening, and the basket set in the moot-post’s finger’s width of thin shade where no slate lay with the boy standing half a pace off through the reading; \textbf{the chapter’s one meaningful change, advanced and not paid:} Berr Clay came up short off the clay road with the red wool cord of his office folded square under his coat and the green of tasted lead glaze at one corner of his mouth, under the hot clay the smell of nothing at all, wiped his thumb twice on his apron before touching nothing, passed a finger over a narrow figure, held the slate unopened to his forearm with the writing inward, read \emph{one in twelve, as the notice says} low into the two hundred, sent the figure over the basket once for the moot and a second time for the households that came late, told the man at the rail who held a number up out of a fist that the figure stood as read and his household had heard wrong, called the levy for Frost and denied it with \emph{The levy is called. It is not called by me} and \emph{your house}, never \emph{I}, taking himself out of his own sentence as a surgeon takes a hand out of a field before the dressing goes on, and went off toward High Kiln with the box locked and believing he had done a kindness; Frost’s second true subtraction went up beside the first and the district’s arithmetic changed a second time for the month where two hundred people stood and could not be changed back, the printed figure unchallenged and the figure read still not the figure paid, while the figures over the basket and over the covered grain knew nothing of the man carried out on Day 188, the hand that went in on Seed 15 or the price under the wool; Hessa took Berr’s narrow slate up the clay road toward Greybank before noon edge-on to her forearm with the writing to her sleeve, answered the women who asked with \emph{I don’t read it. I carry it} and \emph{Reading goes up before noon. I’ve got a road to walk}, and was not made a reader by either shaping of the well-saying; the soft-cuffed clerk stayed set at the out-of-line landing with his cuff grey again by midday and his buyer’s number entered before he looked up, and the market sold over him as water goes over a stone; the bell went four, four and a gap with nobody crossing himself and stayed in the square beside the told bell, not folded into the three counts; at the pot board a silent woman with the sweetish green of lead glaze at one corner of her mouth, clay pale under her nails and a pale cord-mark across the back of one hand, turned a cup a quarter and set it back where it stood, and at the market’s edge a child in cast-off clothes worn like a uniform never measured for him, with silt pale in his wrist creases, a gap where a front tooth had been and a green sliver on a string at his throat, turned half a beat after a pot was set down, both sightings only, a colour and a shape with no eighth and no name, never Fenna or Ulda in the narration; Sella carried him home at the going of the light saying nothing of what had been read over him, set him on his bed under the roof and not in the Debt Loft, put the fold right without a look at his face, left the thread frozen, told the fire it was the thaw, turned the coals with a broken pot, kept her finger above the charcoal and her lips along the two-gapped row and gave every instruction to the tools and never the basket; in the small hours the hand took the space between the moot’s reading and the late households’ reading and set it beside his own unnamed gap with a finger between (one hundred and fifty-three), a told figure beside a paid figure and neither made to agree, and then the heard bell’s gap held beside a counted breath from the room whose floor does not touch his (one hundred and fifty-four), crossing no silence that belonged to another’s breathing, and nothing of the reading came back under the roof as lesson, sign, mending, cause or payment.}
\CRday{Day 290}{Frost 21, Firstday, Y.H. 813  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, loaf shelf’s low angle, hearth, boards, pot board and towel, then the Clay Yard with its seven walked-around places, the yard well and flat stone, the drying racks and rack end, the kindling and flagstones, the wheel-shed edge and its finger’s-width-open back room (a direction and a sound only), the Debt Loft (heard only), and back under the roof in the small hours, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  Frost 21 came on its own ordinary Firstday with no market, Cross or bell, the grey discovered on the well lip where no grey had lain when the coals were banked, the count crossing from two hundred and eighty-nine to two hundred and ninety exact, six months and one hundred and ten days told by nobody, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid two hundred and ninety days, three counts in three places that did not become one, six hearings with no seventh, the heard bell staying in its square, both arithmetics locked in Berr’s box, the two shapings held beside Hessa’s eighth hand, Frost 30 standing nine mornings ahead and unbrought, and the boy taking the body in its old order of crust, unnamed gap, frozen thread, cold and afterdrop and entering none of it (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082, T060/T086, T078); Sella’s grammar held exactly at the fire and the grain, the wool told to keep the river wind off his ears, the broom told to go around, the pot rim two inches out with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, the charcoal unread, the widow’s mark untouched at a morning, the dressed grain turned beneath the wool with a lighter touch and no figure, and the clay jar glanced at once with the hand shut half over nothing; the hand took the small intake of the river’s note and held it past that count’s letting-go and through the little silence after it, leaving the silence whole and empty and not filled to make a row come out even (one hundred and fifty-five); in the afternoon the yard went around its seven walked-around places with a look and a wide step and no number, the stayed frost and the silt-clouded plate of ice on its flat stone were called weather with no fourth likeness made a cause, Tarn at the kindling kept six checkable and the seventh at the lip beside Garl’s unforged collector sentence, brought the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stopped as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth, his chest tight, Seed 16 breath unspent, Ash in his knuckles and the pale clip-ring at his wrist, Jorra at the wheel-shed edge kept dusty and clean forearms on one tray, spoke to the wheel and a pot before any person, put his bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella’s sentence, withheld the note he knew three turns ahead and kept the burned slate at four, the shut-room tellings at two, three pot sayings with the Smoke 14 note apart, the row at five askings with one shaping and no witness and he’s not Vail sealed, while the promise of the boy’s name was neither given nor withdrawn, and Garl stayed in objects with his name unspoken two hundred and ninety days and no collector on the clay road; at the going of the light Sella carried him up at the half-pace from every open slate; in the small hours the file was turned out with every tray parted by a finger’s width, the Frost 14 saying standing at one saying and one second shaping beside Hessa Rale’s eighth hand with a finger between, not a witness, not a confession, not a joining and not paid, and the hand took the held interval and the empty interval from the file, set them side by side with a finger between, borrowed no house count, supplied no fifth to the kiln, crossed no silence that belonged to another’s breathing and came down on the river’s next low note of water over water (one hundred and fifty-six), exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air, a round threshold not a doctrine, the surgeon’s clean satisfaction checked by the infant’s plain want of the crust and the checking not called a virtue; 290 stood exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody in Low Kiln, Sill and Grath, six months and one hundred and ten days were told by nobody, the fire’s fifth stood unpaid the same number of days, the hand laid back against the fold on the one hundred and fifty-sixth answer, the file open on the towel with every gap left gap, the river’s low note going quiet, and nothing opened, named, called, paid or ended.}
\CRday{Day 291}{Frost 22, Secondday, Y.H. 813  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, loaf shelf’s low angle, hearth, boards, pot board and towel, then the Clay Yard with its seven walked-around places, the yard well and flat stone, the drying racks and rack end, the kindling and flagstones, the wheel-shed edge and its finger’s-width-open back room (a direction and a sound only), the Debt Loft (heard only), and back under the roof in the small hours, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  Frost 22 came on its own ordinary Secondday with no market, Cross or bell, the count going from two hundred and ninety to two hundred and ninety-one exact, six months and one hundred and eleven days told by nobody, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid two hundred and ninety-one days with its payer unnamed, the kiln’s four low pulls and its silence, the river’s water over water and the boards’ four, four and a thumb-width knot keeping three counts in three places that did not become one because agreeing any two would want a payer and none stood to any, six hearings beside and never among with the seventh place kept empty, the heard bell’s four, four and a gap in its square beside the told bell, the told figure beside the paid with Frost’s first and second arithmetics locked in Berr’s box and the printed one in twelve unchallenged, the Frost 14 saying held with one saying and one second shaping beside Hessa’s eighth hand with a finger between and no third supplied, the row at five askings with one shaping and no witness, and Frost 30 six mornings ahead and unbrought (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082, T078, T080 held); the boy took the body in its old order of crust two inches off with its empty place unnamed and no third, frozen thread unwiped, cold at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint, and the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody would perform, wanting the crust while knowing a cold patient cannot clot and must be warmed from the outside and slowly, the surgeon taking the inventory and the infant keeping the want with neither authority over the other (T060/T086);
